title: Product Illustrator and Writer
description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Team:**
Design & Marketing

**About Hunar**

Hunar is a voice AI platform helping businesses automate and simplify frontline recruitment and workforce opera-tions.

We’re building AI-powered products that help businesses engage with candidates, automate repetitive conversations, and manage high-volume hiring more eﬀiciently.

We’re a fast-moving startup based in Bengaluru, working with businesses that hire and manage frontline workforces at scale.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a
**Product Illustrator & Writer**
who can bring ideas to life through both visuals and words.

You’ll work across product design, marketing, and brand communication, creating illustrations that give our prod-ucts personality and writing that makes complex technology feel simple, approachable, and human.

From illustrations within the product to website visuals, UX copy, feature announcements, and newsletters, you’ll help shape how Hunar looks, sounds, and communicates with its users.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys both visual storytelling and writing, and understands how the two can work together to create compelling experiences.

**What You'll do**

**Illustration and visual storytelling**

• Design illustrations for product interfaces, empty states, onboarding experiences, and feature announcements.

• Create illustrations and visual assets for website pages, marketing campaigns, and newsletters.

• Develop and maintain a distinctive, consistent illustration language for Hunar.

• Translate complex AI concepts and product capabilities into simple, engaging visual stories.

• Experiment with different illustration styles and creative approaches while maintaining brand consistency.

**UX writing and product communication**

• Write clear, concise, and intuitive UX copy, including labels, instructions, tooltips, empty states, error mes-sages, and onboarding content.

• Work with product designers to make complex workflows easier to understand through thoughtful language.

• Create content for new feature launches, product updates, and in-app announcements.

• Establish and maintain consistency in the product’s voice and tone.

• Think critically about how writing influences usability, comprehension, and user behaviour.

**Marketing and content**

• Write compelling copy for website sections, landing pages, and marketing campaigns.

• Conceptualise, write, and design newsletters and product announcement emails.

• Collaborate with the marketing team on creative campaigns and product storytelling.

• Help communicate Hunar’s value proposition to different audiences through clear messaging and strong visu-als.

**What we're looking for**

• Strong illustration skills with a portfolio demonstrating creativity, versatility, and attention to detail.

• Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with an ability to make complex ideas simple, clear, and engaging.

• Good understanding of visual design fundamentals, including composition, colour, typography, and hierarchy.

• Proficiency in illustration and design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent soft-ware.

• Ability to adapt your illustration and writing styles to different contexts, audiences, and communication goals.

• An understanding of how illustrations and copy work together within digital products.

• Strong conceptual thinking and an ability to communicate the reasoning behind creative decisions.

• Ability to take ownership of projects, work independently, and collaborate across teams.

• A willingness to experiment, learn quickly, and iterate based on feedback.

**Good to have**

• Experience creating illustrations for SaaS products, websites, or digital interfaces.

• Familiarity with UX writing, content design, or product communication.

• Experience with motion graphics or animated illustrations.

• An understanding of B2B products and technology-driven businesses.

• Experience writing and designing email newsletters, feature announcements, or marketing campaigns.

• Familiarity with AI products and an interest in making emerging technologies more approachable.

**What you'll get to work on**

• Shaping the illustration language of a growing AI product.

• Building visual narratives for new features and product experiences.

• Improving how users understand and interact with AI through thoughtful UX writing.

• Creating campaigns and communication assets used by real businesses.

• Working closely with product designers, engineers, and marketers, with the opportunity to own projects from concept to execution.

**Who should apply ?**

We’re open to both
**full-time candidates and students looking for a Graduation Project internship**
.

We’re particularly interested in people with backgrounds in communication design, illustration, visual design, or related disciplines, although your portfolio and ability to think creatively matter more than your degree.

You don’t need to be equally experienced in every aspect of the role, but you should have a genuine interest in both illustration and writing.

Your portfolio should ideally showcase your illustration work, conceptual thinking, and examples of writing or visual storytelling.

title: Hardware Functional Safety (FuSa) Specialist
description: Enabling a software-defined, electrified future. Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here . Mission of the Role : The Functional Safety Specialist is responsible for ensuring that automotive electronic systems comply with ISO 26262 and related safety standards. The role involves safety concept creation, hazard analysis, safety requirements engineering, technical safety architecture, verification planning, and supporting hardware/software teams through the full safety lifecycle.Key Responsibilities Functional Safety Lifecycle Management Lead and execute activities across the ISO 26262 V-model safety lifecycle, from concept phase to SOP. Develop and maintain the Functional Safety Plan, timelines, and work products. Ensure processes are followed and all safety artifacts are created and reviewed. Safety Analysis & Concept Development Perform Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) and derive ASIL levels. Develop Functional Safety Concept (FSC) and Technical Safety Concept (TSC). Define safety goals, safety mechanisms, and safety requirements (FSR/TSR). Requirements Engineering Write, review, and maintain functional and technical safety requirements. Ensure bi-directional traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and validation. Support system, hardware, and software teams to interpret and implement safety requirements. Hardware & Software Safety Collaborate with hardware architects to define safety mechanisms for MCU, PMIC, watchdog, self-tests, power domains, fault handling, etc. Support software teams in designing safety-compliant drivers, boot, diagnostics, and monitoring logic. Review MCU safety manuals, safety architecture, and vendor documentation (e.g., Infineon Traveo II, NXP, Renesas). Safety Analysis & Verification Conduct and review FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA, Dependent Failure Analysis. Calculate FIT rates, single-point fault metrics, and latent fault metrics. Create safety validation plans and support unit/integration/system-level testing. Audits, Assessments & Compliance Prepare safety case documentation for customer and auditor reviews. Work with internal/external assessors (TÜV, Exida, OEM auditors). Support ASPICE, cybersecurity (ISO 21434), and quality-compliance alignment. Cross-Functional Collaboration Provide training and guidance to development teams on ISO 26262 processes. Work directly with system architects, hardware designers, software teams, testing, quality, cybersecurity, and program management. Participate in design reviews and ensure safety considerations are incorporated early.Required Skills & Qualifications Technical Skills Strong understanding of ISO 26262 Part 2–12 and full safety lifecycle. Expertise in safety analyses: FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA. Understanding of safety architecture for MCUs, SoCs, and automotive ECUs. Experience with safety mechanisms: lockstep CPUs, watchdogs, ECC, BIST/MBIST, CRC, voltage monitoring, clock monitoring, safe states, etc. Experience with requirements management tools: DOORS, Polarion, Jama, etc. Working knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers, hardware design, and automotive software development. Domain Knowledge Automotive electronics: clusters, body control, powertrain, ADAS, infotainment, or battery systems. Exposure to ASPICE, ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity), and OEM-specific safety processes. Experience 5–15 years of experience in automotive embedded systems. Minimum 5+ years in Functional Safety roles. Experience delivering at least one safety-critical product to SOP. Preferred Qualifications Certified Functional Safety Engineer/Professional (TÜV, Exida). Experience with safety implementation on MCUs like Infineon Traveo II, NXP S32, Renesas R-Car, TI Hercules. Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, or related engineering field. Experience with model-based development (MATLAB/Simulink). Visteon Culture: If you thrive in a fast-paced, organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability, and a growth mindset from its employees to thrive and stay ahead of the curve Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking, and continuous learning help us keep up with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and be Market leaders. At Visteon you can be more.

title: Service Catalogue Manager
description:
**1. Role Purpose**

The Service Catalogue Manager is responsible for developing, maintaining, standardising, and governing AVASO’s global service catalogue. The role ensures that all service offerings are clearly defined, commercially aligned, operationally deliverable, and documented in a consistent format for use by Sales, Solutioning, PMO, Service Delivery, and Operations teams.

The position will serve as the central owner of service catalogue information, ensuring accuracy, completeness, version control, stakeholder validation, and periodic updates throughout the service lifecycle.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Service Catalogue Development & Ownership**

* Develop and maintain a centralised, structured global service catalogue covering AVASO’s service offerings.
* Define service descriptions, scope, deliverables, prerequisites, exclusions, dependencies, and delivery models.
* Maintain service classifications, categories, subcategories, and standard service attributes.
* Ensure each catalogue entry has a clearly defined service owner and documented approval.
* Identify and eliminate duplicate, outdated, incomplete, or inconsistent service entries.

**B. Service Definition & Standardisation**

* Work with Solutioning, Sales, PMO, GFS, GSC, Professional Services, Digital Workspace, and other relevant teams to define and validate service offerings.
* Standardise service descriptions and delivery requirements across regions while accommodating approved local variations.
* Document service eligibility, resource requirements, delivery assumptions, and operational dependencies.
* Ensure service definitions are sufficiently clear to support solution design, proposals, service transitions, and operational execution.

**C. Catalogue Data Management & Tools**

* Maintain accurate catalogue data using ServiceNow or an equivalent service management platform, supported by structured repositories and reporting tools as required.
* Establish data quality checks for completeness, consistency, accuracy, and duplication.
* Manage catalogue updates, version control, approval workflows, and change history.
* Maintain catalogue records, supporting documentation, ownership details, review dates, and approval status.
* Develop reports and dashboards to track catalogue completeness, pending validations, overdue reviews, and data quality.

**D. Governance & Stakeholder Management**

* Establish and maintain the service catalogue governance process, including submission, review, approval, publication, and retirement of services.
* Coordinate with service owners and functional leaders to validate service information and resolve outstanding gaps.
* Conduct periodic catalogue reviews and ensure timely updates following changes to service scope, delivery models, or commercial arrangements.
* Maintain an action tracker for pending service definitions, approvals, and stakeholder confirmations.
* Escalate overdue inputs, conflicting definitions, and governance exceptions to the designated leadership team.

**E. Commercial & Operational Alignment**

* Coordinate with Finance, Sales, and Solutioning to ensure service descriptions align with approved pricing models, cost assumptions, and commercial terms.
* Capture relevant SLAs, service coverage, response and resolution commitments, resource requirements, and delivery constraints.
* Ensure catalogue entries reflect approved service capabilities and do not introduce unapproved commercial or operational commitments.
* Support proposal preparation, solution validation, transition planning, and service onboarding by providing accurate catalogue information.
* Identify opportunities to simplify service offerings, improve standardisation, and reduce repetitive solutioning effort.

**3. Required Skills & Experience**

Mandatory Requirements

* Proven hands-on experience in service catalogue management, IT service management, service portfolio administration, or a closely related role.
* Strong capability in service definition, documentation, classification, standardisation, and data governance.
* Practical experience with ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM/service management platform.
* Strong stakeholder coordination skills, including working with technical, commercial, and operational teams.
* Experience maintaining structured repositories, managing change records, and producing management reports.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge.
* Experience supporting global IT services, field services, managed services, EUC, networking, or professional services.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, Excel, or similar reporting tools.
* Familiarity with service costing, pricing structures, SLAs, and service delivery models.

**4. Key Competencies**

1. Catalogue Ownership: Takes accountability for end-to-end catalogue completeness, accuracy, and usability.
2. Analytical Thinking: Identifies information gaps, inconsistencies, duplication, and opportunities for standardisation.
3. Governance Discipline: Maintains clear ownership, approvals, review cycles, and audit trails.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Obtains inputs and resolves issues across multiple functions and regions.
5. Execution & Attention to Detail: Delivers accurate documentation, maintains action trackers, and meets agreed deadlines.

**5. First 90-Day Deliverables**

First 30 days — Assess and Baseline

* Review the existing service catalogue, available documentation, and governance processes.
* Validate the service inventory, service owners, and information gaps.
* Establish a prioritised remediation and stakeholder validation tracker.

Days 31–60 — Standardise and Govern

* Implement standard service catalogue templates and mandatory data fields.
* Define ownership, approval workflows, change control, and review cadence.
* Begin resolving incomplete, duplicated, or outdated service records.

Days 61–90 — Operationalise and Report

* Publish the validated catalogue in the agreed central repository or platform.
* Implement catalogue quality and governance reporting.
* Establish a recurring review process and a prioritised improvement roadmap.

**6. Role Boundaries**

The Service Catalogue Manager owns catalogue structure, service definitions, data quality, governance, and maintenance.

The role collaborates with, but does not independently replace, the responsibilities of:

* Solutioning: Solution architecture, technical design, and proposal ownership.
* Sales / Commercial: Customer commitments, pricing approval, and contract negotiations.
* Service Delivery: Validation of operational feasibility and actual delivery capability.
* Finance: Approval of costing assumptions and commercial models.



**7. Success Profile**

The successful candidate will be a hands-on Manager who can independently organise service information, work with multiple stakeholders, establish disciplined governance, and maintain a reliable global catalogue. The role prioritises execution, data quality, service standardisation, and cross-functional coordination rather than a large team-management remit.

title: BIM Content Creator
description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
  
  
We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
  
  
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
Role purpose
  
  
The MIC BIM Component Creator develops, tests, documents and maintains intelligent, reusable, data-rich BIM content for the Moata Intelligent Content (MIC) library. The role converts engineering and project requirements into reliable digital components that enable standardized, efficient and automated design delivery across infrastructure and building projects.
  
  
Working with MIC curators, content checkers, approvers, publishers and project teams, the role ensures that content is technically accurate, lightweight, interoperable, correctly classified and ready for controlled publication and reuse.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  

* Develop and maintain parametric, data-rich BIM content, including Revit families, AutoCAD-based components, Civil 3D subassemblies and other platform-specific assets required by MIC.
* Interpret briefs, engineering requirements, manufacturer information and project standards, then convert them into clear content specifications and fit-for-purpose digital components.
* Apply MIC naming, classification, parameter, metadata, category, subcategory and documentation standards consistently throughout the content lifecycle.
* Build content that is efficient in file size, stable in use, visually appropriate, correctly constrained and suitable for reuse in large project models.
* Configure and test geometry, parameters, formulas, types, visibility settings, connectors, materials and data outputs, as applicable to the authoring platform.
* Create and test Civil 3D subassemblies using Subassembly Composer, including parameters, targets, conditions, codes and corridor behavior where required.
* Complete self-checks and peer checks before content is submitted through the MIC review, approval, versioning and publication gateways.
* Respond to checker and approver feedback, correct identified issues and maintain traceable records of revisions, testing and status.
* Maintain content documentation, thumbnails, reference files, metadata, version information and progress updates in the relevant MIC tracking and catalogue systems.
* Collaborate with project teams, engineering specialists and digital delivery stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve technical issues and support content adoption.
* Provide practical support to users, investigate content-related issues and implement controlled updates without compromising existing use cases.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for standardization, batch processing, automation, quality assurance and reusable workflows.
* Share knowledge with colleagues and develop capabilities across relevant Autodesk, Bentley, GIS, data and automation platforms.

**Essential Qualifications And Experience**

* HNC/HND, diploma, degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, architecture, construction technology, information technology or a related discipline.
* Demonstrable experience creating, editing and quality-checking BIM or digital engineering content within at least one engineering discipline.
* Strong knowledge of BIM content-development principles, including parametric modelling, data structures, classification, naming, performance optimization and quality assurance.
* Proficiency in Revit family creation, including parameters, formulas, nested content, categories, subcategories, visibility controls, materials and testing.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD and Civil 3D; hands-on experience with Civil 3D Subassembly Composer is required for roles supporting corridor content.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, schedules, manufacturer data and project requirements.
* Experience working within controlled review, approval, version-management and publication processes.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and locations.

Desirable knowledge and experience
  

* Experience with Bentley platforms, including MicroStation, OpenBuildings Designer, DGN and CEL content.
* Working knowledge of GIS platforms such as Esri ArcGIS.
* Experience with content catalogues or repositories such as Bentley Component Center and Autodesk Content Catalogue.
* Knowledge of shared-parameter management, data integration, batch processing or tools such as DiRoots.
* Exposure to scripting or automation for BIM content creation and quality assurance, such as Dynamo, Python or platform APIs.
* Experience developing generic or manufacturer content for the Water, Wastewater, Transport, Energy or Built Environment sectors.

Technical quality expectations
  
  
**Quality area**
**Expected outcome**
**Functionality**
Content behaves predictably across the intended types, views, levels of detail and project conditions.
  
  
**Data quality**
Parameters, metadata, classifications and units are complete, accurate, consistent and usable.
  
  
**Performance**
Geometry and file size are proportionate to purpose and do not create avoidable model-performance issues.
  
  
**Standards**
Naming, categories, subcategories, materials, documentation and catalogue information follow current MIC requirements.
  
  
**Verification**
Content is tested, warnings and redundant elements are resolved, and evidence is available for review.
  
  
**Lifecycle control**
Revisions, dependencies, references, status and publication information are recorded and traceable.
  
  
Personal attributes and behaviors
  

* Quality-focused, methodical and attentive to detail.
* Curious about technology and willing to build capability across multiple authoring and data platforms.
* Collaborative and respectful, with a strong commitment to shared team outcomes.
* Proactive in planning work, raising risks, solving problems and following tasks through to completion.
* Comfortable receiving, applying and providing constructive technical feedback.
* Committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing and an automation-first mindset.

Measures of success
  

* Components meet agreed requirements and pass MIC checking and approval with minimal avoidable rework.
* Deliverables are completed to the agreed scope, quality and schedule, with progress and risks communicated clearly.
* Published content is reusable, discoverable, correctly documented and supported through its lifecycle.
* Feedback from users and reviewers is converted into measurable improvements to content and working practices.
* This role contributes to stronger standards, automation, platform capability and knowledge sharing across the MIC team.

**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
  
  
**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

**Employment Compliance Requirement**
As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**

title: Content Intern
description:
**About Skydo:**

Behind every Indian business going global is money they worked hard to earn. But when it's time to get paid, they wait days and lose 3-7% of their revenue to hidden forex markups and fees nobody explains, just to receive what's already theirs.

We're fixing this. Skydo gives exporters flat fees, zero forex markup, settlement in hours, and compliance that's handled for them from start to finish.

**Join us and help millions of ambitious businesses get paid the way they deserve.**

**About the Role :**

As a Content Intern at Skydo, you own the entire blog engine. From crafting outlines and assigning briefs to writers and agencies, to making sure deadlines are met, quality holds up, and every published post performs, you are the point of contact who keeps the whole thing on track. Every blog that goes live on Skydo passes through you.

**What you will do:**

* End-to-end blog ownership: Run the pipeline from topic intake to published post, keeping the editorial calendar accurate and current
* Editorial quality: Review and sharpen outlines before they go into production, then review
* every draft for accuracy, structure, tone, and depth, fact-checking every claim
* Operational ownership: Manage freelance writers and content agencies, assign briefs
* based on topic fit, and hold everyone to the dates they committed to
* Feedback loops: Give writers feedback specific enough to make the next draft better, and track whether quality improves over time
* Distribution and performance: Publish in the CMS, repurpose blogs across LinkedIn,
* newsletters, and social, and work with SEO to track performance and plan reworks

**You’re a good fit if you have:**

* Excellent writing and editing instincts, with a sharp editorial eye and a keen eye for errors
* A fact-checker's mindset: you verify every claim, number, and regulation against a primary source before it ships
* The ability to go deep on financial and compliance concepts like FEMA, RBI purpose codes, FIRA, and EDPMS, and explain them in plain English
* The appetite to learn Skydo's product and pricing inside out, including how we compare to the alternatives exporters actually consider
* Comfort in the messy middle: juggling writers, agencies, deadlines, and last-minute changes without losing the plot
* Bonus: a blog, newsletter, or body of published work of your own, with receipts to show for it.

**The mindset we’re seeking:**

* Radical Accountability: Full ownership is your default. You track how published blogs perform, work out what is landing and what is not, and act on it without waiting for someone to point it out
* Editor's Instinct: You spot what a draft is missing and explain it clearly enough that the writer gets it right on their own next time
* Builder's Ambition: You want to build a system that keeps running after you set it up.

title: Environmental Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Environment Engineer: -**

**1. Environmental Management System (EMS)**

* Implement and maintain environmental management programs in accordance with ISO 14001 requirements and company policies.
* Support the identification and evaluation of environmental aspects, impacts, risks, and opportunities associated with manufacturing operations.
* Monitor environmental performance and drive continual improvement initiatives across the facility.

**2. Statutory Compliance and Regulatory Management**

* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental laws, regulations, and requirements of the State & Central Pollution Control Board and other regulatory authorities.
* Monitor the validity of environmental consents, authorizations, permits, and statutory records.
* Maintain compliance documentation, prepare periodic reports, and coordinate regulatory submissions within stipulated timelines.
* Support regulatory inspections, audits, and closure of observations.

**3. Environmental Monitoring and Pollution Control**

* Monitor air emissions, wastewater discharge, ambient air quality, noise levels, and other applicable environmental parameters.
* Ensure the effective operation and monitoring of pollution control systems and environmental infrastructure.
* Coordinate environmental sampling and testing with approved laboratories and follow up on corrective actions for deviations.
* Identify potential environmental risks associated with manufacturing processes and recommend appropriate preventive and corrective measures.

**4. Waste Management**

* Monitor the segregation, storage, handling, and disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Ensure proper maintenance of waste inventory, disposal records, manifests, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with authorized waste recyclers and disposal agencies and support periodic vendor audits.
* Promote waste minimization, recycling, and resource recovery initiatives.

**5. Environmental Training and Employee Engagement**

* Conduct environmental awareness and training programs for employees, contract workers, and relevant stakeholders.
* Promote employee participation in environmental improvement initiatives and encourage environmentally responsible workplace practices.
* Conduct routine environmental inspections and workplace awareness activities to improve environmental compliance and housekeeping.

**6. Environmental Audits and Risk Assessment**

* Conduct periodic environmental audits and inspections to identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Assist in developing and reviewing environmental aspects-impact assessments and operational controls.
* Track audit findings, coordinate corrective and preventive actions, and verify their effective closure.
* Support emergency preparedness activities related to environmental incidents, including chemical spills and potential pollution events.

**7. Sustainability and Carbon Emission Reduction**

* Support initiatives to reduce energy and water consumption, waste generation, and carbon emissions.
* Collect, analyze, and maintain environmental performance data for sustainability reporting.
* Identify opportunities for resource conservation, recycling, and adoption of environmentally sustainable practices.
* Assist in implementing corporate sustainability goals and environmental improvement projects.

**8. EPR – Extended Producer Responsibility**

·       Drive the EPR module for packaging plastics and e-waste in accordance with the latest E-waste & Plastic Management Rules

·       Co-ordinate with supply chain and recycling partner to ensure on-time fulfilling of EPR obligations and file returns.

**9. Documentation and Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Maintain accurate environmental records, operating logs, inspection reports, training records, and compliance registers.
* Prepare periodic environmental performance reports and present key observations to the EHS team and management.
* Coordinate with Manufacturing, Production, Maintenance, Facilities, Supply Chain, and other functions to implement environmental controls and improvement actions.
* Support environmental investigations and ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

**Key skills & competencies for this position:**

·       At least 2-3 years of manufacturing industry experience and working knowledge meeting the JD.

·       Strong communication & Interpersonal skills for cross functional co-ordinations.

·       Proficiency in local language (Kannada) is a mandate. Multilingual proficiency shall be an added advantage.

·       Good analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

·       Understanding of ISO 14001 Environment Management Systems & EPR modules.

·       Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint for report preparation.

·      Attention to detail, and a proactive approach to environmental improvement.

**Education level and/or certification and training requirements, as well as years of experience**

·       A Bachelor / Master degree in ‘Environment Engineering’ is a mandate requirement as per Karnataka State Pollution Control Board.

·       Max work experience for this role shall not exceed 4 yrs.

·      Any additional environment / sustainability related courses / certifications would be preferred.

title: Sr. Supplier Development Engineer (RF Integration)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
  
  
**SR. SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (RF INTEGRATION)**
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
  
  
SpaceX is developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. We are looking for talented, creative, and driven engineers to develop, drive, and maintain suppliers, from initial concept development to full scale production.
  
  
This is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability of the user terminal manufacturing at our global suppliers. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering and manufacturing departments as well as with global base of suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement RF test cases and calibration procedures for Starlink user terminals at external suppliers
* Working in close collaboration with hardware and software engineers rapidly develop design validation and production test solutions for our high-volume consumer products
* Establish strong linkages between assembly data and final RF test performance, driving root cause analysis of yield limiters
* Use statistical tools such as SPC and DOE to monitor, and JMP to analyze, control, and improve yield across the manufacturing line
* Develop and maintain risk models to evaluate RF test strategies and ensure effective test coverage across corner cases in individual manufacturing processes
* Sustain and optimize RF integration workflow and throughput in a high-mix assembly configuration environment, driving continuous improvements in cycle time and cost
* Collaborate with design teams to provide feedback on DFM (Design for Manufacturability) and yield optimization opportunities with focus on RF integration
* Support installation and qualification of new RF test tools, including both capability enhancements and capacity expansions
* Work closely with production team and electronics hardware vendors to resolve equipment and process-related issues
* Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), engineering instructions, and test documentation
* Planning, proposing, and leading experiments to produce timely and accurate analyses used to drive design, development, and supply chain decisions, with a focus on scalability for high volume electronics manufacturing
* Planning validation exercises to demonstrate initial feasibility as well as manufacturing capability at high volumes, incorporating throughput modeling and yield optimization
* Reviewing progress of development activities at supplier locations and serve as point of escalation for critical process related issues, ensuring alignment with high volume ramp-up requirements
* Assigns specific tasks and work with SpaceX suppliers to support process development and/or data gathering activities aimed at achieving consistent high throughput and low defect rates
* Establish validation procedures to qualify process equipment during development builds as well as mass production, incorporating statistical process controls and capacity planning for high volume output
* Actively participate in the program planning and monitoring process assuming responsibility for key deliverables at all milestones, including quality gates for volume ramp-up

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical or electronics engineering
* 5+ years of professional experience with antennas, RF communication systems, or electronics hardware

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Master's degree or PhD in electrical or electronics engineering
* 10+ years of professional experience with antennas, RF communication systems, or electronics hardware
* 5+ years of experience in electronics manufacturing, including leadership roles in supplier development or process engineering for complex consumer electronics systems
* 5+ years of experience in final assembly, test and packout
* Experience with basic principles of antenna theory and designing wireless communications systems
* Thorough understanding of RF active and passive components
* Experience characterizing radio performance at microwave frequencies
* Programming experience in Python, C#, C++, or MATLAB
* Experience in analyzing large datasets and dispositioning hardware based on data
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple suppliers and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to work independently with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proven track record of production ramp-up for high-volume electronics manufacturing, preferably in consumer electronics

**Additional Requirements**

* Position is based in Bangalore, India and requires being onsite - remote work not considered
* Must be willing to work long hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines
* Ability to travel: Up to 50% of work week travel may be required to suppliers in Southeast Asia

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are:**
You are energized by motion—new problems, shifting priorities, and the kind of fast-paced environment where progress depends on clear thinking and calm execution. You don’t wait for perfect information before you act; you ask sharp questions, form a hypothesis, and move forward while keeping others aligned on what you’re learning. You thrive when the work is ambiguous and the stakes are real, because you enjoy turning complexity into something teams can rally around.
  
  
You approach challenges with a builder’s mindset. You’re curious, hands-on, and willing to experiment, but you’re equally disciplined about quality and follow-through. When something isn’t working, you don’t look for someone to blame—you look for the root cause, the simplest path to resolution, and the long-term fix that prevents repeat issues. You communicate with intention, adapting your message so engineers, partners, and stakeholders all walk away with the same understanding and next steps.
  
  
You’re the teammate people trust in the middle of pressure. You create space for collaboration, invite different viewpoints, and make others better by sharing context and giving credit freely. You take ownership naturally: when you see a gap, you close it; when you see an opportunity, you champion it. **What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Developing and delivering technical workshops, training sessions, and product demonstrations tailored to customer needs.
* Partnering with R&D and product management teams to influence product direction and resolve complex technical issues.
* Authoring and maintaining technical documentation, application notes, and best practice guides.
* Providing pre- and post-sales technical support, including troubleshooting, bug tracking, and solution development.
* Mentoring and guiding junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Accelerating customer success by ensuring seamless deployment and integration of Synopsys solutions.
* Enhancing product quality and usability through direct feedback and collaboration with R&D teams.
* Expanding Synopsys’ footprint in key accounts by demonstrating technical excellence and building strong customer relationships.
* Reducing design cycle times and improving overall productivity for our customers.
* Contributing to the growth of Synopsys’ technical community through knowledge sharing and mentoring.
* Influencing future product innovations by identifying emerging customer needs and market trends.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Strong expertise in ASIC/FPGA design and verification methodologies.
* Hands-on experience with industry-leading EDA tools such as synthesis, simulation, and formal verification platforms.
* Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Perl, TCL) and automation frameworks.
* Solid understanding of digital design, SoC architectures, and semiconductor manufacturing processes.
* Ability to analyze and resolve complex technical issues quickly and effectively.

**Who You Are:**

* Innovative thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Excellent communicator, able to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Collaborative team player who values diversity and inclusion.
* Customer-oriented with a commitment to delivering outstanding service and solutions.
* Adaptable, resilient, and eager to learn new technologies and methodologies.

**The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:**
You’ll join an accomplished team of application engineering experts at the forefront of EDA and semiconductor innovation. Our team partners closely with customers, R&D, and product management to deliver world-class solutions and technical support. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture that encourages continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional growth. Together, we drive the adoption of cutting-edge technologies and ensure Synopsys remains the trusted partner for industry leaders worldwide.
  
  
**Rewards and Benefits:**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Avionics System V&V (DO178C., ARP4754A)
description:
**We are hiring! - Aerospace System Testing Engineer**

**Location:**
Bangalore, Karnataka (onsite)

**Experience:**
6+ Years Are you passionate about aviation safety and mission-critical systems?

Qubist Solutions is expanding our engineering team, and we are looking for a rigorous and detail-oriented Aerospace System Testing Engineer. In this role, you will bridge system design, software, and hardware to ensure our airborne products meet the highest levels of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

**What You Will Do:**

* Design, develop, and execute system-level test plans and procedures for complex avionics architectures.
* Ensure bi-directional requirements traceability from aircraft-level safety objectives down to implementation artifacts.
* Configure and manage Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), System Integration Labs (SIL), and automated test environments.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve defects and root-cause anomalies during integration.
* Generate objective evidence and traceability matrices to support SOI (Stage of Involvement) audits and FAA/EASA certification.

**The Standards You Will Drive:**

You will directly apply the core ecosystem of aerospace certification guidelines to our testing lifecycle:

* ARP4754A:Validating system architectures and requirement allocations.
* ARP4761: Utilizing FHA, PSSA, and SSA outputs to drive safety-critical failure-mode testing.
* DO-178C: Executing high-level/system-level software integration tests.
* DO-254: Verifying complex electronic hardware behavior at the system and LRU levels.
* DO-330: Defining Tool Operational Requirements and validating automated verification toolchains.
* DO-356A: Testing system vulnerabilities and verifying airworthiness cybersecurity architectures.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Aerospace, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or related fields.
* 5+ years of hands-on avionics testing and integration experience in a certified program.
* Proficiency in Requirements Management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion).
* Experience with test automation scripting (Python, C/C++) and aviation data buses (ARINC 429, AFDX, MIL-STD-1553B).
* A proven track record of generating certification artifacts for regulatory audits.

**How to Apply:**

Ready to build the future of flight? Click "Apply" on this post or send your resume directly to communications@qubistsolutions.com with the subject line "Aerospace Testing Engineer - [Your Name]".

#Hiring #Aerospace #Avionics #SystemsEngineering #DO178C #DO254 #ARP4754A #ARP4761 #DO330 #DO356

title: Etch Process Technologist- Manager
description:
**The Group You’ll Be A Part Of**
In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.
  
  
**The Impact You’ll Make**
As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomic precision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your role involves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware to meet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements to ensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial role our customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductor breakthroughs.
  
  
In this role, you will directly contribute to \_\_\_.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Responsible for performing professional process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of the company’s complex semiconductor capital equipment and systems.
* Reviews processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture, fabrication and evaluation of products. Involvement may begin at any step from pilot plant to full-scale manufacturing.
* May conceive and plan projects involving definition and selection of new concepts and approaches in the processing or development of new processes.
* Supports customer technology managers in the planning, data collection, analysis, and reporting of customer demos to defend existing process applications. Works with customer and senior engineers cross functionally to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements and business issues/ challenges.
* Utilize internal simulation & AI/ML based tools to drive process development strategies in optimizing the etch processes.
* Analyze data and provide insights to improve process performance, yield and efficiency. Utilize JMP and other tools to generate process sensitivities and trade-offs
* Work closely with concept & feasibility teams to drive and adopt new process innovations and technology roadmaps. Great presentation skills to clearly articulate demo status, complex etch strategies.
* Works with customer to demonstrate and introduce new technologies at customer sites through demos, on site evaluations, and new tool qualifications. Drives the adoption of new technology at the customer site.
* Acts as single point of contact accountable for process, hardware, software, etc. related requests from customer and work with cross-functional teams within BU. Contributes to product development and release activities.

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Who We’re Looking For**

* Minimum Qualifications:
* Ph.D. in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics with 5+ years or M.S. with 8+ years or B.S. with 10+ years of relevant work experience.
* Managerial & Leadership responsibilities
* Lead a team of Junior & Senior process engineers to enable successful penetration & defense of key etch applications directly impacting Lam revenue
* Responsible for managing multiple customer accounts in driving Lam Etch Tool Strategy, enabling successful tool evaluations at the customer site & driving new business opportunities.
* Acts as a hands-on technical manager & leader for colleagues with less experience, coach them, and ensure successful engagement of the team in driving Lam Etch objectives.
* Responsible for creating & presenting technical review material for key technical projects on frequent basis for high level TRMs at customer site.
* Will be subject matter expert & key technologist with etch experience in process development in advanced technology nodes, will be responsible in coming up with solutions & implementing learnings from global scientific community in new approaches for some of grand etch challenges.
* Works with cross-functional teams to get information and results as needed to enable successful tool demo and business wins/defenses.
* Update on regular basis demo progress & customer penetration & defense status to executives and higher management both at customer and internal.
* Customer Relation- Professionally represent the company to the customer. Utilize knowledge of company’s product lines and services to keep existing/ potential customers informed when new/ additional needs are identified.
* Other Job Responsibilities-Comfortable with travelling 2-3 Months of the time during initial training.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* In depth understanding of Plasma Physics, Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), Atomic Layer Etching (ALE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP).
* Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques.
* Experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques.
* Interest in advanced technology and an on-going desire to learn.
* In-depth understanding and working knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE); experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc.)
* Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and ability to react to shifting priorities to meet business needs and deadlines.
* Excellent people skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively and efficiently with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, internal and external partners.
* Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment
* Handling development projects and supporting semiconductor customers

**Our Commitment**
We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
  
  
Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.
  
  
*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

title: Senior Associate, Application Onboarding,  IAM
description:

The Application Onboarding Associate supports the onboarding of applications into SailPoint IdentityNow by gathering pre‑onboarding information, preparing documentation, and assisting with technical deployment activities. **Key Responsibilities**

* Collect, validate, and document pre‑onboarding information from application owners and stakeholders.
* Support the assessment and selection of appropriate onboarding methods and connector types (e.g., AD, CSV, API/web services).
* Assist in deploying and configuring applications within SailPoint IdentityNow under the direction of senior analysts.
* Execute Post‑Implementation Testing (PIT) activities including data validation, entitlement verification, and lifecycle checks.
* Perform routine data quality reviews, cleansing, and maintenance to ensure accuracy and integrity of identity data.
* Create or enhance scripts and tools to automate onboarding or data preparation tasks.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to identify new connector requirements, enhancements, and process improvements.
* Provide operational support and knowledge transfer on onboarding processes and standards.
* Generate and analyse onboarding and operational reports to identify trends, risks, and optimisation opportunities.
* Maintain process documentation, configuration notes, and audit evidence in accordance with regulatory and internal standards.
* Stay current on IdentityNow capabilities, industry practices, and emerging Identity Governance technologies.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, Computer Science or relevant field, or equivalent practical experience in IAM/security operations.

* Working knowledge of:

+ Active Directory and LDAP concepts
+ REST APIs, authentication methods, and data integrations
+ CSV‑based data ingestion

* Understanding of identity lifecycle management, access governance, and IAM principles.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and data‑quality skills.
* Ability to manage multiple onboarding activities in a project‑driven environment.

* Willingness to follow standards, learn new technologies, and grow within an IAM/IGA operating model.

* Understanding of joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle processes.

+ AD/LDAP connectors
+ CSV connectors
+ REST API / web services integrations

**Technical Foundations**

* Understanding of AD groups, accounts, and permissions.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, data flows, authentication, and connectivity fundamentals.
* Basic networking knowledge (ports, protocols, dependencies).

**Automation & Scripting**

* Ability to adapt or create scripts for data preparation and onboarding automation.
* Comfortable working with structured data formats (CSV, JSON, XML).

**Testing, Data Quality & Operations**

* Experience performing PIT or functional testing activities.
* Strong focus on accuracy, consistency, and identifying data anomalies.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Ability to produce onboarding documents, technical notes, and process guides.
* Experience generating operational or audit‑relevant reports.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Works effectively with application owners, IT teams, and business users.

* Able to explain technical concepts in clear, business‑friendly language.

* Able to identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and root causes.

**Time Management**

* Consistently meets deadlines while maintaining quality standards.

**Collaboration & Teamwork**

title: Senior Customer Experience Associate
description:
**CX (Customer Experience) | 3+ years | Full Time | Bangalore**
**Role Name: Senior Customer Experience Associate**
At Kapture CX, we are looking for a
**Senior Customer Experience Associate**
in our
**Customer Experience**
team.
  
  
**Who are we?**
Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight-driven efficiencies to their CX operations. Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture’s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca-Cola, Bigbasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation.
  
  
Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and we have offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines and Indonesia.
  
  
**What is this role all about?**
As a
**Senior Customer Experience Associate**
, you will take ownership of customer issues that require deeper technical troubleshooting, stronger understanding of client workflows, and coordination across multiple teams. You will work closely with customers, Implementation, Product, SRE and Engineering teams to investigate and resolve complex issues, manage escalations, and ensure a smooth customer experience.
  
  
The role combines
**customer engagement, technical problem-solving, issue ownership and operational discipline**
, while also contributing to better documentation and more effective support processes.
  
  
**Sounds interesting?**
**Here’s What You Will Do In This Role**
**Client Engagement**

* Build strong understanding of client workflows, business logic and use cases to provide context-aware technical support.
* Act as a reliable point of contact for complex customer issues, providing clear and timely updates throughout the resolution process.
* Understand the business impact and priority of customer issues and ensure the right level of escalation and follow-up.
* Provide solution-oriented guidance to customers by understanding their workflows, requirements, and business context.

**Technical Expertise**

* Investigate and troubleshoot complex application, API and integration issues, using available logs, API responses and system information to identify probable causes.
* Analyse issues logically, distinguish between configuration, integration and product-related problems, and provide complete technical information for further investigation where required.
* Raise and manage BUGs/CRs in JIRA with clear reproduction steps, business context and supporting technical information, and follow them through to closure.
* Collaborate with Product, SRE and Engineering teams on complex issues and validate fixes or resolutions before communicating closure to customers.
* Build and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, FAQs and troubleshooting guides covering client workflows, business context and recurring issues.
* Perform QA/QC checks and set up alert mechanisms to proactively identify and address potential issues and bugs.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Manage customer issues through triage, prioritisation, escalation, resolution and closure, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs.
* Coordinate with Implementation, Product, SRE and Engineering teams to drive complex issues to resolution and ensure clear ownership across teams.
* Support release, configuration or implementation-related activities where required, ensuring customer-impacting issues are identified and addressed proactively.
* Identify recurring support challenges and contribute to improvements in processes, documentation and ways of working.

**Business Acumen**

* Perform basic analysis of customer issues, support trends, and relevant operational data to identify patterns and areas for improvement.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to track customer issues, support trends, SLAs, and other relevant metrics.
* Use data and dashboard insights to highlight recurring issues, operational gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Present relevant findings clearly to support discussions with Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders.

**What does success look like in this role?**
Success in this role means
**consistently resolving complex customer issues within defined SLAs, maintaining strong customer trust, providing accurate technical troubleshooting and escalation, and driving issues to closure through effective cross-functional collaboration.**
It also means building strong knowledge of customer workflows and contributing to documentation, process improvements and a more effective support experience.
  
  
**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**

* You have 3+ years of experience in Customer Experience, technical support, application support or a similar role, preferably in a SaaS or CRM environment.
* You have experience handling complex customer issues and escalations and coordinating with technical teams for resolution.
* You are comfortable working with ticketing tools such as Freshdesk and issue-management tools, managing multiple priorities while meeting SLAs.
* You have a strong understanding of client workflows, business logic and SaaS product functionality.
* You have experience working with APIs, integrations or basic backend troubleshooting.
* You have experience creating or maintaining technical documentation, runbooks, FAQs or troubleshooting guides.
* You communicate clearly and professionally with both customers and technical/internal teams.

**What are the most critical skills for this role?**

* Strong technical troubleshooting and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate complex issues, identify probable root causes and provide clear information for escalation.
* Strong customer handling skills, with the ability to manage expectations during complex or high-priority issues.
* Ability to understand technical issues in the context of customer workflows and business impact.
* Strong ownership and follow-through on issues across multiple teams.
* Ability to document technical issues, solutions and recurring scenarios clearly and accurately.
* Strong prioritisation and time-management skills in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

**You Will Have An Advantage If You**

* Have hands-on experience with JIRA for BUG/CR tracking and escalation management.
* Have experience working with enterprise or high-volume SaaS customers.
* Have exposure to API testing/debugging tools such as Postman.
* Have experience creating technical runbooks, knowledge articles or troubleshooting documentation.
* Have worked closely with Product, Engineering, SRE or Implementation teams on customer issues.
* Have exposure to AI-powered SaaS products, chatbots or customer experience automation.
* Have exposure to dashboarding tools and analytics for tracking and analysing customer or operational data.
* Have exposure to prompt engineering and AI tools.

**Why should you be interested?**
**Here’s What You Will Gain From This Role**

* You will work on a leading enterprise SaaS platform used by some of India's top brands, gaining exposure to complex customer environments and large-scale CX operations.
* You will deepen your technical troubleshooting, product and problem-solving skills by working on diverse customer challenges.
* You will work closely with Product, Engineering, SRE and Implementation teams, building strong cross-functional experience.
* You will develop a deeper understanding of enterprise customer workflows, SaaS products and technical support operations.
* You will be part of a fast-growing organization that values ownership, learning and career progression.

title: Senior Applied Value Engineer - UKI Energy, Oil & Gas
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
As an Senior Applied Value Engineer you push the envelope in solving mission-critical problems for our customers. You will work with our most strategic customers, understand their strategy and key challenges, and build Celonis solutions using cutting-edge AI technologies from market leaders such as Microsoft and OpenAI. With Celonis’ market-leading Process Intelligence (PI) Platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ businesses and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization to increase Celonis' footprint at those customers..
  
  
**Role Description**

* As a Senior Applied Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
* Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a „can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
* Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
* Proof projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects, incl. architecture and deliver secure, scalable LLM/agent systems with RAG, tools, and guardrails; integrating with enterprise data, identity, and compliance frameworks.
* Ensure Successful Project Outcome: Senior Applied Value Engineer stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached
* Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization Senior Applied Value Engineer specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries

**Requirements:**

* 6+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales, including defining AI roadmaps, building compelling ROI/TCO business cases and prototyping of machine learning and generative AI solutions.
* Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.
* Understanding of business processes across sectors (such as Supply Chain or Finance) with the ability to translate high-level business needs into specific AI use cases.
* Good knowledge of Python and common ML libraries (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies.
* Strong presentation skills to both internal and external stakeholders (including executives), whether whiteboarding sessions or formal readouts and demos.
* Bachelor’s Degree required, Masters Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent work experience preferred.

**Nice to have (big plus):**

* Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering, while ensuring safety through rigorous evaluations and guardrails.
* Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
* Experience in deploying and monitoring models at scale across major cloud platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, GCP Vertex)

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Sr Principal Product Engineer
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**About Us**
Cadence is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality. With the integration of ChipStack, we are redefining the industry by bringing agentic AI capabilities directly into the silicon development lifecycle. Cadence customers are the world’s most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including consumer, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace industrial and health. At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a dynamic and commercially minded Product Engineer to drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy and manage customer engagements for our groundbreaking agentic AI product suite. In this role, you will act as the critical nexus between our cutting-edge technology and our customers' most pressing business needs. You are highly technical—capable of deeply understanding AI-driven chip design and verification flows—yet highly business-savvy, with a talent for positioning complex products in the market. You will collaborate closely with Research & Development (R&D) and Field Application Engineers (FAEs) to orchestrate successful product evaluations, secure technical wins, and accelerate widespread adoption of our AI solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
\* Own and manage end-to-end customer engagements, acting as the primary GTM driver for our agentic AI and LLM-driven EDA products.
  
  

* Serve as the strategic bridge between customers, Field Application Engineers (FAEs), and R&D, ensuring that technical evaluations are executed flawlessly and feedback is operationalized.
* Blend deep technical knowledge of semiconductor design with strong business acumen to articulate product value propositions, ROI, and competitive differentiation to engineering leaders and executives.
* Engage directly with early adopters and key customers to understand their specific design workflows, translating their requirements into actionable roadmaps for the R&D team.
* Develop high-impact technical collateral, product presentations, and deployment playbooks to empower the sales and FAE teams in the field.
* Maintain current knowledge of advancements in AI-powered hardware design, EDA trends, and market dynamics to actively participate in shaping the product's strategic direction.

**Required Qualifications**
\* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (an MBA or equivalent business experience is a strong plus) with 12+ Years experience.
  
  

* Proven expertise in a Product Engineering, Technical Marketing, or Field Application Engineering (FAE) role within the semiconductor or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) industry.
* Solid technical foundation in ASIC design flows, hardware verification (Verilog, SystemVerilog), and an understanding of modern ML/LLM technologies.
* Demonstrated track record of managing complex technical customer engagements and successfully executing Go-To-Market (GTM) initiatives.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the unique ability to translate dense, highly technical concepts into compelling business value.
* Self-motivated, with a proactive approach to cross-functional collaboration, problem-solving, and driving projects forward in a fast-paced environment.

**The Cadence Advantage**
\* The opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology in an environment that encourages you to be creative, innovative, and to make an impact.
  
  

* Cadence’s employee-friendly policies focus on the physical and mental well-being of employees, career development, providing opportunities for learning, and celebrating success in recognition of specific needs of the employees.
* The unique “One Cadence – One Team” culture promotes collaboration within and across teams to ensure customer success.
* Multiple avenues of learning and development available for employees to explore as per their specific requirement and interests.
* You get to work with a diverse team of passionate, dedicated, and talented individuals who go above and beyond for our customers, our communities, and each other—every day.

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**
