title: Learning Operations Specialist
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
eBay is reimagining the future of e-commerce by building a trusted marketplace and empowering global teams with high-impact talent development. The Global Finance Learning & Development team supports finance professionals across all stages of their careers through innovative, scalable learning programs and operational excellence.
  
  
In this role, you will partner directly with business leaders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to design engaging learning solutions, oversee global learning management system (LMS) operations, facilitate high-touch onboarding experiences, and maintain internal digital content platforms. Combining instructional design expertise with operational rigor, you will play a central role in driving talent development across the Finance organization—including new hire onboarding, early career technical curriculum, networking circles, and other ad hoc learning projects.
  
  
What You Will Accomplish
  
  
As the Instructional Designer and Learning Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for end-to-end learning solution design, global LMS system management, program facilitation, and content governance across the Global Finance organization.
  
  
Instructional Design & Content Development
  
  

* Apply instructional design and design thinking principles to build engaging, learner-centered functional and technical training programs.
* Develop and maintain end-to-end courseware, including e-learning modules, facilitator guides, participant workbooks, presentations, visual assets, and knowledge assessments.
* Partner with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to design and update finance technical curricula and onboarding materials.
* Build assessment tools and end-of-class exams for structured career development pathways, including the multi-tier Finance Future Professionals (FFP) curriculum.
* LMS Administration & Learning Operations
* Own end-to-end LMS operations in Workday Learn across the Global Finance organization, overseeing asset loading, offering creation, and course enrollments.
* Track and report L&D metrics, pulling learning enrollment, attendance, and assessment analytics to monitor program impact and engagement.
* Serve as ad-hoc registrar and operational point of contact, handling ad-hoc requests, registration tracking, and learner comms across teams.

Program Management & Facilitation
  
  

* Facilitate engaging virtual and in-person sessions, including new hire programs and networking circles.
* Coordinate program logistics, including conference room bookings in key hubs (San Jose, Austin, Bangalore), calendar holds, and executive speaker alignment with leadership.
* Support Finance Networking Circles (FNC) by aligning strategy, coordinating host schedules, managing calendar holds, publishing communications, and co-hosting live sessions.
* Develop and distribute onboarding materials (e.g., Director & Above Playbook) and tailored Welcome Letters for new hires, direct managers, and directors.
* Distribute post-session collateral, sharing training recordings, AI Zoom summaries, and updated course decks with participants.

Content Curation & Digital Governance
  
  

* Manage site governance and user permissions across internal SharePoint / Hub sites and external portals to maintain seamless navigation.
* Lead quarterly site content reviews with page owners to update featured tools, initiatives, and leadership development resources.
* Maintain shared collaborative spaces, preserve learning design artifacts and final versions of learning materials, assessments and results, evaluation feedback and other core deliverables.

What You Will Bring
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in instructional design, content development, and facilitation, with a strong portfolio of learner-centered deliverables.
* 3+ years of experience managing multiple concurrent instructional design and L&D projects in complex organizations.
* Proven technical proficiency in LMS administration (e.g., Workday Learn) and e-learning authoring platforms (e.g., Articulate Rise, Adobe product suite).
* Strong operational proficiency in session scheduling, attendance tracking, Zoom integrations, and data reporting/analytics.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and consulting skills, with a track record of building trust with SMEs, Executive Assistants, and senior executive leaders.
* High degree of agility and execution mindset, with demonstrated ability to consistently meet tight deadlines and adapt to evolving strategic priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Instructional Design, Organizational Development or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience within Finance or tech/e-commerce environments is preferred.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

This engineering organization offers controls, Security & Fire and Energy solution.
  
  
**About Fire & Security Business**
10+ years of wide JCI/Tyco and third-party system knowledge for design, detailed engineering and implementation of Fire Protection and Suppression system. Team provides the services and value-added solutions for the system and provides onsite & remote engineering support across the globe for engineering.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
The primary responsibility for this role is to work on end-to-end presales engineering activities of Fire protection & Suppression opportunities from various verticals (e.g., Transportation, Data Center, Commercial, Industries, Fit-outs, Key Accounts, etc.). You will be handling techno-Commercial activities of the projects covering various such as Fire Sprinkler, Hydrant, water spray, foam and gas suppression Systems etc. You should own the technical consideration to win the job and should be part of HOTO process to get the D&E and OPS approval for booking.
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Review the project inputs and project intake form shared by the Front desk/Sales.
* Analyze the requirement and initiate the Kick-off call with Front Desk after getting CoE SFDC Code and time frame.
* Prepare designs on given floor plans to arrive with the BOQ; in case BOQ is unavailable.
* Identify potential issues/risks and proactively bring them to the customer's knowledge and help to mitigate the identified risks.
* Initiate the discussion with OEMs & subcontractors and get the right solution and proposal from OEMs.
* Analyze the proposal and commercials received from the OEM and verify the same based on the past data and benchmark costing available in the SCM Database.
* Upon completion of cost comparison, prepare the optimized techno-commercial Costing sheet, Proposal, and Compliance Statements.
* Once the deliverables are ready, perform Self QC and get the 2nd level QC done by the Delivery Manager. Eventually, submit the deliverables to the Front Desk.
* Perform 2nd level QC of the deliverables done by other Application Engineers in the team
* Update the SFDC regularly, and complete timesheet & assigned training on time.
* Actively negotiate and follow up with OEMs and Internal OPS/ Post Sales team to get the right kind of prices for the project.
* Regularly participate in the Daily Call /Cadence Call with the business team.
* Actively derive the strategy for increasing the win rate.
* Align with Organization KPIs such as Quality, Cycle Time, OTD, Win rate, Productivity, etc.

**What We Look For**

* BE (Mechanical / Electrical)
* Must have 6+ years of relevant experience in Fire Protection & Suppression Systems domains.
* Strong knowledge of Fire Protection & Suppression Systems (Fire Sprinkler, Pre-action system, Water spray, standpipe & hose system, Hydrant network, Fire water storage, Stationary pumps, Foam suppression, water mist system, Kitchen hood system, Gas Suppression – FM, Novec, Inergen & Co2 etc.).
* Knowledge in Building Management System will be added advantage for the role.
* Must have presales and estimation experience on various verticals (Transportation, Commercial, Fit-outs, Industries, Data Centers, etc.).
* Capable of performing hydraulic and flow calculation and doing product selections along with the deviation/compliance statements.
* Must be able to work on complex costing sheets covering Material, Engineering, Operations, and Subcon costs.
* Skill in articulating offered solutions in a structured way through high-standard technical proposal documents.
* Must build a strong network with the 3rd party vendors regionally specific.
* Must be a quick learner & keen on problem-solving techniques.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Must be a good team player.

**Preferred**

* Experienced in designing Fire Protection & Suppression systems (fire hydrant, sprinkler, HVWS, MVWS, Foam, Water Mist, Gas Suppression) per NFPA, BSEN, Vds, TAC, and NBC norms.
* Proficient in hydraulic and flow calculations using SprinkCAD, Fire-CAD, ANSUL, and HYGOOD.
* Preparing the bill of quantity (BOQ) & material track sheet as per approved / shop drawings and material technical data sheet.
* Coordination with consultants / clients for contractual clarifications and to get the approval of design.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, Sprink CAD, Fire CAD, Navis and Excel.

title: Automation Expert & BA, Agentic Solutions, Relay Product and Tech
description:
**Description**
Relay Product Excellence's mission is to monitor Transaction Integrity for products supporting Identity Verification, Account Support, and Compliance across Carrier and Driver processes. We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented Business Analyst to join the Relay Product Excellence team. In this role, you will support the analysis of complex operational data, help define business requirements, and contribute to continuous improvement across compliance and verification workflows. You'll work closely with stakeholders across operations and product to identify gaps, measure performance, and support automation and process improvement initiatives. Our team monitors Transaction Integrity for products supporting Identity Verification, Account Support, and Compliance across Carrier and Driver processes- partnering with product and technology teams to ensure the integrity and reliability of processes at scale.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Exciting**

* Deliver Agentic AI and Data Driven Automation solutions for a 200+ member team, conducting more than 2MM investigations a year
* Opportunity to collaborate with product/program/operations teams to identify customer pain points and build innovative solutions
* Shape the future of identity verification by developing processes, tools, and leadership talent that reduce waste & abuse while ensuring compliance
* Drive automation and AI initiatives to scale verification capabilities, adapting to emerging business needs and launching automation solutions with measurable impact

You'll work in a fast-paced environment where every day brings new challenges—from evolving regulatory requirements to emerging fraud patterns. If you're a strategic leader who thrives on solving complex problems with data and technology, this role offers an unparalleled opportunity to make your mark on Amazon's transportation future.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve business processes and data methodologies; build automated, scalable solutions for recurring analytical needs
* Extract, analyze, and interpret datasets using SQL, Python, and AI tools to generate actionable insights
* Perform root cause analysis, variance analysis, and pattern identification with guidance from senior analysts
* Apply data transformations and basic statistical techniques to support diagnostic analysis
* Support the design and maintenance of automated reporting systems, dashboards, and KPI visuals to track metrics
* Validate data quality, flag upstream issues, and help maintain data integrity across workflows
* Solve defined business problems using structured analytical approaches; escalate ambiguous or complex issues while proposing initial solutions
* Support comprehensive analysis for business cases, product pilots, and strategic initiatives that contribute to measurable business impact
* Communicate findings clearly to immediate team and stakeholders up to two levels above, translating analytical results into clear formats for technical and non-technical audiences
* Proactively communicate project status, risks, and roadblocks; participate in requirements gathering and help clarify success criteria
* Scope and deliver analytical projects within defined timelines, incorporating best practices and quality checks in all work
* Partner with Product, Tech, Operations, and data engineering teams on assigned workstreams to support process automation and data quality efforts
* Contribute to business requirements reviews, documentation, and team-level process improvements

**About The Team**
Relay Product Excellence's (RPE) mission is to monitor Transaction Integrity for products supporting (a) Identity Verification, (b) Account Support, and (c) Compliance. We do this at a larger scale for Carrier and Driver processes, by collaborating with product teams like Carrier Identity and Continuous Compliance (CICC), Relay Safety and Trust (RST), and Relay Mobile. We supplement these products to help create programs where automation is yet to be launched, or cannot be developed. We are committed to enhancing the experience for carriers, drivers and product partners by adapting to emerging needs of the business, and launching programs that have a measurable impact in reducing waste & abuse, and ensuring compliance.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in Amazon Redshift and other AWS technologies
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with industry standard tools and scripting languages (Python or Perl) for automation
* Experience in AgentCore, QuickAutomate, Selenium and GenAI tools

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience scripting for automation (e.g., Python, Perl, Ruby)
* Experience creating complex SQL queries joining multiple datasets, ETL DW concepts
* Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
* Experience using very large datasets

Flowserve is a global manufacturer of pumps, valves, seals, and aftermarket services, delivering comprehensive flow control solutions that support essential industries such as energy, clean water, and pharmaceuticals. If you're looking for a culture built on ingenuity, innovation, and excellence, Flowserve offers the opportunity to put your experience in motion. title: Consultant - Project Controls
description:
**Job Description**
WSP India is seeking to onboard dynamic and versatile Project management Expert with comprehensive experience across Document Control, Project Control, Scheduling, and Procurement to support our growing portfolio of complex engineering projects in Earth and Environment team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Document Control:**

* Oversee creation, organization, and maintenance of project documentation; ensure accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with WSP’s internal audit and quality assurance procedures.
* Work closely with departments, regional leads, and subject matter experts to gather information, manage document workflows, and ensure timely delivery and distribution of project documents.
* Create, edit, and review technical documents, manuals, reports, and drawings; maintain registers and schedules for incoming/ outgoing information.
* Manage physical and digital document storage systems; upload documents to EDMS; monitor and improve documentation workflows and processes.
* Conduct regular audits, check document quality, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards and project procedures.
* Be in continuous touch with the PM to be on top of any internal or external documentation.

**Project Cost Control:**

* Ensure alignment with client expectations and deadlines while coordinating with billing, finance, and project teams to manage accounts receivable, timesheets, expenses, and invoice-related queries.
* Prepare billing drafts, compile and verify monthly invoices, and ensure accurate manual data entry and mapping to final invoice sheets.
* Manage project setup, budgeting, task assignments, and closeout activities in Oracle Horizon, including maintaining WBS, time transfers, and compliance checks.
* Able to create Opportunity in Oracle based Horizon during proposal/ pre-proposal and update status based on directions from PM.
* Ensure necessary Risk Assessment procedures are followed while creating the opportunity in Horizon as well as help in preparing RMIS document.
* Support financial analysis and reporting by using financial systems [excel based Project Cost (PC) Control/ Financial Analysis Report (FAR) tools] to track project performance metrics, generate monthly accruals, and assess impacts of scope changes and forecast deviations.
* Collaborate with design teams to collect engineering progress data for Earned Value (EV) analysis and maintain accurate tracking of planned value, actual cost, and schedule.
* Act as liaison between GCC India and US teams for project setup, billing, and timesheet coding, while supporting the E&E PMO team in portfolio monitoring.
* Conduct data integrity checks, audits, and maintain project documentation including lessons-learned databases and meeting records.
* Should have extensive knowledge of working with ERP for project creation and maintenance.
* Should be able to create and track change order and identify, quantify and mitigate risk acting as a buddy to the PM.

**Project Scheduling:**

* Create, update, and maintain resource- and cost-loaded project schedules using Microsoft Project (MSP) or Primavera P6, based on stakeholder input, proposals, and scope documents.
* Develop activity lists, identify critical paths, and notify teams of key activities and schedule risks.
* Monitor project progress, detect deviations, and support recovery planning and schedule forecasting.
* Assess and report impacts of changes to baseline schedules and milestones, ensuring timely updates and resolution tracking.
* Support bids and proposals by preparing preliminary schedules and timelines.
* Use Earned Value Management (EVM) and financial systems to analyze and report project performance and KPIs.
* Maintain accurate Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and integrate project schedules under an Enterprise Project Structure (EPS).

**Other Responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Draft and prepare supplier and subcontractor contracts in alignment with prime contract requirements, ensuring all necessary terms are accurately flowed down; support the US team in contract finalization and negotiation.
* Track contract performance, manage renewals and extensions, and maintain organized contract documentation and repository.
* Creation and renewal of Work Orders (WOs) and timely vendor invoice updates in Oracle Horizon ERP.
* Collaborate with Project Managers, and Finance to monitor project expenses, resolve contract-related queries, and ensure compliance with internal procurement policies and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate procurement requests from project teams, provide operational support, and assist in internal procurement audits and training.
* Utilize analytics and forecasting tools to support procurement planning, maintain accurate procurement records in Oracle, and contribute to continuous improvement through industry best practices.

**Key Competencies / Skills:**

* Proficient in MS Office Suite, especially Advanced Excel; experience with Oracle ERP (Horizon/NetSuite), Power BI is a plus.
* Skilled in project scheduling tools like Primavera P6, Microsoft Project (MSP), and SmartSheets.
* Familiar with documentation control platforms such as Aconex, Autodesk, ProjectWise.
* Strong understanding of Earned Value Management (EVM) and financial systems related to project control.
* Combined minimum 4 years of experience in project scheduling, cost control, documentation, and procurement.
* Experience supporting procurement functions, including vendor coordination and invoice tracking.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and time management abilities; capable of handling multiple priorities and tight deadlines.
* Skilled in forecasting, reporting, and maintaining accurate project records and WBS structures.
* Strong coordination and problem-solving abilities; able to work independently and in teams. Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and open to new challenges.
* Adopts a “Best for WSP” approach in daily activities.
* Flexible with work timings to support US-based project teams across time zones.

**Qualifications**

* Engineering degree with project management experience or master’s degree in construction management or project management is preferred.
* Minimum of 4 to Maximum 8 years of experience project management with Engineering / professional services consultants.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* CAPM-PMI / PMP certifications would be an added advantage.

BGV:
  
  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.

title: Patent Writer / Scientific Writer (AI Drug Discovery)
description:
**Job Description:**
Patent & Scientific Writer

**Job Title:**
Patent & Grant Writer / Scientific Writer (AI Drug Discovery)

**Company:**
Peptris Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
C-CAMP, NCBS-TIFR Campus, GKVK, Bangalore, India

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Department:**
Intellectual Property & Strategy / Legal

**About Peptris Technologies**

We are an AI-powered pre-clinical drug discovery company revolutionizing how new medicines are discovered. Our proprietary machine learning platform rapidly screens ultra-large virtual chemical libraries to generate diverse, patentable, and synthesizable molecules.

We focus on Novel Chemical Entities (NCEs), repurposing approved drugs, and rescuing clinical candidates across Oncology, Inflammation, Infectious Diseases, Women’s Health and Rare Diseases. Operating as computational company, we rely on CROs and partner networks for all wet-lab execution. We are looking for a sharp, scientifically grounded professional to protect the cutting-edge assets generated by our AI engines and scientists.

**The Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled Patent & Grant Writer to bridge the gap between our computational algorithms, medicinal chemistry strategy, Pharmacology strategy, global IP protection, and research funding. Stationed at our innovation hub in C-CAMP, Bangalore, you will play a pivotal role in capturing the novel hits generated by our AI platform and translating our scientific vision into compelling patent applications and funding proposals.

Working directly alongside our founding scientists, data science team, and external counsel, you will translate complex AI-driven chemical discoveries into robust patent applications and highly competitive grant submissions. Please note:
**You do not need to be a registered patent attorney or patent agent for this role**
. Our priority is your deep scientific understanding, exceptional writing skills, and ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Intellectual Property:***

* *Patent Drafting:*
  Draft high-quality provisional, non-provisional, and PCT patent specifications covering novel chemical entities, pharmaceutical compositions, and methods of use.
* *IP Harvesting:*
  Conduct regular IP harvesting sessions with the AI/ML, Pharmacology and medicinal chemistry teams. Extract key predictive data, identify patentable AI-designed scaffolds, broaden SAR coverage and define broad yet defensible Markush structures.
* *Prior Art & FTO Analysis:*
  Perform comprehensive literature and patent database searches to assess patentability, freedom-to-operate (FTO), and competitor landscapes.
* *Data Translation:*
  Synthesize complex pharmacological, chemical, and computational data into clear, technically sound documents to support external counsel in global prosecution.

***Grant Writing & Scientific Strategy:***

* *Grant Identification:*
  Actively scout and identify relevant non-dilutive funding opportunities from national and international agencies
* *Proposal Development:*
  Lead the end-to-end drafting, editing, and submission of highly competitive scientific grant proposals, ensuring strict alignment with agency guidelines and Peptris’s strategic goals.
* *Cross-functional Collaboration*
  : Work closely with the executive, R&D, and finance teams to gather necessary technical data, project timelines, and budget requirements for proposals.
* *Technical Reporting:*
  Assist in drafting scientific progress reports, white papers, and regulatory technical documents for awarded grants and key stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

***Educational Background:***
Ph.D. or Master’s degree (M.Pharm/M.S./M.Sc.) in Medicinal Chemistry, Pharmacology, or a closely related field.

***Writing Experience:***
2–5 years of proven experience in scientific writing, encompassing patent specification drafting and/or successful grant proposal writing within a pharma/biotech company, tech transfer office, or research institution.

***Technical Expertise:***
Deep understanding of the Patent Writing with respect to drug discovery lifecycle, chemical structures, Markush claim drafting, and structure-activity relationships (SAR) and/or biological mechanisms descriptive writing.

***Bonus Skills:***
Familiarity with computational chemistry, AI/ML in drug discovery, or software-assisted methodologies is a massive plus.

***Search Capabilities:***
Proficiency in using patent and scientific databases

**What We Offer**

***Competitive Compensation:***
Salary commensurate with experience

***Innovation Ecosystem:***
Incubated at C-CAMP (Center for Cellular and Molecular Platforms) at the NCBS-TIFR Campus, placing you at the heart of Bangalore's premier biotech ecosystem.

***Pioneering Work:***
The opportunity to shape the intellectual property and funding strategy for one of India's most promising AI-drug discovery startups.

***Impact:***
A collaborative culture where your IP - Patent and grant work directly supports research and out-licensing deals that bring life-saving medicines to patients worldwide.

title: Technical Writer - Product & UX
description:
We’re looking for a Technical Writer on a contract basis who can help user and make a complex technical product easier to understand and use.

This isn’t purely a documentation role. A big part of the work will be within the product itself—working with designers and product designers on UX copy, terminology, workflows, and helping user explain technical concepts without making them sound unnecessarily technical.

**What you’ll work on**

You’ll work closely with our Product, Design, and Engineering teams on things like:

* Writing and refining UX microcopy — labels, buttons, tooltips, empty states, errors, warnings, confirmations, onboarding messages, and other in-product content.
* Creating product documentation for new and existing features.
* Turning complex workflows and technical concepts into documentation that users can actually understand and follow.
* Working with designers on prototypes and reviewing screens from a content and usability perspective.
* Creating user guides, feature guides, FAQs, troubleshooting documentation, and release-related content.
* Talking to engineers and subject-matter experts to understand how something actually works before documenting it.
* Helping us establish consistent terminology across the product and documentation.
* Building lightweight writing guidelines so we’re consistent about things like tone, capitalization, terminology, error messages, and common UX patterns.
* Reviewing existing product copy and documentation and improving areas that are unclear, inconsistent, or overly technical.

**What we’re looking for**

1. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable getting into the details of a technical product but knows when those details matter to the user and when they don’t.
2. You should have experience with technical or product writing and ideally have worked on B2B, SaaS, enterprise, cybersecurity, infrastructure, developer tools, or similarly technical products.
3. Experience working directly with Product and UX teams is important. You should be comfortable looking at a Figma screen and discussing not just grammar, but whether the language actually helps the user understand what’s happening and what they need to do next.
4. Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who can take something complicated and make it clear, concise, and useful without losing its technical meaning.
5. This is a contract role, and the exact scope will evolve with the product. Some weeks may involve more UX writing, while others may involve deeper product documentation. We’re looking for someone comfortable moving between both.

title: Technical Implementation Consultant
description:
**Strength in Trust**
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
  
  
**The Challenge**
Due to rapid growth and an increased demand for our platform, OneTrust is seeking a Technical Implementation Consultant. The Technical Implementation Consultant role is one of the key pieces of the OneTrust architecture. After the sales process, consultants are the key contact in driving and building the relationship, implementing the solution, and managing the expectations of the customer. Technical Implementation consultants work across the technical modules. As a Technical Implementation Consultant, you will be responsible for the customer relationship and will work directly with our customers to . The role is one of the most important as it is the bridge between OneTrust and the customer, helping the business grow by identifying product enhancements and relaying them between the customer and OneTrust Product teams.
  
  
**Our Team**
The Content Customization team is unique team with incredible talent. This team combines a fine-tuned project management discipline alongside superb technical acumen sprinkled with stunning design chops. Not only that, but we build on top of 2 world-class, customer-friendly CMS and LMS platforms. Furthermore, we operate like a boutique agency inside the OneTrust Ethics Professional Services Team.
  
  
**Your Mission**
**As a Technical Implementation Consultant, You Will**
Oversee the technical implementation and platform adoption for customer projects from start to finish.
  
  
Provide creative insight and execution for customers while implementing web-based portals and pages based on customer assets and brand guidelines on our CMS tool.
  
  
Provide creative insight and execution for customers while implementing branding and creating custom courses with customer assets and brand guidelines on our learning authoring tool.
  
  
Use your experience across a broad range of front-end technologies including HTML and CSS.
  
  
Use your design experience using wireframing tools like Figma and storyboarding in tools like Fig-jam.
  
  
Use or deepen your experience with the Adobe suite of products to create assets to use in creative projects.
  
  
Use or deepen your knowledge of Instructional Design.
  
  
Use or deepen your experience with web accessibility standards (ADA &WCAG).
  
  
Work closely with UI/UX design, marketing, product management and engineering on project goals and requirements.
  
  
Prioritize and drive resolution on escalated customer issues.
  
  
Complete internal and project documentation.
  
  
Seek opportunities in day-to-day workflow to improve quality and efficiency from ideation to deployment.
  
  
Document processes and workflows in shareable documents for future use and adoption.
  
  
Document project progress in our CRM tool (Salesforce)
  
  
Be an advocate for our customers by representing their issues to Product Management and Software Engineering with a focus on steering the OneTrust roadmap.
  
  
Monitor and analyse the customer’s adoption of our solution features and functionality to provide leadership with an understanding of their overall business needs as they relate to our products.
  
  
Provide strategic and tactical support for Sales, Professional Services, and Business Development
  
  
You will also act as system and regulatory best practice expert, drawing from a plethora of consulting experience to advise customers on optimization of privacy & ethics program(s). Act as the customer advocate. Seamlessly transition ownership and action plan back to involved teams. Show ownership of issues, engage customers, establish urgent priorities, and implement resolution plan. Able to resolve simple to moderate issues with minimal management intervention. Ability to interpret and deliver on custom SOW customer projects.
  
  
**Your Experience Includes**
BA/BS OR MS in Computer Science, Web Design/Development [Bootcamp friendly], Engineering Management or Information Technology/Systems
  
  
2 – 5 years of relevant experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, design, technical consulting; with expertise in architecting, supporting and/or rolling out new technology and solution initiatives.
  
  
Experience working with front-end technologies and design frameworks.
  
  
Effective customer-facing relationship building skills. Proven success in and genuine enthusiasm for working directly with customer(s).
  
  
Proven ability to engage across corporate functions (Professional Services, Support and Product Management).
  
  
Previous end-to-end implementation experience, ideally on a SAAS platform/product or creative agency.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to chair meetings or host trainings.
  
  
An understanding of the following tech/tools: HTML, CSS, Figma (or any wireframing tool), Acquia (or any CMS), Gomo (or any learning authoring tool), Salesforce, Jira – a plus, SSO, Domain Management.
  
  
Ability to build relationships across stakeholders in marketing, product, sales, and engineering.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft suite of products.
  
  
**Extra Awesome**
Knowledge of HTTP, SSO, SCORM packages, domain management.
  
  
Knowledge of Learning Management Systems.
  
  
Functional experience in the field (Privacy, Ethics or GRC)
  
  
Industry Certifications (CIPP/E, CIPM, GRCP, CPA, CISA, LPEC, etc.)
  
  
Experience dealing with senior management (C-Level) across multiple customers.
  
  
Language skills (German, French, Spanish, or Italian)
  
  
Where we Work
  
  
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
  
  
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
  
  
**Benefits**
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
  
  
Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

Your Data

**.**

**Our Commitment to You**

title: Requirements Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

**Overview**

The Requirements Engineer will lead requirements engineering for complex rail and nuclear projects, ensuring stakeholder, system, functional, interface, safety, cybersecurity, operational and assurance requirements are clear, verifiable, controlled and fully traceable. The role requires strong systems engineering capability, mandatory MBSE experience, and practical understanding of system architecture, interfaces, operational scenarios, integration constraints and verification needs. This is not a requirements database administration role; the candidate must be able to technically challenge, interpret and validate requirements with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

**Your role**

* Lead requirements elicitation, analysis, validation, baseline control, change impact assessment and traceability from stakeholder needs through design, implementation, integration, testing, commissioning, handover and acceptance.
* Develop and maintain stakeholder, system, subsystem, functional, non-functional, safety, security, operational, maintainability, interface and assurance requirements.
* Apply MBSE and systems engineering methods to connect requirements with architecture models, operational scenarios, interface definitions, verification evidence and system integration risks.
* Support interface management and ICD development for internal and external rail/nuclear systems, including functional, physical, operational, data, safety and cybersecurity interfaces.
* Perform requirements quality reviews to identify ambiguity, gaps, conflicts, duplication, missing verification methods, unclear ownership, assumptions, constraints and cross-discipline dependencies.
* Prepare requirements management plans, traceability matrices, compliance matrices, interface registers, verification cross-reference matrices, assurance review packs and requirements status reports.
* Support V&V planning, test specifications, design reviews, hazard reviews, assurance gates, readiness reviews, commissioning reviews and requirements close-out.
* Work closely with systems engineering, signalling, telecoms, I&C/control systems, electrical, mechanical, civil, RAMS, cybersecurity, quality, commissioning, operations and assurance teams.

*Rail and Nuclear Sector Knowledge*

*Rail:*

* Understanding of rail systems engineering, integration, staged commissioning, brownfield interfaces, operational readiness, depots, stations, control centres, signalling, train control, telecoms, passenger/emergency communication, CCTV, access control and integrated control systems.

*Nuclear:*

* Understanding of nuclear safety culture, graded approach, defence-in-depth, quality assurance, configuration control, evidence-based assurance, safety-classified systems, I&C, physical security and emergency preparedness interfaces.
* Working knowledge of relevant standards and assurance practices such as ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288, INCOSE guidance, EN 50126/50128/50129, IEC 62290, EN 50159, CSM-RA, IAEA guidance, ISO 19443, IEC 61513, IEC 60880, IEC 62138, IEC 62645 or equivalent, as applicable.

**About you**

* Mandatory Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) experience, including SysML-based modelling, architecture modelling, interface modelling, requirements allocation and model-to-requirements traceability using Cameo, Enterprise Architect, Capella, Rhapsody or equivalent.
* Strong systems technical understanding across rail and/or nuclear systems, including system architecture, functions, subsystems, operating modes, interfaces, data flows, integration constraints, safety requirements, cybersecurity requirements and V&V needs.
* Proven ability to derive, decompose, allocate, validate and control requirements from standards, operating concepts, hazards, interface definitions, ICDs, design outputs, verification methods and assurance gates.
* Experience using requirements tools such as IBM DOORS, DOORS Next, Polarion, Jama, ReqIF or equivalent, with the ability to use the tool as part of a wider systems engineering and assurance process, not only for database maintenance.
* Experience working in safety-critical or regulated environments, preferably rail, metro, nuclear facilities, control systems, signalling, telecoms, I&C, safety systems or infrastructure projects.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communications Engineering, Control Systems, Nuclear Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
* Typically 7+ years’ experience in requirements engineering, systems engineering, assurance or technical delivery within regulated rail, nuclear or safety-critical infrastructure projects.
* Strong technical writing, stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, requirements review, compliance assessment and multidisciplinary coordination skills.
* Preferred: INCOSE ASEP/CSEP/ESEP or equivalent systems engineering certification; experience with RAMS, safety case support, cybersecurity engineering, human factors, operability and maintainability.

**About AtkinsRéalis**

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

title: Forward Deployed Implementation, Senior Analyst (BLR)
description:
Alchelyst is a client solutions and infrastructure partner for private markets asset managers. Purpose-built for the expanding demands and sophistication of global private markets, the firm offers a comprehensive managed service offering that can support GPs, private wealth funds and investors. Alchelyst has offices in the US, Ireland, UK, Luxembourg and India.
  
  
**Role**
AURUM, Alchelyst’s proprietary technology platform, is designed to automate fund administration processes at scale. Its core features work out of the box, and the platform is flexible enough to adapt to each client’s needs. The Forward Deployed Implementation team makes sure AURUM works for every client, from day one and every day after. The role has two parts:
  
  

* Implementation: Onboarding new clients onto AURUM. This means understanding their fund structures, reporting needs, and operating model, then working with operations and technology teams to configure the platform so clients go live smoothly.
* Adoption and tactical solutions: Extending AURUM to client-specific, complex and exception-driven cases. The team sits alongside operations teams to understand these cases and works with the technology team to deliver tailored solutions quickly, so that AURUM becomes part of how operations works every day.

We are seeking a techno-functional professional with 3-5 years of experience in fund administration, either as a fund accountant or as a business analyst on fund accounting systems.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines a solid understanding of private markets fund accounting with a strong interest in technology. They’ll support new client implementations and work with operations teams, under the guidance of senior team members, to identify, document and deliver tactical solutions on AURUM.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Client Implementation****

* Support the onboarding of new clients onto AURUM across requirements gathering, configuration, testing and go-live.
* Work with clients, operations and technology teams to document fund structures, reporting needs and operating models, and help translate them into platform setup.
* Support data migration, validation and parallel runs, including data preparation, reconciliations and tracking of open items through to closure.
* Act as a day-to-day contact on assigned onboarding tasks, tracking progress against the plan and flagging risks early to senior team members.

****Operations Engagement & Adoption****

* Work closely with fund accounting, investor services and reporting teams to understand current workflows, document manual workarounds and note where standard AURUM features do not fully meet the need.
* Support Operations leads and senior team members on AURUM adoption, helping users understand how the platform can support their day-to-day processes.
* Track adoption across assigned teams and processes, and flag barriers to adoption with supporting data and suggested next steps.

****Use Case Analysis & Solution Support****

* Analyze assigned client-specific and non-standard use cases, including bespoke fund structures, waterfall and allocation logic, non-standard investor reporting and exception handling.
* Help assess whether each use case is best addressed through configuration, a tactical build, a workflow change or a roadmap item for the core product, and present options to senior team members.
* Write clear business requirements, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria for assigned use cases, with review from senior team members.
* Contribute to solution design discussions with the technology team, helping weigh speed of delivery against scalability, control and maintainability.

****Delivery & Testing****

* Maintain the tactical backlog for assigned operations areas, keeping status, priority and effort information up to date for review.
* Work in short delivery cycles with developers, product owners and QA, managing timelines on assigned items without prompting.
* Support user acceptance testing with operations, including writing test scenarios, preparing test data, running parallel tests and tracking defects to resolution.
* Support go-live activities including cutover, training sessions, user guides and hypercare support.

****Product Feedback & Standardization****

* Flag recurring patterns across tactical requests and suggest candidates for generalization into core AURUM features.
* Capture and share feedback with the product team on usability, feature gaps and operational pain points.
* Contribute to the library of reusable solutions, configurations and playbooks, keeping documentation current.

****Governance****

* Prepare updates on delivery progress, adoption metrics and benefits realized (hours saved, errors reduced) for senior team members.
* Follow internal control, audit and data governance requirements, maintaining appropriate documentation and supporting change management.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. CA, CPA, ACCA, CFA (any level) or an MBA in Finance would be an advantage.
* 3-5 years of experience in fund administration or private markets, as a fund accountant, business analyst, or in a techno-functional role on fund accounting systems.
* Good working knowledge of private markets fund accounting, including capital calls, distributions, management fees, carried interest and waterfalls, NAV calculations, investor allocations, and financial and investor reporting.
* Exposure to gathering requirements from operations users and documenting them as functional specifications or user stories.
* Experience working on or supporting fund accounting platforms such as Investran, Geneva, eFront, Allvue, LemonEdge, FIS, or similar.
* Basic working knowledge of SQL for data analysis and validation.
* Experience participating in UAT or system go-lives in an operational environment.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet timelines and escalate issues with context and a proposed resolution.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with both operations users and engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure or Fund of Funds administration.
* Exposure to Agile delivery and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Exposure to workflow automation, low-code platforms, or scripting (e.g., Python, Power Automate).
* Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience with data integrations, file-based imports and exports, or APIs between fund accounting and third-party systems.
* Exposure to change management, transformation or process improvement projects.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 1–3 Months: Build a working understanding of AURUM, the client implementation process and existing operational workflows, and begin documenting non-standard use cases and manual workarounds outside AURUM for review with senior team members.
* Within 4–9 Months: Deliver assigned items within agreed timelines, write requirements that need minimal rework, and support solutions through UAT with minimal defects. Contribute to increased AURUM adoption and reduced reliance on manual workarounds in assigned areas. Support new client implementations through to go-live.
* Within 9–12 Months: Work with greater independence on assigned workstreams, track the impact of delivered solutions (hours saved, errors reduced, turnaround times), and flag recurring requests that could become core AURUM features.
* Ongoing: Continue to identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and AURUM adoption. Support the onboarding of new Analysts by sharing knowledge and modelling process discipline.

description:
**About Bureau**
Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
  
  
Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
  
  
**Why Bureau?**
Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
  
  
We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Foundation & Data Quality: You will own the data sourcing engine for our OCR models. This includes sourcing new document types, ensuring decent volume for each type, and tagging data to create high-quality training sets.
* Performance Benchmarking: Systematically evaluate our 120+ API services against internal standards and external competitors. You will identify latency issues, success rate drops, and coverage gaps to ensure we stay best-in-class.
* Data-Driven Strategy: Analyze transaction data to uncover opportunities for product optimization. You will answer questions like: "Why did this verification fail?" and "How can we improve conversion rates for this specific segment?"
* Impact Reporting: Translate raw data into actionable insights. You will utilize SQL and data visualization to recommend specific upgrades to our tech stack to the Engineering and Product teams.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Education: Final year student or recent graduate in Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a business-related field with a heavy analytical focus.
* Skills:
* Data Fluency: You are comfortable with SQL and handling large datasets. You can query data and find the story inside the numbers.
* Technical Aptitude: You don't need to be a software engineer, but you must be comfortable understanding how APIs work and how data flows through a system.
* Mindset: You are a go-getter. You don't wait for permission to fix a data error; you identify it, report it, and propose a solution.

**Our Culture**

* We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

**Compensation**

* Competitive salary + potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

title: Senior Associate, Corporate Technology
description:
**Job Description**
**About BetaNXT**
BetaNXT is a leading provider of frictionless wealth management infrastructure, real-time data solutions, and enhanced advisor experience. We invest in platforms, products, and partnerships to accelerate growth for the ecosystem we serve. Our connective approach empowers our clients to deliver comprehensive, end-to-end advisor and investor experience.
  
  
BetaNXT is a premier provider of technology, data, and operations as services to a rich client base of wealth managers, institutional wealth firms, and digital brokers. It is comprised of three industry-leading businesses which, combined, provide end-to-end solutions across the investment lifecycle.
  
  
**Overview Of The Enterprise Tools Support Engineer**
The Enterprise IT Tools Support Engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliability, usability, and operational effectiveness of enterprise technology platforms and business-critical IT tools across the organization. This role provides technical support, system administration, user enablement, and application configuration services to ensure seamless business operations and high-quality user experience.
  
  
The role operates at the intersection of IT Operations, Enterprise Applications, User Support, and Business Process Enablement, delivering timely issue resolution, user access management, system customization, and data administration. The individual plays a hands-on role in troubleshooting complex issues, supporting application enhancements and releases, facilitating data integration, and driving continuous improvement through stakeholder engagement, training, and process optimization.
  
  
**Enterprise Tools Support Engineer**
**Responsibilities**

* Provide first and second-level support to enterprise users for software applications via phone, email, and chat.
* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve software issues in a timely and efficient manner.
* Document and track all support requests, resolutions, and follow-up actions in ServiceNow.
* Collaborate with the development team to escalate and resolve complex issues.
* Conduct user training sessions and create documentation to help users understand and effectively use Enterprise software.
* Assist in the testing of new software releases and updates to identify potential issues.
* Provide feedback to the development team on user experience and suggest improvements.
* Configuring/customizing commercial applications to meet business needs
* Support user account maintenance in software applications
* Facilitating Export or Import of data across multiple application platforms
* Create and enhance Power BI reports and dashboards using appropriate charts, visual layouts, filters, and drill-down capabilities to present business and operational data clearly.
* Full Understanding of business workflows and processes
* Developing good working relationships with users across the organization

**Skills & Experience Of The Enterprise Tools Support Engineer**

* 3+ years of experience supporting enterprise IT tools, business applications, in a corporate environment
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent practical experience
* Proven experience in a technical support role, preferably in software application support.
* Strong knowledge of software troubleshooting techniques and tools.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote support tools.
* Working knowledge of Power BI data visualisation, including dashboard design, chart selection, data storytelling, interactive reports, and translating business requirements into meaningful visual insights.
* On-Call coverage may be required.

**Preferred Software/Tool Experience**

* CRM/CSM/ITSM/CMDB: ServiceNow, Salesforce
* PDLC/SDLC: JIRA, Confluence, Kiplot, Gitlab Ultimate, Testrail.
* Enterprise tools: PowerBI, M365 suite
* Knowledge of SQL, scripting languages, or other programming languages is a plus.
* Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms is desirable.

title: Forward Deployed Implementation, Associate (BLR)
description:
Alchelyst is a client solutions and infrastructure partner for private markets asset managers. Purpose-built for the expanding demands and sophistication of global private markets, the firm offers a comprehensive managed service offering that can support GPs, private wealth funds and investors. Alchelyst has offices in the US, Ireland, UK, Luxembourg and India.
  
  
**Role**
AURUM, Alchelyst’s proprietary technology platform, is designed to automate fund administration processes at scale. Its core features work out of the box, and the platform is flexible enough to adapt to each client’s needs. The Forward Deployed Implementation team makes sure AURUM works for every client, from day one and every day after. The role has two parts:
  
  

* Implementation: Onboarding new clients onto AURUM. This means understanding their fund structures, reporting needs, and operating model, then working with operations and technology teams to configure the platform so clients go live smoothly.
* Adoption and tactical solutions: Extending AURUM to client-specific, complex and exception-driven cases. The team sits alongside operations teams to understand these cases and works with the technology team to deliver tailored solutions quickly, so that AURUM becomes part of how operations works every day.

We are seeking an experienced techno-functional professional with 5-10 years of experience in fund administration, either as a fund accountant or as a business analyst on fund accounting systems.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of private markets fund accounting with a strong grasp of technology. They’ll support new client implementations and lead engagements with operations teams to identify, define, prioritize and deliver tactical solutions on AURUM.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Client Implementation****

* Support the onboarding of new clients onto AURUM, from requirements gathering through configuration, testing and go-live.
* Work with clients, operations and technology teams to understand fund structures, reporting needs, and operating models, and translate them into platform setup.
* Coordinate data migration, validation, and parallel runs so clients transition onto AURUM with confidence.
* Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for new clients during onboarding, keeping implementations on track and raising risks early.

****Operations Engagement & Adoption****

* Work closely with fund accounting, investor services and reporting teams to observe current workflows, identify manual workarounds and understand where standard AURUM features do not fully meet the need.
* Work with Operations leads to drive adoption of AURUM, helping teams understand how the platform can support their day-to-day processes
* Track adoption across teams and processes, and escalate barriers to adoption with clear, actionable recommendations.

****Use Case Analysis & Solution Design****

* Analyze client-specific and non-standard use cases, including bespoke fund structures, waterfall and allocation logic, non-standard investor reporting and exception handling.
* Determine whether each use case is best addressed through configuration, a tactical build, a workflow change or a roadmap item for the core product.
* Write clear business requirements, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria that enable the technology team to build robust solutions
* Design solution approaches with the technology team, balancing speed of delivery with scalability, control and maintainability.

****Delivery & Prioritization****

* Own and prioritize the tactical backlog for assigned operations areas based on business impact, risk, effort and client commitments.
* Work in short delivery cycles with developers, product owners and QA to move solutions from requirement to production quickly.
* Lead user acceptance testing with operations, including test scenario design, data preparation, parallel runs and sign-off.
* Support go live activities including cutover, training, user guides and hypercare support.

****Product Feedback & Standardization****

* Identify recurring patterns across tactical requests and recommend which should be generalized into core AURUM features.
* Provide structured feedback to the product team on usability, feature gaps and operational pain points.
* Maintain a library of reusable solutions, configurations and playbooks to speed up future delivery.

****Governance****

* Report on delivery progress, adoption metrics and benefits realized (hours saved, errors reduced) to senior stakeholders.
* Ensure solutions meet internal control, audit and data governance requirements, with appropriate documentation and change management.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. CA, CPA, ACCA, CFA (any level) or an MBA in Finance would be an advantage.
* 5-10 years of experience in fund administration or private markets, as a fund accountant, business analyst, or in a techno-functional role on fund accounting systems.
* Strong understanding of private markets fund accounting, including capital calls, distributions, management fees, carried interest and waterfalls, NAV calculations, investor allocations, and financial and investor reporting.
* Experience gathering requirements from operations users and translating them into functional specifications and user stories for technology teams.
* Hands-on experience implementing, configuring or supporting fund accounting platforms such as Investran, Geneva, eFront, Allvue, LemonEdge, FIS, or similar.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation and troubleshooting.
* Experience leading UAT and supporting system go-lives in an operational environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and scope.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to work with both senior operations staff and engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure or Fund of Funds administration.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams and with tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Exposure to workflow automation, low-code platforms, or scripting (e.g., Python, Power Automate).
* Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience with data integrations, file-based imports and exports, or APIs between fund accounting and third-party systems.
* Prior experience in a change management, transformation or process re-engineering role.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 1–3 Months: Develop a strong understanding of AURUM, the client implementation process, and existing operational workflows, identify non-standard use cases and manual workarounds outside AURUM, and establish priorities for improvements in collaboration with operations and technology teams.
* Within 4–9 Months: Deliver prioritized solutions within agreed timelines, translate operational needs into clear requirements that minimize rework, and ensure solutions progress through UAT with minimal defects. Demonstrate increased AURUM adoption and reduced reliance on manual workarounds outside AURUM. Support new client implementations through to a smooth go-live.
* Within 9–12 Months: Track and report the impact of delivered solutions, including hours saved, errors reduced and improved turnaround times. Identify recurring tactical solutions and work with the product team to incorporate them into core AURUM features.
* Ongoing: Continuously identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, strengthen AURUM adoption and enhance workflows. Where applicable, support junior team members in developing the skills and confidence to work independently through guidance and review.

title: Business Analysis Intern
description:
**About Thoughtworks & The Strategic Beach Management Portfolio**
Thoughtworks is a leading global technology consultancy that integrates strategy, design, and software engineering to drive digital innovation.
  
  
In professional services and IT consulting firms like Thoughtworks, the "beach" (or "bench") refers to the pool of talented consultants who are temporarily unassigned between billable client engagements. Effectively managing this unassigned talent capacity is critical to maintaining operational efficiency, preserving profitability, and reducing unassigned time. Rather than treating this period as idle time, proactive beach management transforms transient capacity into a strategic asset and ensures consultants remain deployable and ready to meet rapid commercial demand.
  
  
The Strategic Beach Management (SBM) portfolio transforms unassigned consulting capacity across India into high-impact, reusable software assets—including strategic big bets, internal investments, open-source contributions, and client sales Proofs of Concept (POCs)—while accelerating consultant deployability.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an proactive, energetic, analytical, and process-driven Operations / Business Analyst Intern (Management Trainee) to serve as the go-to person for day-to-day operations behind the Beach Operating System (BeachOS). The intern should be comfortable bringing actionable insights and outcomes in ambiguous situations. In this role, you will work directly with the Thoughtworks’ key stakeholders in staffing, people, operations and engineering delivery teams with guidance from the Strategic Beach Manager to manage and track daily consultant onboarding, monitor pod progress, analyze consultant journey workflows, and iteratively automate operational tracking systems for internal strategic Thoughtworks initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**BeachOS Cadence & Operations Management**

* Manage the daily operational cadence of the BeachOS, including onboarding unassigned consultants into active beach pods and Big Bet initiatives.
* Ensure timely feedback check-ins, consultant availability management, skill metrics documentation, and pod rotation timelines.
* Serve as a primary operational link between Beach Consultants, Staffing Partners, People team and Strategic Beach Manager

**Value Stream Analysis & Workflow Optimization**

* Map and analyze the end-to-end consultant journey from project roll-offs to upskilling, matchmaking, and billable placement.
* Identify operational friction points, for eg: missing Workday roll-off feedback and suggest possible ways to address them.
* Help design and implement standardized operational templates, checklists, and decision flowcharts.

**Data Analytics & Metrics Dashboarding**

* Track core SBM key performance indicators: Average Time on Beach, Upskilling Success & Deployability Rates, and Beach Capacity Flow across Big Bets.
* Assist in transitioning manual tracking spreadsheets into real-time operational dashboards if required and suggest them to SBM and other stakeholders

**Candidate Profile & Key Qualifications**

* Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA / PGDM in Business Management, Business Analytics, Systems from a reputed institute.
* Analytical & Process Mindset: Strong proficiency in process mapping, workflow optimization, and structured problem-solving..
* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the confidence to interact with technology leads, staffing team, people team and consultants.
* Proactive Ownership: High degree of organization, empathy, self-direction, and ability to manage multiple operational cadences independently.

**What You Will Gain**

* Direct exposure to strategic workforce planning, executive reporting, and internal governance at a tier-1 global tech consultancy.
* Hands-on experience designing, operating, and automating an enterprise-grade org process (BeachOS).
* Mentorship from Strategic Beach Management leadership and exposure to AI/LLM initiatives, open-source ecosystems, and delivery/process innovation.

See here our AI policy.

title: Engineering Change (EC) Engineer - Mechanical
description:

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Location:
  
  
Bangalore,IND
  
  
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
  
  
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
As a Manufacturing Engineer, you are responsible for developing and maintaining methods, operating sequences, and processes in the fabrication of parts, components, subassemblies, and final assemblies. You'll work closely with other engineering functions to coordinate the release of product improvements and new products, and you'll use engineering principles to estimate and reduce manufacturing costs, improve product quality, determine time standards, and make recommendations for tooling and process requirements. Your expertise in lean principles, automation, and continuous improvement will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and achieving higher levels of productivity and cost-effectiveness. You'll develop and use test procedures, evaluate test results, and assess work methods, procedures, and policies to identify root cause issues and solutions that ensure operational success.
  
  
**Shift Timing – 02:00 PM to 11:00 PM**
**General Profile:**
Requires specialized in Packaging solution. Interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. Solves problems; takes a broad perspective to identify innovative solutions. Works independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations.
  
  
**Job Description:**
EC Engineer is responsible for the development and management of the Engineering Change Order process for assigned groups and/or product families or lines from documentation of initial problem statement through implementation and execution of the engineering change. Mediates problems across division lines to remove barriers preventing effective implementation of engineering changes. Ensures rapid and efficient processing of ECOs, resulting in cost-effective change implementation.

* Prioritizes Review of ECOs and expedites release of ECO, in the implementation cycle.
* Review ECO's for content completeness, Structure of Bill of Material, customer impact (internal and external), organizational impact, and functional product impact

* Trains / coaches ECO participants in their functional areas; advises ECO participants on possible solutions for ECO related problems, issues or situations; routinely mediates conflicts between ECO participants. Evaluates ECO process for continuous improvement opportunities; assists in KPI development and document the process.

**Regularly participates in ECO PM’s meetings.**

* Participates in projects; may lead a ECO CIB project.
* Reviewing ECOs and recommending material related changes through the Change Control Board, identifying ECO impacted kits and assemblies and updating ECO notification summary comments to reflect current status.

**Knowledge:**

* Knowledge of Engineering Change Order (ECO) processes, forms, instructions, and policies
* Knowledge of ECO roles and responsibilities.
* Knowledge of PDM and BOMs & item master theory.
* Knowledge of supplier manufacturing processes and the ability to engage with suppliers to resolve issues.
* Knowledge of manufacturing methods and materials to include basic lean philosophy and principles.

title: Development Sr Engineer I Sustaining

title: Environmental Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
WSP has an exciting opportunity for an Environmental Consultant to join our large and growing team of environmental professionals in India. The role will be based within the UK Environmental Management and Assessment (EMA) team, which is part of our wider Planning and Consents business.
  
  
The role would suit an enthusiastic individual looking to deliver environmental elements of engineering projects, within a wide range of sectors including transmission & distribution, rail, highways, energy and commercial / residential, from feasibility through to planning, including detailed design and construction.
  
  
You will have responsibility for preparing technical reports, preparing proposals, project delivery, and financial management.
  
  
You will be joining a well-respected and leading global environmental consulting team with a wide range of clients across different markets and sectors including national and local government, industrial, commercial and scientific sectors. You will be integrated into the UK EMA team and will be supported in your professional career development with opportunities for training, mentoring and chartership.

* Preparing and reviewing written input into technical environmental reports

* Author chapters/report for large scale environmental projects including (EIA, SEA, CEMP, etc.)
* Support the career development of more junior colleagues in the India team

* Monitoring of deliverables/projects against scope, budget and programme

Key Competencies / Skills

* Are ambitious and appreciate the responsibilities associated with undertaking work in highly technical subject areas
* Have strong communication skills including fluent written and verbal English with report writing skills, such as experience of Environmental Impact Assessment chapter writing

* Are confident and highly motivated, with good and proactive communication skills and the ability to work independently, as well as part of a team

Desirable Skills

* Knowledge on Environmental Assessment process for on-shore and off-shore wind energy projects and infrastructure projects

title: BPI Project Specialist, Cyber & Data Resilience
description:
