The position will bring structure, visibility, and delivery discipline to cross-functional projects focused on process simplification, standardization, automation, data quality, operating-model improvement, and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Based in Bangalore, this role will report to the Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Leader and/or the overall Cyber BPI Program Manager, subject to the final program structure. The Project Specialist will work closely with workstream leaders, process owners, Cyber operations teams, technology and platform partners, and global delivery stakeholders to maintain plans, manage dependencies, resolve issues, and move initiatives from analysis through implementation and sustainment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Project Planning and Delivery
  
  

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and implementation schedules for assigned BPI initiatives.
* Coordinate day-to-day execution across business, operations, technology, data, and change-management workstreams.
* Track actions, decisions, risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, ensuring owners and due dates are clear.
* Proactively identify delivery gaps or schedule risks and escalate them with practical options and recommendations.
* Drive follow-through on commitments and maintain strong execution discipline across project teams.
* Support initiatives from discovery and design through implementation, stabilization, handoff, and closure.

BPI Program Governance and Reporting
  
  

* Prepare clear, accurate project status reports, dashboards, leadership updates, and decision materials.
* Maintain core project artifacts, including plans, RAID logs, action trackers, decision logs, governance calendars, and benefits trackers.
* Coordinate governance meetings, prepare agendas and materials, document decisions, and monitor resulting actions.
* Ensure project information is current, consistent, and transparent across workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Support portfolio-level reporting by consolidating progress, risks, dependencies, resource needs, and upcoming milestones.

Process Improvement Support
  
  

* Partner with the Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Leader and process owners to support current-state assessments, process mapping, root cause analysis, and future-state design.
* Coordinate workshops, stakeholder interviews, working sessions, pilots, and implementation-readiness activities.
* Help translate improvement recommendations into sequenced workplans, accountable owners, and measurable deliverables.
* Support development and maintenance of SOPs, process documentation, controls, training materials, and handoff plans.
* Monitor adoption and sustainability actions after implementation and surface areas requiring additional intervention.

Benefits, Metrics, and Controls
  
  

* Coordinate the definition and tracking of project KPIs, baselines, targets, and expected benefits.
* Work with initiative owners and finance or data partners to maintain supporting evidence for productivity, quality, cycle-time, capacity, cost, and other operational improvements.
* Monitor performance against agreed measures and flag variance, data-quality concerns, or benefit-realization risks.
* Ensure control plans, ownership, and ongoing reporting requirements are documented before project closure.

Stakeholder and Change Coordination
  
  

* Build productive working relationships across CDR service lines, Cyber operations, IT, platform teams, and global delivery locations.
* Coordinate stakeholder communications, change-impact activities, training, and implementation readiness.
* Adapt communications to the audience, providing concise executive summaries as well as detailed working-level updates.
* Facilitate alignment across teams with different priorities and help drive timely resolution of open decisions.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, and a continuous-improvement mindset throughout project delivery.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Experience in project management, program coordination, business process improvement, operations, transformation, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, deadlines, dependencies, and stakeholder groups.
* Working knowledge of project management practices and tools, including planning, status reporting, RAID management, governance, and change control.
* Experience supporting process improvement, operating-model, automation, or technology-enabled transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, and Project or comparable planning tools.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Platform, workflow tools, or process-mapping applications is advantageous.
* Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Belt certification is advantageous; willingness to build Lean Six Sigma capability is expected.
* Experience working with global, cross-functional, or GCC delivery teams is advantageous.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear leadership-ready materials.
* Bachelor's degree in business, operations, technology, engineering, project management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Success Profile
  
  

* Highly organized executor who creates clarity, structure, and momentum in complex initiatives.
* Proactive problem solver who anticipates risks and follows issues through to resolution.
* Detail-oriented without losing sight of broader business objectives and outcomes.
* Clear communicator who can work effectively with senior leaders and delivery teams.
* Collaborative team member who is comfortable working across cultures, functions, and time zones.
* Curious and improvement-oriented, with a willingness to challenge inefficient ways of working constructively.

Measures of Success
  
  

* Projects and workstreams delivered against agreed milestones, scope, quality expectations, and implementation plans.
* Accurate and timely reporting of project status, risks, decisions, dependencies, and resource requirements.
* Strong follow-through on actions and effective coordination across stakeholder groups.
* Clear project documentation, governance discipline, and readiness for implementation and handoff.

title: Mechanical Engineer - Internship
description:
**About Airbound**
**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**
This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.
  
  
The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.
  
  
To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.
  
  
**About Hardware Engineering**
Hardware Engineering owns the aircraft's physical development, from a concept sketch to a part that flies. This spans system design, mechanism design, and structural design: working out how something moves, what it's made of, and whether it holds up under real load. Because most of what we design is custom, it also means designing the equipment we use to prove our work — rigs, jigs, and testers built specifically to validate a design before it goes anywhere near a real flight. It's one team across concept, design, initial prototyping, and test: the full arc of getting a product from an idea to something that ships.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring a Mechanical Engineering Intern - for freshers and university students who've built things with their own hands, not just studied how to. No prior professional experience is required; what we're looking for instead is real, hands-on project experience: BAJA, FSAE, robotics teams, personal builds, or similar.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Mechanism & Assembly Design**

* Support the design and development of mechanisms and mechanical assemblies for our aircraft, from early concept through production intent
* Build and test prototypes yourself — this is a hands-on role, not a design-and-hand-off one

**Analysis & Validation**

* Assist with load calculations, tolerance stacks, basic FEA, and weight budgets to validate designs before they're cut or molded

**Manufacturing Process Exposure**

* Work with composites layup, injection molding, additive manufacturing, and CNC machining to learn how to choose the right process for each part

**Composites & Structures Track**

* If focused on composites/structures: help us model and design composite structures — laminate design, layup optimization, and structural analysis — rather than just building to a fixed layup

**Mechanism Design Track**

* If focused on mechanism design help select actuation hardware — servos, stepper motors, and similar — and write short scripts to drive and test them

**Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a degree in mechanical engineering or a related field
* Real hands-on project experience (BAJA, FSAE, robotics, or similar build teams) that demonstrates genuine mechanism design or composites/structures work, not just coursework
* Working familiarity with 2D and 3D CAD
* Basic understanding of load calculations, tolerance analysis, and weight budgeting
* Strength in at least one of the following:

+ Detailed mechanism design (including actuation hardware selection and basic scripting to drive and test it)
+ Composites and structures (modeling and analysis, not just layup execution)

* Strong attention to detail and a willingness to get hands-on with hardware
* Clear communicator, comfortable working with both internal teams and external vendors
* Willingness to go the extra mile when a project needs it

**Work location:**
Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Comprehensive health insurance to keep you and your loved ones covered
* Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend to ease your commute
* Advanced salary credit to support you when you need it

“A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive -
**this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful**
from the ground up”
  
  
**Work Schedule**

* In-office role, working alternate Saturdays.

Ready to take off?
  
  
**Scam Notice:**
Beware of impersonators collecting fees for interviews & jobs at Airbound (Opendrone Private Limited) Please do not make any payments and report any such incidents to us at contact@airbound.com .

title: Senior Content Engineer
description:

* Define and improve information architecture, content models, structured content, and documentation standards to make knowledge scalable and reusable.

* Proven experience with Docs-as-Code, Git/GitHub, structured authoring, XML/DITA, and modern documentation workflows.

Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future - you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.
  
  
Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook
  
  
**What Diligent Offers You**

* Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients
* We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
* We have teams all over the world. We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.

Headquartered in New York, Diligent has offices in Washington D.C., London, Galway, Budapest, Vancouver, Bengaluru, Munich, Singapore and Sydney.  To foster strong collaboration and connection, this role will follow a hybrid work model. If you are within a commuting distance to one of our Diligent office locations, you will be expected to
**work onsite at least 50% of the time.**

title: Sr. Technical Content Creator
description:
**About Us**
Automation Anywhere is the leader in Agentic Process Automation (APA), transforming how work gets done with AI-powered automation. Its APA system, built on the industry’s first Process Reasoning Engine (PRE) and specialized AI agents, combines process discovery, RPA, end-to-end orchestration, document processing, and analytics—all delivered with enterprise-grade security and governance. Guided by its vision to fuel the future of work, Automation Anywhere helps organizations worldwide boost productivity, accelerate growth, and unleash human potential.
  
  
**Our Opportunity**

* Automation Anywhere University reaches over one million learners worldwide. We're looking for someone who can close the gap between what's possible on the Automation Anywhere platform and what customers actually know how to build and do it fast, at the pace of a product that isn't slowing down.
* This isn't a role for someone who learns a tool and then documents it. It's a role for someone who builds things with the tool first, then figures out how to teach what they just learned. You'll be working with beta features, emerging protocols, and capabilities that don't have training content yet, because you'll be creating it.

**Location:**
Bangalore, India.
  
  
**Who You’ll Report To:**
Director, Community & Learning
  
  
**You Will Make An Impact By Being Responsible For**

* Design and build end-to-end learning experiences for the Automation Anywhere platform, from curriculum architecture through hands-on exercise design, slide development, video production, and audio/video editing
* Create technical training content covering core automation development, Agentic Process Automation (APA), and integration with LLMs, MCPs, and A2A protocols
* Build companion assets that bring concepts to life, sample applications, working scripts, and web app demos built with code-assistant tools
* Translate complex, sometimes pre-release technical topics into clear, practical experiences that meet customers where they are
* Stay ahead of the curve on emerging development workflows, including AI-assisted development, and integrate those perspectives into how content is designed and delivered
* Work closely with product, developer relations, and subject matter experts to turn new capabilities into training before customers have to figure it out on their own

**You Will Be a Great Fit If You Have**

* 8+ Years of Minimum Relevant Experience.
* Hands-on proficiency with the Automation Anywhere platform, you've built real automations, you understand how the product actually works under the hood, and you can speak to it credibly
* Experience using code-assistant agents (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, or similar) to build working applications, scripts, or integration demos, not just familiarity, but actual shipped output
* Working knowledge of common data formats (JSON, XML, Markdown) and comfort with database platforms like Supabase
* End-to-end content production skills: you can go from content design to finished video without handing off at every step
* A demonstrated ability to take something technically complex including things still in beta and design a learning experience that makes it approachable and actionable

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Agentic Process Automation (APA) on the AA platform
* Familiarity with MCP and A2A protocols and how they integrate into automation workflows
* Background as a practitioner (developer, automation engineer, solutions architect) who moved into content or teaching rather than the other way around

This is an opportunity to work with a global, passionate team pioneering technology that’s redefining the way people work, everywhere. Join us and discover the many ways that you can have an impact, achieve your potential, and go be great.

title: Product Information / Labeling Subject Matter Expert (SME) - Medical Devices
description:
**Req ID:**
391651
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Product Information / Labeling Subject Matter Expert (SME) - Medical Devices to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
Job Description – Product Information / Labeling Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Medical Devices
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ Years
  
  
**Domain:**
Healthcare / Life Sciences / Medical Devices
  
  
**Function:**
Product Labeling, Regulatory Affairs & Product Information Management
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**Product Information / Labeling Subject Matter Expert (SME)**
with
**10+ years of experience in Healthcare, Life Sciences, and Medical Devices**
to lead and support global product labeling, Instructions for Use (IFU), packaging, product information, and regulatory documentation initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in
**global medical device labeling regulations, UDI requirements, labeling content management, regulatory compliance, product lifecycle management, and quality systems**
.
  
  
This role will serve as the functional and regulatory SME for product information and labeling, partnering closely with
**Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, R&D, Clinical Affairs, Human Factors, Product Management, Packaging Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and IT teams**
to ensure product information is accurate, controlled, traceable, and compliant across global markets.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product Information & Labeling Strategy
  
  

* Serve as the SME for medical device product information and labeling, including product labels, IFUs, user manuals, quick reference guides, packaging labels, implant cards, and other regulated product documentation.
* Define and implement global labeling strategies supporting new product introductions (NPI), product lifecycle changes, regulatory submissions, and market expansions.
* Conduct labeling gap assessments and impact analyses resulting from regulatory, product, manufacturing, or market changes.
* Establish standardized processes and governance for product information and labeling across global markets.

Regulatory Compliance
  
  

* Ensure labeling compliance with applicable global medical device regulations and standards, including:

+ FDA 21 CFR Part 801
+ EU Medical Device Regulation (EU MDR 2017/745)
+ ISO 15223-1 – Medical Device Symbols
+ ISO 20417 – Information Supplied by Medical Device Manufacturers
+ ISO 14971 – Medical Device Risk Management

* Interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into actionable labeling and product-information requirements.
* Support regulatory audits, inspections, submissions, and remediation activities related to labeling and product documentation.

UDI & Product Data Management
  
  

* Provide expertise in Unique Device Identification (UDI) requirements and associated product master data.
* Support UDI creation, maintenance, validation, and submissions to applicable regulatory databases, including GUDID and EUDAMED.
* Ensure consistency between product master data, regulatory information, labeling content, packaging, and downstream systems.

Labeling Content & Lifecycle Management
  
  

* Lead the creation, review, approval, revision, and retirement of controlled labeling content.
* Manage labeling changes through formal document and change-control processes.
* Coordinate translation and localization activities to ensure compliance with country-specific language and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure appropriate version control, traceability, approval workflows, and audit trails throughout the labeling lifecycle.
* Support implementation and optimization of Enterprise Labeling Management Systems (ELMS), PLM, and document/content management platforms.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Clinical, Legal, R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Packaging Engineering, Human Factors, Product Management, and IT.
* Translate complex technical, clinical, regulatory, and product requirements into clear and compliant customer-facing information.
* Work with Human Factors and Usability Engineering teams to ensure IFUs and product documentation appropriately address usability and patient/user safety.
* Coordinate with packaging and manufacturing teams to ensure approved labeling is accurately deployed into production environments.

Risk Management & Quality
  
  

* Participate in ISO 14971 risk-management activities to ensure appropriate labeling controls are implemented for identified risks and foreseeable misuse.
* Support investigations into labeling-related complaints, non-conformances, quality deviations, and field actions.
* Lead or support root cause analysis (RCA), CAPA, and remediation activities related to labeling and product information.
* Ensure labeling processes comply with applicable Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of professional experience, with significant experience in Healthcare, Life Sciences, and/or Medical Devices.
* 7+ years of strong hands-on experience in medical device product labeling, product information management, regulatory affairs, quality, or related functions.
* 5+ years of deep knowledge of global medical device labeling regulations and standards, particularly FDA 21 CFR Part 801, EU MDR, ISO 15223-1, ISO 20417, and ISO 14971.
* 5+ years of strong experience with IFUs, user manuals, packaging labels, UDI, product master data, translation/localization, and labeling change control.
* 5+ years of experience working within regulated Quality Management Systems (QMS) and formal document/change-control environments.
* Experience with Enterprise Labeling Management Systems, such as Loftware, BarTender, or PRISYM ID.
* Experience with PLM/document management platforms such as Windchill, Arena, Agile PLM, or equivalent systems.
* Familiarity with Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, or similar publishing/artwork tools is preferred.
* Strong understanding of product lifecycle management from NPI through commercialization, maintenance, and product retirement.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Healthcare, Technical Communications, Regulatory Affairs, or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree and/or Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) is preferred.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Medical Device Labeling & Product Information
* FDA & EU MDR Regulatory Compliance
* IFU / User Manual / Packaging Labeling
* UDI, GUDID & EUDAMED
* ISO 15223-1 / ISO 20417 / ISO 14971
* Enterprise Labeling Management Systems
* PLM & Document Management
* Labeling Change Control
* Translation & Localization
* Risk Management & CAPA
* Quality Management Systems
* Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
* Healthcare / Life Sciences Domain Expertise

description:

We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory system and neural pathways.
  
  
**JOB TITLE:**
**Product Documentation & CAD Engineer**
**Welcome to Natus**
We are continuing to grow our business in India and are now looking to expand our team there. Be part of this exciting journey right from the start!Natus Sensory is a leading manufacturer of medical devices and software for a range of solutions. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes in target markets through innovative screening, diagnostic and treatment solutions. We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory systems.
  
  
**About The role:**
The Product Documentation & CAD Engineer, within our R&D department, will be responsible for supporting product sustaining, New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering documentation, configuration management, and CAD activities for new and existing medical device products. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain accurate product configurations, engineering drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and controlled product documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
You will work closely with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, and Supply Chain teams to execute engineering changes, support design transfer and manufacturing readiness, resolve product and component-related issues, and ensure alignment between product designs and released documentation. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Agile PLM, SolidWorks CAD, EPDM/PDM, Jira, BOM management, and engineering change control within a structured product-development environment.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**Product Sustaining and Lifecycle Engineering:**

* Support sustaining engineering activities for released medical devices, including product improvements, component and supplier changes, obsolescence management, cost reduction, manufacturing improvements, and product lifecycle updates.
* Investigate product, component, supplier, and manufacturing issues and collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify root causes and implement robust engineering solutions.
* Support design modifications and product improvements while maintaining compliance with approved product requirements, design controls, risk management, and configuration management processes.

**CAD, Engineering Drawings, And Product Configuration**

* Create, modify, and maintain 3D models, assemblies, and 2D engineering drawings using SolidWorks CAD, ensuring appropriate dimensions, tolerances, materials, specifications, and revision control.
* Maintain engineering drawings, CAD models, assemblies, and associated design files within EPDM/PDM, ensuring data integrity, traceability, revision control, and proper release.
* Create and maintain part numbers, manufacturer part numbers, product structures, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and related product configuration data within Agile PLM.
* Ensure alignment and traceability between BOMs, CAD models, engineering drawings, specifications, approved manufacturer parts, and released product documentation.

**Engineering Change And Configuration Management**

* Initiate, develop, route, and support engineering change activities, including ECOs, DCOs, and MCOs, from initiation through review, approval, release, and implementation.
* Perform change-impact assessments and coordinate with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, and Supply Chain to ensure changes are complete, accurate, properly documented, and effectively implemented.
* Maintain configuration integrity throughout the product lifecycle and ensure engineering records comply with company procedures, document-control requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.

**New Product Introduction And Design Transfer**

* Support NPI and design transfer activities, including BOM readiness, drawing and specification release, product configuration, engineering change implementation, manufacturing documentation, and production readiness.
* Partner with R&D and Manufacturing teams to transition designs from development into production while ensuring released documentation accurately reflects the approved product configuration.
* Support prototype builds, pilot builds, first-article activities, manufacturing readiness reviews, and resolution of engineering issues identified during NPI.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration And Project Execution**

* Collaborate closely with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Operations teams to support product development, sustaining engineering, and manufacturing objectives.
* Participate in design reviews, engineering change reviews, product lifecycle reviews, and project meetings to ensure technical and documentation alignment across functions.
* Track engineering tasks, issues, and project activities using Jira, ensuring timely execution and clear communication of status, risks, and dependencies.
* Coordinate effectively with U.S.-based and global engineering teams and provide working-hour overlap as required to support project execution and cross-functional collaboration.

**Qualifications**

* Education & Experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 5–10 years of relevant engineering experience in product engineering, sustaining engineering, mechanical design/CAD, NPI, engineering documentation, or configuration management.
* Experience supporting medical devices or another regulated product-development environment is preferred.

**CAD & Product Lifecycle Management Expertise**

* Proficiency in SolidWorks CAD, including 3D modeling, assemblies, 2D engineering drawings, drawing revisions, and engineering documentation.
* Hands-on experience with Agile PLM, including part creation, manufacturer part management, BOM creation and maintenance, product structures, and engineering change activities.
* Experience with EPDM/PDM or comparable engineering data and document-management systems.
* Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, material specifications, and manufacturing requirements.

**Configuration Management & Engineering Change Control**

* Working knowledge of product configuration management, BOM management, document control, revision control, and engineering release processes.
* Experience initiating and executing ECOs, DCOs, MCOs, or equivalent engineering change processes.
* Understanding of product lifecycle management principles and maintaining traceability between engineering designs, BOMs, specifications, approved components, and manufacturing documentation.

**NPI, Sustaining & Regulated Product Development**

* Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), design transfer, sustaining engineering, and manufacturing readiness activities.
* Experience supporting component changes, supplier changes, product improvements, obsolescence, and manufacturing-related engineering changes.
* Familiarity with medical device quality systems, ISO 13485, FDA Quality System requirements, design controls, and configuration management practices is desirable.

**Project Management & Communication Skills**

* Experience using Jira or similar tools for engineering task, issue, and project tracking.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
* Ability to independently manage multiple engineering changes and documentation activities while meeting project schedules and quality requirements.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across global and cross-functional engineering teams.

**Desirable Additional Skills**

* Experience with GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and tolerance analysis.
* Knowledge of DFM/DFA principles and manufacturing processes such as machining, injection molding, sheet metal, and assembly.
* Experience supporting root-cause investigations, CAPA activities, supplier changes, and component obsolescence.
* Familiarity with risk management and design-control processes for regulated medical devices.
* Experience supporting prototype, pilot, and production builds.
* Ability to apply product lifecycle, configuration management, and engineering change-control processes independently.

**We offer**

title: JBPIND - Specialist, Product Content & Digital Experience.
description:
**Company Overview**
JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited is a subsidiary of J.B. Poindexter & Co., Inc. a privately held diversified manufacturing company forecasting $2.4B in annual revenue and 8,000 team members in 2026. The eight operating subsidiaries, covering over 50 locations, are engaged in the production of commercial truck bodies, step-vans, utility trucks, pickup truck bed enclosures, precision machining, and expandable foam plastic packaging.
  
  
For more information, visit www.jbpoindexter.com
  
  
JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited is the captive shared services unit of the J.B. Poindexter & Co., Inc. The company, wholly owned by J. B. Poindexter & Co., Inc. & is headquartered in Houston, Texas, USA.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Product Content & Digital Experience Specialist develops, maintains, and publishes accurate, useful, and customer-focused product and digital content across company websites, ecommerce platforms, marketplaces, email, social channels, and dealer websites.
  
  
The role translates complex product specifications and technical information into clear guidance that helps customers understand products, identify compatible parts, and use products effectively.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Develop and maintain website and landing-page copy that communicates product features, benefits, applications, and relevant customer information.
* Create and update product descriptions, parts catalogue content, compatibility information, installation instructions, FAQs, product comparisons, and marketplace listings.
* Translate complex product specifications, engineering details, and technical information into clear, accurate, and customer-friendly content.
* Prepare and maintain structured product information to support consistent content presentation and merchandising.
* Publish approved content through existing content management systems, website platforms, and ecommerce tools, following established workflows and approval processes.
* Adapt approved content for social channels, websites, and other digital touchpoints while maintaining accuracy and consistency.
* Support product information management by maintaining content completeness, consistency, accuracy, and alignment across relevant systems and channels.
* Coordinate with product, engineering, marketing, sales, ecommerce, IT, and other stakeholders to validate technical details and resolve content gaps.
* Review and proofread content for accuracy, clarity, grammar, formatting, usability, and adherence to brand and content standards.
* Maintain content updates and publishing records, track assigned work, and ensure approved changes are delivered within agreed timelines.
* Identify outdated, incomplete, duplicate, or inconsistent product content and coordinate corrections with the relevant stakeholders.
* Support ongoing improvements to content templates, publishing processes, product data quality, and digital customer experience.
* Manage multiple content requests and priorities while maintaining attention to detail and a high standard of quality.
* Strengthen SEO, structured data, parts catalogs, and eCommerce product content.

**Education/Experience**

* 08-10 years of relevant experience in technical writing, product content, digital content management, merchandising, product information management, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience developing content for products with technical specifications, parts information, compatibility requirements, or installation guidance; B2B, industrial, manufacturing, or engineering experience is highly relevant.
* Strong technical writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn complex specifications into clear, structured, customer-friendly guidance.
* Hands-on experience with content management systems and publishing approved content across website and platforms.
* Working knowledge of merchandising, product detail pages, marketplace listings, and structured product information.
* Understanding of SEO fundamentals, including page content, metadata, keywords, and content structure.
* Experience maintaining product information, parts catalogs, compatibility data, FAQs, comparisons, and other product-support content.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to validate information with subject-matter experts before publishing.
* Ability to collaborate across product, engineering, marketing, sales, ecommerce, and IT teams and manage multiple deliverables simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Writing, English, Communications, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience with content development tools such as Adobe Experience Manager, MadCap Flare, Adobe FrameMaker, and Adobe InDesign for creating, managing, and publishing digital and technical content.

**Code Of Ethics**
JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited, requires the highest standard of ethics in all business dealings, with customers, suppliers, advisors, employees, and authorities. This position shall actively ensure that his/her own activities and those of all employees within the project meet this obligation. JBPCO critical standards and procedures related to expected conduct are detailed on the company website. This position is expected to be familiar with these policies and ensure that they are implemented in all areas of control.

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
**About Derivate X**

Derivate X is an SEO/GEO agency for B2B SaaS. We run multi-client retainers across strategy, content, off-page, and reporting; mostly async over Slack, Notion, and Asana.

**NOTE:**
If you use ChatGPT to copy-paste the response, please stay away.

**The role**

You’ll write and ship client-facing content that ranks and gets cited: blog posts, guest posts, landing/GEO pages, and related assets, with high ownership and clean turnaround. You work with SEO on briefs/keywords and with delivery on deadlines; you don’t invent strategy from scratch.

**What you’ll own**

* Write and revise SEO/GEO content for assigned B2B SaaS clients (blogs, GPs, pages, linked assets, etc)
* Turn briefs into clear, structured drafts that match client voice and our quality bar
* Use AI as a force multiplier; never as a paste-and-ship substitute; you own the final draft
* Hit deadlines in Asana; keep versions, feedback, and status clear in Notion/Slack
* Iterate fast from SEO/editor/client notes (days, not weeks)
* Maintain style consistency across a client’s content set

**You won’t own**

* SEO strategy/keyword strategy
* Client relationship/reporting
* Pure off-page / link outreach

**Must-haves**

* Strong written English, brief, structured, no roaming around the bushes
* Portfolio of SEO or B2B content (links or samples); show you can explain a hairy concept cleanly
* Comfortable using AI tools
  *and*
  rewriting hard so the output isn’t generic
* Async-first: Slack + Notion + Asana; minimal meetings
* Reliable on deadlines across multiple pieces/clients

**Nice-to-haves**

* SaaS / DevTools / B2B writing experience
* SEO or GEO / AI-search awareness (entities, structure, cite-worthy clarity)
* Agency or multi-client experience

**You’ll thrive here if you**

* Prefer ownership over hand-holding
* Care about terminology, consistency, and edge cases
* Move at early-stage pace without dropping quality

**What we offer**

* Performance bonus tied to company growth
* Direct access to founders; real impact on live client work from week one

**How we hire**

* Usually 1–3 weeks. Process: screen → paid/short writing test (no ChatGPT paste) → fit call → offer.

**Description**
**About the Role**
We're looking for a RFP Writer to join our Bids & Proposals team. You'll write clear, accurate, persuasive responses to RFPs, RFIs, and due diligence questionnaires, working closely with Product, Engineering, Category, InfoSec, and Legal. title: Data Privacy Intern
description:
About Comply Ark
  

Comply Ark is a regulatory infrastructure company building software for data protection compliance under the DPDPA and global privacy regimes.

We build two products. DataLens is a full-stack, data-blind compliance platform for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025. It discovers and classifies personal data across an organisation's systems, generates the records of processing, runs consent and data principal requests, and supports breach response, all without personal data ever leaving the customer's environment.

Comply Ark was founded by Navaneeth SS, a technology and data protection lawyer who previously practised at a leading Indian technology law firm, and Midhun MP, a full-stack engineer who owns the technical architecture of DataLens. A technology and data protection lawyer and a full-stack engineer: the exact pairing this category has been missing. The company is DPIIT-recognised, a recipient of the Kerala Startup Mission Idea Grant, and part of the current ISB iVi (I-Venture Immersive) cohort.

The role

This is one role that spans law, technology and business, because privacy compliance is now all three at once. The DPDPA is in force, and its obligations become enforceable in May 2027. Most organisations need 6 to 12 months to become compliant, and penalties reach up to ₹250 crore per breach. That makes the buying window now. Organisations need someone who can read the Act closely, understand how their systems actually hold personal data, and explain both to a General Counsel and a CISO in the same meeting.

As a Data Privacy Intern, you will do that work inside a company building the infrastructure for it. You will research the law, test and shape the products against it, and take both to the market. This is not a legal internship with some technology on the side, or a sales internship with some reading attached. Every intern works across all three areas below. The weighting shifts with your background and strengths, and a typical split is about 40 percent privacy and regulatory work, 30 percent product, and 30 percent business development.

What you will do

You will produce work that ships: research the product team builds on, test findings that change the product, and account work that moves real conversations forward.

Privacy and regulatory

* Read the DPDPA and the DPDP Rules, 2025 at sub-section level, and translate obligations into operational requirements for specific sectors such as banking and fintech, insurance, healthcare, edtech and e-commerce.
* Track regulatory developments in India, including notifications, Data Protection Board activity and sectoral regulator guidance, and in the global regimes CookieGate covers, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, LGPD and PDPL.
* Draft and cite-check knowledge content such as client briefings, updates to the Comply Ark DPDPA whitepaper, product FAQs and the DataLens content series, with every claim traced to the official text.

Product and technology

* Map legal obligations to DataLens and CookieGate features, and write them up as clear requirements with acceptance criteria the engineering team can build and test against.
* Test the products the way a compliance officer would use them: run data principal request flows, review generated records of processing, check consent records, and log every issue with reproducible steps.
* Review cookie and tracker classifications across jurisdictions, flag misclassifications, and help build the reference datasets that improve classification accuracy.
* Build sector-specific demo scenarios and sample data so that each demo speaks to the prospect's own regulatory exposure.

Business development

* Research and qualify target accounts in regulated, data-heavy sectors, map their buying committees, from the General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer to the CTO, CISO and DPO, and keep the sales tracker current.
* Build and update sector playbooks covering regulatory exposure, typical data flows, buying triggers and likely objections.
* Support outbound and demos with account research notes, tailored follow-ups, meeting notes and post-meeting debriefs.
* Support partnerships with law firms and compliance consultancies, from partner research to the material they need to work with us.

You will not give legal advice to customers or prospects. Comply Ark builds software, it is not a consulting firm, and any client-facing statement on the law is reviewed by the founders before it leaves the company.

Who we are looking for

We welcome applicants from law, technology and business, and we hire for judgement, precision and ownership rather than for a particular degree.

You should be a student in the later years of your degree, or a graduate within one year of completing it. Your background decides where you start, and the role expects you to grow into the other two areas.

Background

Typical degrees

What we expect you to bring

Law

B.A. LL.B., LL.B., LL.M.

Close reading of statute at sub-section level, structured legal writing, and a working grasp of how privacy regimes compare

Technology

B.Tech, B.E., BCA, MCA, B.Sc. in computing

A clear model of how systems store and move personal data, from databases and APIs to cookies and third-party scripts, plus basic SQL or Python

Business

BBA, B.Com, MBA, PGDM

Account research, clear commercial writing, comfort with a CRM or tracker, and the confidence to speak with senior buyers

What every applicant needs

* Precise written English. Most of your work will be read by lawyers, engineers or buyers, and each of them will notice loose wording.
* A real interest in data protection, shown through coursework, writing, projects, moots, internships or self-study.
* Comfort with technology. You do not need to code, but you must be willing to understand how a product works and to test it carefully.
* Good use of AI tools, paired with the discipline to verify every output against the source.
* The habits remote work demands: you communicate without being chased, meet the deadlines you set, and say early when something is off track.

What will set you apart

* A privacy certification such as CIPP/E, CIPP/A, CIPM or CIPT, or one in progress.
* Published writing, a moot, research or a project on data protection or technology law.
* Prior internship experience at a law firm, a compliance team, a privacy or security company, or an early-stage startup.
* Hands-on familiarity with browser developer tools, cloud consoles or consent management platforms.
* Prior work on outreach, partnerships or sales, in any setting.

How we work

The internship is fully remote, and it runs on written work, clear weekly commitments and regular feedback.

* You agree your weekly working hours with us at the start, with regular overlap during Indian working hours for reviews and collaboration. If you are studying, we plan around your examinations in advance rather than at the last minute.
* Every intern has a weekly review with a founder and sends a short written update at the end of each week covering what was done, what is next and what is blocked.
* Work happens in writing, in shared documents and trackers, so that anyone can pick it up without a meeting.
* You need your own laptop and a reliable internet connection. We provide Comply Ark accounts and the tools the work requires.
* Before you start, you sign a confidentiality and intellectual property agreement.

What you will get

You will learn data protection the way it is actually practised now, at the point where the law, the system and the buyer meet.

* Direct work with both founders, a technology and data protection lawyer and a full-stack engineer, with weekly feedback on your work.
* Real ownership. Your research, test findings and account work feed into the products and conversations that Comply Ark is running.
* Exposure to how enterprise buyers in regulated sectors evaluate privacy software, from the first conversation to the demo.
* Credit for your work. Where something you wrote is published, you will be named.
* A monthly stipend, a certificate of completion, and a letter of recommendation for interns whose work earns one.
* The possibility of a pre-placement offer, based on your performance during the internship.

How to apply

Apply through this LinkedIn job post with an up-to-date CV. We accept applications only through LinkedIn, so that every candidate goes through the same process.

We review applications on a rolling basis, and the process runs in five steps:

1. **Application review.**
   We read every CV against what this posting asks for.
2. **Candidate questionnaire.**
   Shortlisted candidates receive a short questionnaire that takes about 20 minutes. It includes a note of no more than 200 words on why this role, and on one data protection question you find genuinely interesting. The note carries as much weight as your CV.
3. **Work sample.**
   You choose one short task: map a DPDPA obligation to a product requirement, profile a company's regulatory exposure, or review a live website's cookie consent against the law.
4. **Interview with the founders.**
   A 30 to 45 minute conversation about your work sample and how you think.
5. **Offer.**
   We confirm the duration, weekly hours, start date and stipend in writing.

Using AI in your work is welcome, but we assess your own judgement, so please write your answers yourself. A specific answer from your own work will serve you better than a polished general one.

How we handle your personal data

We use your application data only to assess you for this role, and we hold it to the same standard we build our products for.

We erase your application 6 months after the process closes. If you would like us to keep it on file for future roles, we will ask for your consent separately, and you can withdraw that consent at any time.

You can ask us at any time for a summary of the data we hold about you, or to correct, update or erase it, by writing to careers@complyark.com. The same address handles any grievance about how we have dealt with your data. Our full privacy policy is at complyark.com/privacy-policy.

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, ECE, or related field

title: Application Engineer - Aftermarket (API Pump)
description:

**Job Title: Application Engineer – Aftermarket (API Pumps)**
**Job Summary**
The Application Engineer – Aftermarket will report to the Regional Commercial Operations Lead – Pump AM, APAC, and will be based in Bangalore. The role involves supporting technical tendering and quotation activities for API pump aftermarket requirements, including replacement pumps, spare parts, upgrades, and services.
  
  
The incumbent will work closely with the regional sales team, channel partners, customers, and internal stakeholders to understand customer requirements, review technical specifications, prepare techno-commercial offers, and ensure accurate and timely submission of quotations in line with company policies and procedures.
  
  
**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**

* Coordinate with the sales team to understand customer requirements, technical specifications, scope, and submission timelines.
* Review customer inquiries, RFQs, and tender documents to identify technical and commercial requirements.
* Assist in preparing techno-commercial offers, quotations, and tender submissions for API pump aftermarket products and services.
* Review technical specifications and identify applicable customer requirements for replacement pumps, spare parts, and related services.
* Coordinate with suppliers and the Supply Chain team to obtain quotations for required components and bought-in equipment.
* Support the evaluation of supplier quotations to ensure compliance with customer specifications and scope requirements.
* Assist in preparing technical and commercial clarifications for customers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate with manufacturing, project management, and supply chain teams to support smooth order handover.
* Maintain accurate records of customer inquiries, quotations, and opportunities, and update the tracking system regularly.
* Support the preparation of cost estimates and commercial evaluations to ensure competitive and accurate quotations.
* Assist in identifying potential technical and commercial risks and escalate issues to the reporting manager.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders to ensure timely submission of quotations and progress of orders.
* Support the regional sales team in aftermarket business development activities related to pump spares, replacements, and services.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, tendering procedures, and applicable business processes.Perform other related responsibilities as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Basic understanding of API pumps, industrial pumps, pump components, and aftermarket services.
* Knowledge of technical tendering, RFQ processing, quotation preparation, or application engineering.
* Understanding of technical drawings, engineering specifications, and customer requirements.
* Good commercial awareness and basic understanding of costing and pricing.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, preferably SAP, for quotation, material, or order-related activities.
* Basic understanding of purchase processes, supplier quotations, and commercial terms.
* Good analytical skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective communication and coordination skills to work with sales, engineering, supply chain, and other internal teams.
* Ability to manage multiple inquiries and meet quotation submission deadlines.
* Willingness to learn, take ownership of assigned tasks, and work in a collaborative environment.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Knowledge of Hindi is preferred.

**Education And Experience**

* BE or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university or institute in India.
* 4–5 years of relevant experience in application engineering, technical tendering, estimation, quotation preparation, or sales support for industrial pumps.
* Exposure to API pumps, pump aftermarket, spare parts, replacement pumps, or industrial rotating equipment is preferred.
* Experience in reviewing RFQs, preparing quotations, and coordinating with sales and supply chain teams will be an advantage.
* Exposure to ERP systems, preferably SAP, is desirable.
* Experience in an international business environment is an added advantage.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Desk-based role requiring regular use of a computer, telephone, and other office equipment.

title: Support Engineer
description:
**About Signeasy**

**Contracts run businesses. We're unlocking the intelligence inside them.**

Signeasy began 16 years ago with a simple idea: signing should be easy. That idea helped the world go paperless. But signatures were only the beginning.

Today, the real problem isn't signing contracts. It's what happens after. In most companies, contracts sit scattered across inboxes, shared drives, CLMs, ERPs, and filing systems. They're static, forgotten, and underused, yet they quietly define revenue, risk, compliance, and growth. We believe contracts are one of the most powerful and most overlooked sources of truth in a business.

2025 changed everything. While others continued to treat contracts as paperwork, we began turning them into living, searchable, and intelligent systems of record. We shipped more than 250 product releases, achieved 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and were featured at Apple's WWDC, all while building the foundation for what comes next.

2026 is our biggest year yet. With the launch of Intelligent Contract Management, we're going to market with an AI-powered contract management platform built for modern teams who expect more than storage, signatures, or status quo software.

This is the moment, and this is the team building it. If you want to help shape the future of contracts with us, read on.

**Your role**

As our Support Engineer, you'll be part of the Customer Support team and the technical voice of Signeasy for our customers. You'll resolve the issues that need more than a help article: API errors, integration failures, SSO setups, mobile app, and tricky account problems. You'll handle tickets end to end and get on calls with our enterprise and API customers when a conversation works better than an email thread.

You'll be the bridge between customers and our engineering team. When something is broken, you'll reproduce it, find the root cause where you can, and hand engineering a clean, well-documented ticket. When something is confusing, you'll fix it at the source with better docs, macros, and product feedback.

If you enjoy digging into logs, love the moment a stubborn issue finally clicks, and care about leaving every customer better off than you found them, you'll find a lot to love here.

**What you'll do**

**Ticket resolution**

* Own tickets across email, chat, and phone, from first response to resolution, within our support SLAs
* Take escalations from the frontline team and resolve complex issues across our web app, iOS and Android apps, eSign API, and Intelligent Contract Management
* Troubleshoot integrations with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, HubSpot, Salesforce, and other tools our customers rely on
* Keep customers informed with clear, honest updates, and manage expectations on timelines and workarounds

**Enterprise and API customers**

* Join calls with enterprise and API customers to debug live issues, walk through setups, and answer technical questions
* Help developers integrate our eSign API: review their requests, read error responses, and point them to best practices
* Support admins with account configuration, SSO/SAML, user management, and compliance-related questions

**Debugging and escalation to engineering**

* Reproduce issues across platforms, and investigate using logs, HAR files, browser dev tools, API tools such as Postman, and SQL queries
* Separate configuration issues from real bugs, and file well-documented Jira tickets with steps to reproduce, impact, and customer context
* Follow escalations through to closure and close the loop with the customer

**Knowledge and product feedback**

* Write and update help center articles, internal runbooks, and Zendesk macros so the next customer or teammate solves it faster
* Spot recurring issues and trends, and share them with Product and Engineering to improve the product
* Respond to app store reviews that need a technical answer

**AI and automation**

* Use AI tools to investigate issues, draft responses, and summarize ticket trends
* Build simple scripts, automations, and templates that cut repetitive work for the support team

**Who you are**

We're looking for someone technical, curious, and customer-first: a problem solver who takes ownership and doesn't let an issue go cold.

* 3 to 4 years of experience in technical or product support for a B2B SaaS product
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, and JSON, with hands-on experience using Postman or similar tools
* Comfort reading logs, analyzing HAR files, and using browser developer tools
* Experience troubleshooting web and mobile apps
* Hands-on experience with Zendesk (or a similar helpdesk) and Jira
* Confidence leading customer calls, including with technical and enterprise stakeholders
* Strong written and spoken English, with a clear, empathetic, and crisp communication style
* Self-driven, organized, and calm under pressure, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with SSO/SAML, OAuth, and webhooks
* Exposure to integrations such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365
* Basic scripting in Python or JavaScript
* Experience with iOS or Android debugging tools

**Why you'll love this role**

This role sits at the center of everything we ship. You'll work with customers of every size, from individual professionals to enterprise and API teams, and partner closely with Product and Engineering to make Signeasy better every week.

Your work will directly shape how customers experience Signeasy: how quickly their problems are solved, how much they trust us, and how the product improves based on what they tell us.

It's a high-ownership role with clear room to grow, into senior support, support operations, solutions engineering, or product, depending on where your interests take you.

**Why work with Signeasy**

Our values make us a TIGER: Trust, Integrity, Growth mindset, Empathy, and Responsibility.

We're a lean, close-knit, and nimble team. We're opinionated but collaborative: we disagree, then commit to a shared decision. We're modern, but we don't follow trends blindly. We're easy to work with, and we believe in having difficult conversations. We ask lots of questions, experiment, and learn fast. And we're deeply empathetic toward our customers, our colleagues, and ourselves.

Our people are our greatest asset. You'll work alongside some of the smartest, most humble people around the world, who come from diverse backgrounds and bring a wide range of experiences. We're a hybrid-friendly organization that values flexibility, with a mix of in-person collaboration at the office and focused work from home.

We are the #SigneasyTribe. Ask us plenty of questions about our culture, so we can both see whether there's a real connection that makes this a great experience for both of us.

**We'd love to hear from you**

Great talent comes from all kinds of paths. If this role speaks to you, please apply, even if you don't match every line on paper. We review every application and will get back to you within a week.

* Hear what it's like to work at Signeasy
* Meet Signeasy's leadership team
* Read our origin story
* Take a peek at Signeasy's culture
* Learn more about growth at Signeasy

Signeasy is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Deal Support Specialist
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Discipline**
Clients and Industries, Pursuits & Commercial Excellence
  
  
**Role Type**
Deal Support Specialist - Supervising Associate
  
  
**The opportunity**
:
  
  
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) consists of various service delivery centers from which Client Service and Enablement Services teams operate to deliver strategic support to EY member firms. GDS spans all geographies, practices, services lines, sectors and competencies within EY to deliver integrated services that result in efficient and world-class solutions. The position in discussion is with the P&CE in EY GDS Clients and Industries Function. The GDS P&CE serves as an extension to the onshore Deals team who are involved in the direct Bid Management Processes. The P&CE supports the onshore teams on a number of opportunities, adding more value during the Deal process or the bid management cycle.
  
  
The Deal Support Specialist - Supervising Associate provides support in the different phases of the Deal process. This role will support the Pursuit Strategist/Leader in all the stages of the Bid Management Process, involving in pre-RFP, RFP response and post-RFP phase. The range of activities include project management, research, review and analytical support for the onshore Deal team throughout the bid management cycle. This role will support in executing globally consistent strategy.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Pursuit and Opportunity Management:**

* Gather information through secondary research (both internal and external sources) and generate top-notch deliverables such as company profiles, competitor insights, trend analysis, and other valuable assets to support pre and proposal development phases.
* Prepare and drive project management plan throughout the deal cycle by acting as a point of contact in managing the end-to-end process including but not limited to organizing meetings, preparing meeting notes, finalizing timelines and accountabilities as per deadlines.
* Owns the preparation of kick-off documents, CV collation for team book, orals preparation and credentials pack. Support in the development of draft proposal sections based on deal requirement.
* Liaise with the broader team in development of client collaterals such as storyboards, placemats, proposals and internal presentations
* Establish and maintain clear and transparent communication and build strong stakeholders’ relationships by exhibiting professional etiquettes and adhering to agreed timelines and quality benchmarks
* Manage a repository of Regional, Market Segment or Service Line client-facing collateral as appropriate
* Exhibit innovative thinking and flexible approach while managing complex and out-of-scope requests
* Own and maintain repository of client presentations, RFQ responses, marketing collateral, etc

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

* Critical thinking, organized, detail – oriented with strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines
* Demonstrates excellent customer service skills including telephone, MS Teams and e-mail support

**Supervision Responsibilities:**

* This role will have supervisory responsibilities and direct reports
* Will be responsible for leading a region, stakeholder management and governance
* Act as a counselor for Pursuit Coordinators (Senior Associate and Associate Ranks)
* Quality review of deliverables

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Prior experience in Deals/pre-sales/bid management and project management
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and listening)
* Good business acumen and understanding of business development, Deal/ project management and coordination skills
* Expert in computer skills like Microsoft suite and Internet-based research
* Experience with SharePoint is desirable
* Able to build collaborative relationships with a variety of stakeholders

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
**Education:**

* University/bachelor’s degree required
* Master’s in business administration

**Experience:**

* 6 Yrs to 11 Yrs
* Minimum 3 years’ experience working with large Global organization preferably in a professional services firm
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
* Excellent written and oral communication skills in English is essential as the role requires direct communication with international team members
* Well versed in using MS Office

**Certification Requirements:**

* Expected to remain current on EY training and curriculum (e.g. Account Management Framework (AMF), Badges, etc)
* APMP and or PMP Certification would be added advantage

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* As the job involves responding to clients' needs and varying time zones, long/flexible hours are regularly required
* Moderate travel – for attending leadership meetings/trainings

**Technologies and Tools**

* Excellent MS office skills, specifically PowerPoint are required

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**The Position**
OPSWAT is now searching for a mid-to-senior level

As a member of a dynamic company, he or she also gets involved in other activities such as technical assistance to the Sales team, helping to test and assess new products and product releases, and other special projects.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Collaborating with the global OPSWAT Support team to resolve customer issues (which are often technical issues) rapidly and comprehensively, making sure to meet published SLAs.
* Working in a Technical Account Manager capacity to customers who are often very technically oriented (typical customers are engineers and IT personnel).
* Providing professional services for the implementation of OPSWAT products.
* Maintaining strong customer relationships through:

+ Regularly scheduled conference calls to review open issues.
+ Occasional in-person meetings
+ Improving issue management processes within the company.
+ Coordinating activity between Support, R&D, Product Management, and other departments.
+ Gaining expertise (both functional and limited technical) in OPSWAT products.
+ Going onsite and delivering professional services (training, system implementation) per request.
+ Getting engaged in other special project activities.

* Understanding customer IT requirements and goals
* Providing advice on the use of technology to implement OPSWAT products.

* Bachelor's degree in a Computer Science, Technical discipline, or Equivalent experience.
* 6-7 years of experience, with strong technical support background, including 3-4 years of professional services/delivery experience.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and Windows server.
* Basic knowledge of Linux, with an interest to expand that knowledge.
* Good foundation and willingness to expand knowledge of networking concepts.
* Basic knowledge of and willingness to expand knowledge of cybersecurity and critical infrastructure protection.
* Strong presentation skills (be able to describe things and convey ideas to others in an easy way).
* A proven customer-oriented attitude, including the ability to work with difficult and/or frustrated customers.
* A passion for solving problems and making customers happy.
* Ability to think logically, analyze logs and troubleshoot computer software and IT related issues.
* Availability and willingness to travel as necessary to your assigned accounts, and to Company meetings.

**It Would Be Nice If You Had**

* Experience working with global teams.
* Cybersecurity domain experience, including file security, device security, network security and etc.
* Network integration skillsets (e.g. Cisco, Dell-EMC, Juniper, Aruba, Ruckus, Meraki, Aerohive, Extreme, etc.).

description:

description:
