title: Lead Applied Value Engineer - CPGR /CMT -NAM
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
The position of
**Lead Applied Value Engineer**
is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a
**Lead Applied Value Engineer**
for the
**High Tech**
industry you are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Team and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**
**Identify & Frame Value**

* Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
* Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers
* Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

**Realize Value**

* Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
* Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
* Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

**Scale Value**

* Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
* Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
* Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

**The qualifications you need:**
**Live for Customer Value:**
Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.
  
  
**Data, Analytics, Applications & IT:**
Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.
  
  
**Process Improvement & Value Realization:**
Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value
  
  
**Project Management:**
Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.
  
  
**Executive Stakeholder Management:**
Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and sovereign appearance.
  
  
**Business Domain Expertise:**
Understanding of theHigh Tech domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)
  
  
**Industry Expertise:**
Expertise in the High Tech industry and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities
  
  
**Degree:**
In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program
  
  
**What Celonis Can Offer You:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
* Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
* Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
* Prioritize Your Well-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.
* Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
* Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
* Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
* Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

**Read This Before You Apply**

At ARL, we value curiosity, initiative, clear thinking and the ability to turn research into useful content.

We're looking for someone who pays attention to what is happening in the market, asks thoughtful questions, spots patterns and understands what an audience needs to know. You should enjoy going beyond surface-level trends to understand why a topic matters — and then turn those insights into clear, engaging written content.

Prior experience as a content researcher is a plus, but it isn't a requirement. We care more about your research instincts, analytical ability, writing, and willingness to learn.

**Who We Are & Why ARL**

At AgResearch Labs (ARL), we're building technology and infrastructure for cleaner, more climate-resilient food production.

Over more than a decade of R&D, ARL has developed indigenous aeroponics and farm-automation technologies that power Growize Farms, our commercial platform for building and operating high-performance farms at scale.

Recognised among India's Top 100 deep-tech startups by NASSCOM, ARL is entering its next phase of growth — scaling our business, teams and operating systems.

This creates an opportunity to help shape how we explain our work, engage our audiences and contribute to conversations around agriculture, food production, technology and the markets we operate in.

**The Role**

As a Content Researcher, you will identify relevant topics, investigate what audiences and markets care about, and turn your findings into thoughtful, well-written content.

You'll explore market needs, industry developments, audience questions, emerging conversations and content trends to understand what is worth saying, who it is for and how best to communicate it.

The role is not limited to writing from a brief. We want someone who can help identify the brief in the first place: someone who can research independently, connect ideas, analyse what works across different channels and develop content that is useful, relevant and engaging.

**What You'll Own**

**Market, Audience & Topic Research**

* Stay curious about developments in the market, industry news, customer needs, audience conversations and emerging trends relevant to ARL.
* Research topics using credible sources, reports, articles, interviews, social platforms, search trends and other relevant inputs.
* Identify the questions, challenges, misconceptions and interests that matter to our audiences.
* Separate meaningful signals from passing trends, and explain why a topic is relevant to ARL and its audience.
* Build a pipeline of researched topics, angles and content opportunities.

**Content Ideation & Writing**

* Turn research and insights into clear, engaging written content across formats such as educational explainers, articles, thought pieces, anecdotes, social posts, newsletters and website content.
* Develop strong angles, hooks and narratives rather than simply summarising information.
* Adapt the depth, tone, structure and format of content to the intended audience and channel.
* Translate technical or complex ideas into accessible content without losing accuracy or nuance.
* Work with internal subject-matter experts to validate information and uncover useful stories, examples and perspectives.

**Content Analysis & Performance Learning**

* Study content from relevant brands, creators, publications and competitors to understand what earns attention, builds trust and drives engagement.
* Analyse available performance signals — such as reach, engagement, saves, shares, clicks, search visibility or reader feedback — to understand what is working and why.
* Use evidence and audience response to refine topics, formats, distribution choices and future content ideas.
* Develop hypotheses, test different angles and document learnings rather than relying only on intuition.
* Understand that different channels and audiences need different approaches; content that works in one place may not work in another.

**Research Quality & Collaboration**

* Verify facts, check sources and maintain a clear distinction between evidence, interpretation and opinion.
* Keep research organised, with source links, key findings and useful context that others can review.
* Collaborate with the marketing, business and technical teams to align content with business priorities and audience needs.
* Manage multiple topics and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and writing quality.
* Use AI and research tools thoughtfully to improve efficiency, while independently verifying claims and adding original judgment.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong curiosity about markets, people, industries and why certain ideas or stories resonate.
* Good research and analytical instincts — the ability to find credible information, connect dots, spot patterns and draw useful conclusions.
* Clear, engaging writing with the ability to explain ideas simply and adapt to different formats.
* An understanding that effective content starts with audience needs and a clear purpose, not just a trending topic.
* The ability to assess what content works, for whom, on which platform and why — using both qualitative judgment and available data.
* Initiative to suggest topics and angles, ask questions and develop ideas without waiting for a fully defined brief.
* Attention to detail, factual accuracy and a willingness to revise work based on feedback and evidence.
* Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where content priorities and business needs can evolve.

Prior experience as a content researcher, content writer, journalist, editorial researcher, market researcher or in a related role is good to have, but not mandatory. Strong writing samples, research projects, personal publications or other evidence of your ability to think and communicate well are welcome.

**Good to have:**
Experience with digital content, SEO, social media analytics, audience research, industry publications or content planning; familiarity with agriculture, food systems, sustainability, climate, technology or deep-tech topics; comfort using spreadsheets, analytics dashboards and AI-assisted research tools.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You consistently identify relevant topics and angles grounded in audience needs and market developments.
* Your content is accurate, clear, engaging and appropriate for its intended audience and channel.
* Research leads to useful insights and original angles, rather than surface-level summaries.
* Content ideas become a consistent pipeline of work that supports ARL's communication and business priorities.
* You learn from performance data and feedback, and use those learnings to improve future content.
* Internal teams can rely on your research, source quality and written output.

**Why This Role**

This is an opportunity to help shape how a growing deep-tech and AgTech business communicates with the world. You'll have room to explore ideas, understand an evolving market, learn from subject-matter experts and turn complex topics into content that informs, engages and builds understanding.

If you're curious about why people pay attention to certain ideas, enjoy getting to the bottom of a topic and can turn what you learn into compelling writing, we'd like to hear from you.

title: QMS Development - Lead
description:

Degree in Engineering, Quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated professional expertise.

Minimum

of relevant professional experience, including hands-on

experience.

Practical experience with
**AS9100**
implementation, maintenance, auditing, or improvement, along with

requirements, in an aerospace-related organisation.

title: Senior Applications Engineer (Functional Verification)
description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You have spent enough time in digital design or verification to know that the real work starts when something breaks in a way the documentation never mentioned. Debugging is not just a skill for you, it is how you think. You follow the signal, trace the logic, and figure out what actually happened versus what should have happened, and you can explain the difference to someone who was not there when it broke.
  
  
Working with customers does not intimidate you. You have learned that the best support is not about having every answer immediately, it is about asking the right questions, reproducing the issue, and staying with it until it makes sense. You know your way around Verilog or VHDL well enough to read someone else's RTL and spot where the problem might be hiding.
  
  
You are comfortable working across time zones with engineers in different locations, and you understand that being remote does not mean working in a vacuum. At Synopsys, you will be part of a global team supporting EDA tools that matter, and the work you do will directly affect how customers deploy and trust the products we build.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Drive customer deployments of VCS/Verdi simulation/debug technology, working closely with product teams and R&D to ensure successful adoption and integration.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot complex technical issues in verification flows, utilizing good product knowledge and analytical skills.
* Collaborate with global domain experts to gather requirements and contribute to the development of a robust product roadmap.
* Drive competitive engagements by demonstrating Synopsys VCS/Verdi advantages and supporting customers in benchmarking scenarios.
* Interface directly with customers, product validation, and R&D teams to propose solutions and suggest improvements in implementation and validation processes.
* Develop and optimize scripts (Perl, TCL, Shell, Make,Python) to enhance productivity and workflow automation.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Enable customers to accelerate their verification cycles and achieve first-pass silicon success through expert support and deployment of VCS simulation technology.
* Drive innovation in verification methodologies by integrating advanced features and AI-driven productivity tools.
* Enhance Synopsys’ product offerings by providing actionable feedback from customer engagements and competitive benchmarking.
* Facilitate seamless collaboration across global teams, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality solutions.
* Support the continuous improvement of VCS/Verdi and related technologies through proactive problem-solving and technical expertise.
* Contribute to the growth of Synopsys’ leadership in EDA by empowering customers to leverage the full capabilities of verification platforms.

**What You’ll Need:**

title: Venture Fellow - Internship
description:
Aadi Labs is a venture creation studio. We help founders turn promising ideas into working products, first customers and the foundations of real companies, and we build some of those companies ourselves, with Venture Fellows leading the work.

You will own a real function inside an early-stage venture for six months: real users, real numbers, real consequences if something does not work.

**What you will actually do**

Depending on the venture and the function you choose, that could mean running growth experiments and watching the numbers move, shipping product decisions that get tested by real users within days, writing and deploying code that goes live the same week, or designing the first experience a customer ever sees of something that did not exist a month ago. You will not be handed a six-month roadmap on day one. You will be handed a problem and the room to go solve it.

**Who this is for**

AI is already part of how you work daily. You use it to get more done than your headcount would suggest, not as a novelty you dabble in occasionally. You want responsibility earlier than a conventional internship gives you, and you are comfortable with a role that is not fully defined yet.

Prior experience in a function helps, but a real track record of building or shipping something, anywhere, counts for more than a résumé line.

**Pick your track**
— Venture Fellows lead one of five functions. You choose which one you are applying for on our site.

* **Growth**
   — positioning, acquisition and retention, with AI handling the busywork so your judgment goes toward what to test next.
* **Product**
   — the customer, the first use case, the smallest version worth shipping, prototyped with AI to move at founder speed.
* **Engineering**
   — production code, using AI coding tools to multiply your own output.
* **Design**
   — the end-to-end experience, from UX to the first impression a user gets.
* **Other**
   — sales, operations, customer success, or a function that doesn't fit neatly above.

**Logistics**
: 6 months · Remote or hybrid (Whitefield, Bangalore)

· Direct exposure to zero-to-one building, mentorship, real equity via ESOP, and a credible path to full-time or founding your own venture after.

title: Consultant
description:
**Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!**
Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.
  
  
What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!
  
  
**Who We Are**
Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments. We’ve scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.
  
  
Today we support more than 5,100 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.
  
  
With over 1,400+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.
  
  
As a Consultant at Flywire, you will play a pivotal role in guiding our clients through the successful implementation and optimization of Flywire's payment solutions. You will leverage your expertise to understand client needs, translate them into actionable strategies, and ensure a seamless integration experience, ultimately contributing to their financial success and Flywire's growth.
  
  
Responsibilities:\*\*
  
  

* Lead and manage the end-to-end implementation lifecycle for new clients, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and go-live.
* Conduct in-depth analysis of client business processes and payment workflows to identify opportunities for efficiency and optimization through Flywire's offerings.
* Develop and deliver tailored solution presentations, workshops, and training sessions to client stakeholders at various levels.
* Act as a primary point of contact for clients during the implementation phase, providing expert guidance, resolving issues, and managing expectations.
* Collaborate closely with internal Flywire teams, including Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support, to ensure client success and product enhancements.
* Document client requirements, solution designs, and implementation plans comprehensively.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with project delivery and client satisfaction.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Flywire's implementation methodologies and best practices.
* Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and Flywire's product roadmap.

Qualifications:\*\*
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in a consulting, implementation, or technical account management role, preferably within the fintech, payments, or SaaS industry.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects and multiple client engagements simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, capable of building rapport with diverse stakeholders.
* Proficiency in understanding and explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience with payment systems, financial processes, or enterprise software implementations is highly desirable.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel occasionally to client sites as required.

**What We Offer**
Competitive compensation
  
  
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  
  
Competitive time off
  
  
Work with brilliant people globally Learn more about their journeys by checking out #InsideFlywire on social media
  
  
Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates
  
  
Be a meaningful part in our success - every FlyMate makes an impact
  
  
Great Talent & Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers, OneFlywire Career Mobility)
  
  
**Submit today and get started!**
We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for any questions.
  
  
Flywire is an equal opportunity employer and follows a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity, national origin, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, genetic disposition or carrier status, veteran status, or any other category protected under applicable national, federal, state or local law.

title: Benefits Operations Associate, EDI
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
Rippling is looking for an Operations Analyst to support our EDI and API operations. In this role, you will be responsible for configuring, debugging, and maintaining client-level configurations and assisting in resolving any errors returned from multiple insurance carriers. This role will require significant engagement across insurance carriers, customers, and a number of internal departments, and will have a major impact on the success of Rippling's Benefits platform.
  
  
Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most important product categories, and the Benefits Operations team is critical to getting companies enrolled in the right benefits. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments every year.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own end-to-end setup of new EDI/API implementations (834, JSON, and carriers’ proprietary files) and post-production support for our growing client base, including carrier requirements gathering, file mapping, testing, error report handling, and discrepancy resolution
* Act as the primary point of contact with insurance carriers, customers, and brokers to resolve issues related to EDI/API transactions
* Identify process gaps and areas where improvements can be made
* Own productivity metrics and ensure adherence to SLAs
* Support EDI/API connections post production

**What You Will Need**

* 2 - 4 years of experience in EDI file transmissions (834 files or proprietary files) and enrollment/member eligibility management.
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal).
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Excellent client service skills.
* Good attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize.
* Knowledge with API is a plus.
* Knowledge of HIPAA regulations as they relate to benefits enrollment data and PHI handling.
* Basic knowledge of XML or flat-file data formats used alongside 834 EDI.

RA & QM functionality sits overall within the SQR (Systems, Quality & Regulatory) business function.
  
  
This role provides deep functional and process expertise and serves as the primary regional/global or functional authority supporting the Global Process Owner (GPO). The incumbent ensures global process standards are effectively deployed and adhered to locally, while leading high-priority, cross-functional simplification and transformation initiatives.

* RA: Product Regulatory Affairs
* RA: Drug Operations
* RA: Drug Strategy (US / EU / non-EU)
* RA: Drug Labelling
* RA: Distributor Management
* QM: Clinical Evaluation Reports
* QM: Documentation Control

* Designing and governing a harmonized service delivery model
* Governance of global process documentation
* Establishing and monitoring standardized KPIs
* Leading enterprise-wide transformation programs
* Shaping a stakeholder-aligned future-state operating model

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Design thinking & facilitation

Engagement delivery & governance
  
  

* Structure workplans, risks, and interlocks across pursuit/delivery workstreams; prepare SteerCo updates and execution dashboards

description:
**Job Description Summary**
As the Application Specialist for Ultrasound, you will be responsible for driving and executing clinical education training, demonstration management, and demonstration strategies. You will facilitate evidence-based practices and support both the customer experience and commercial teams from pre-sale through post-implementation by delivering effective, outcome-based education and training solutions. Your efforts will directly impact our customers’ ability to enhance productivity, improve patient care, and elevate quality by optimizing their technical and clinical competencies, image quality, workflow, and protocol management.
  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Provide technical and clinical leadership during the sales process by demonstrating the full range of Ultrasound products, including potential uses, product capabilities, and customer benefits.
* Coordinate, schedule, and execute objective-based system training for customers and channel partners; monitor and report on training outcomes.
* Develop and deliver product training to customers on equipment usage.
* Monitor customer installations of ultrasound products within the assigned territory/region to enhance customer satisfaction and maintain strong relationships.
* Support trade shows and professional conferences by conducting product demonstrations and customer training sessions.
* Leverage market and product knowledge to assist the sales team in developing effective sales, marketing, and customer service strategies.
* Build and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) in the region; responsible for training the sales and dealer teams periodically to enhance their capabilities.
* Penetrate competitive accounts and provide current market intelligence to the business.
* Promote new product features (NPI) and clinical techniques; collaborate with customers to develop training plans and strategies that support new product adoption and ongoing training needs in Ultrasound.
* Serve as the focal point for the modality/team by identifying customer satisfaction issues, assisting with escalations, resolving problems, and addressing specialty training requests.
* Advocate for and support the adoption of hybrid training delivery models for customers.
* Maintain well-documented pre- and post-training records in alignment with global guidelines.
* Responsible for pre- and post-sales support of ultrasound systems. Responsibilities include conducting clinical activities such as workshops, CMEs, webinars, and hands-on training.
* The incumbent will be based as per requirement and will support the LCT (Local Customer Team) or the Region depending on the scope of priority.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree/ Diploma with 5+ years of experience in MNC as Ultrasound applications is required.
* Experience in Fetal Medicine, General Imaging, OB/GYN, Vascular Sonography, and Cardiology applications is essential
* Ultrasound technical/clinical industry experience is required, along with any applicable certifications.
* Good knowledge of 2D, Doppler, and color flow imaging, with experience in 3D and 4D imaging (especially for OB/GYN).

* Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs

title: ServiceNow Senior Analyst
description:

title: MES Engineer: Pharmaceutical & Biotech Manufacturing
description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.

Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.

Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top-tier global investors, 60+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.

**About The Role**

We're hiring an MES (Manufacturing Execution System) Engineer to help pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers move from paper to digital batch execution.

You'll implement, configure and improve MES solutions for our clients, and every project has to meet strict GMP and data integrity standards. You'll report to a Lead or Senior Engineer, and you'll own work packages as your experience grows.

**What You'll Do**

**Delivery & Implementation**

* Work on MES projects from start to finish: requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, deployment and Hypercare.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and turn them into MES functional and technical requirements, workflows and configurations.
* Configure MES solutions to fit each client's operations, including electronic batch records (EBR), recipes, production workflows and master data.
* Design and deliver integrations with enterprise systems such as ERP (for example SAP), LIMS, WMS and QMS, and with shop-floor (L2) equipment and automation systems.
* Find and fix system issues quickly to keep production downtime low.

**Compliance & Validation**

* Apply GMP, GAMP 5, data integrity (ALCOA+), EU Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to all MES work.
* Prepare validation deliverables and help execute them, including specifications, IQ/OQ/PQ test scripts and traceability matrices. Follow computerized system validation (CSV) and computer software assurance (CSA) principles.
* Help with deviations, root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of MES implementation or consulting experience in pharmaceutical, biotech or life sciences.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major MES platform, such as Leucine MES, Körber PAS-X, Emerson Syncade, Siemens Opcenter, FactoryTalk PharmaSuite or GE Proficy.
* A solid understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, electronic batch records, recipes and production execution.
* Practical experience with MES configuration, documentation, testing and validation support.
* Knowledge of system integration, including ERP-MES interfaces, L3-L2 integration and APIs.
* The ability to turn requirements into MES documentation, workflows, configurations and test cases
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder management.
* Comfortable working on your own or as part of a team

**Mandatory**

* Working knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5, data integrity, EU Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11, applied in MES work.
* Hands-on experience with batch processes in pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing.
* Proven experience with MES platforms, electronic batch records, testing and validation.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with digital transformation or Industry 4.0 initiatives.
* Experience with cloud-based or SaaS MES solutions.
* Certification in an MES platform or related technology.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server or Oracle databases.
* Hands-on SAP integration experience, for example PP-PI, MM and QM

**Benefits**

* Be part of a fast-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high-performing team building innovative AI-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: Aerospace FMS. System Testing Engineer
description:
We are hiring!

**Aerospace (FMS) System Testing Engineer**

**Location**
: Bangalore, Karnataka (onsite)

**Experience**
: 3-5 Years

Are you passionate about aviation safety and mission-critical systems?

Qubist Solutions is expanding our engineering team, and we are looking for a rigorous and detail-oriented Aerospace System Testing Engineer. In this role, you will bridge system design, software, and hardware to ensure our airborne products meet the highest levels of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

**What You Will Do:**

* Design, develop, and execute system-level test plans and procedures for complex avionics architectures.
* Ensure bi-directional requirements traceability from aircraft-level safety objectives down to implementation artifacts.
* Configure and manage Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), System Integration Labs (SIL), and automated test environments.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve defects and root-cause anomalies during integration.
* Generate objective evidence and traceability matrices to support SOI (Stage of Involvement) audits and FAA/EASA certification.

**The Standards You Will Drive:**

You will directly apply the core ecosystem of aerospace certification guidelines to our testing lifecycle:

* ARP4754A: Validating system architectures and requirement allocations.
* ARP4761: Utilizing FHA, PSSA, and SSA outputs to drive safety-critical failure-mode testing.
* DO-178C: Executing high-level/system-level software integration tests.
* DO-254: Verifying complex electronic hardware behavior at the system and LRU levels.
* DO-330: Defining Tool Operational Requirements and validating automated verification toolchains.
* DO-356A: Testing system vulnerabilities and verifying airworthiness cybersecurity architectures.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Aerospace, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or related fields.
* 3+ years of hands-on avionics testing and integration experience in a certified program.
* Proficiency in Requirements Management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion).
* Experience with test automation scripting (Python, C/C++) and aviation data buses (ARINC 429, AFDX, MIL-STD-1553B).
* A proven track record of generating certification artifacts for regulatory audits.

**How to Apply:**

Ready to build the future of flight? Click "Apply" on this post or send your resume directly to
**communications@qubistsolutions.com**
with the subject line "Aerospace Testing Engineer - [Your Name]".

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a hybrid employer in Bucharest, Romania, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
  
  
We strive to make competitive offers, allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.

* Health Benefits

* Equity

* Monthly Lunch at Legion

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

**How We Determine What We Pay**

Shape the future of product delivery while crafting solutions that enhance and optimize customer experiences. Lead end-to-end processes, manage dependencies, and liaise with stakeholders as part of a team at the forefront of innovation.
  
  
As an Product Delivery Manager for Document Management Services (DMS), you will be engaged in setup and management of document templates and oversee document generation for multiple business lines. Your primary responsibility is to ensure efficient, accurate, and compliant document creation processes that support lending and business operations. You will execute on the product vision & roadmap of DMS capabilities with a focus on Document Generation, Document Search/Retrieval and transformational initiatives in support of the end-to-end lending document lifecycle and engagement across multiple stakeholders.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end product delivery, including intake, dependency and release management, operationalization, and performance reporting.
* Oversee change management and ensure compliance with risk, controls, and regulatory requirements.
* Manage timelines, resources, and stakeholder communications, proactively resolving blockers.
* Build deep product and business knowledge to serve as a strategic partner to product and technology teams.
* Lead cross-functional teams to implement document management solutions and integrate with banking applications.
* Use data to monitor progress, ensure quality deliverables, and meet success metrics.
* Foster continuous learning and growth within project teams, delegating tasks for efficient delivery.
* Engage with senior management and stakeholders, providing updates and resolving issues and build strong relationships with stakeholders to understand needs and expectations.
* Anticipate challenges, remove obstacles, and drive continuous improvement.
* Promote lean program management, documentation standards, and operational excellence.
* Conduct team retrospectives and adjust approaches to incorporate learnings.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Minimum 7 years' experience in product delivery or document management or related domain.
* Proven ability in operational management, change readiness, and iterative product delivery.
* Skilled in drafting clear, concise status updates and communicating complex information with simplicity.
* Experienced in release management, deployment strategies, and conflict resolution.
* Advanced computer literacy and proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Working knowledge of Large Language models (LLM) and/or Agentic AI

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Proficiency in product delivery tools (e.g., Figma, LUCID, JIRA, JIRA Align, Excel, PowerPoint, Process Mapping Tools) and collaboration platforms (e.g., Confluence, SharePoint)
* Project management and Agile certifications. (Preferred)
* Preference: Experienced with document lifecycle management, template setup, and related technologies (API, cloud storage, OCR, e-signature).
* Knowledgeable in Agile and hybrid methodologies and product development lifecycle

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. title: Field Application Lead Engineer
description:
**WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING**
At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.
**Together, we advance your career.**
The Field Application Engineer position will be the technical interface for AMD’s embedded products with embedded customers in the INDIA region. As an Engineer, the role will be responsible for technical support for AMD’s embedded products, particularly FPGA and embedded x86 products. In this position, the individual will help AMD drive a new era of embedded computing by engaging with large INDIA end customers to demonstrate how AMD technology can be used to address the needs of their business. The role will provide technical support for AMD’s embedded pipeline with a special focus on pre-sales and development support activity as opportunities transition from opportunity to deployment. Building confidence with key customer influencers and overcoming technical objections will be critical for success in the role. Post-sales technical support is also required as the account encounters technical issues. The role will be expected to handle technical escalations that may occur and accelerate resolutions. The Engineer must have a strong technical knowledge base and skill-set but be equally effective in communication with both customers and internal AMD stakeholders. Must be proficient in troubleshooting in embedded platform, system and module-level design evaluations & developing reference designs.
  
  
**The Primary Focus Of The FAE Will Be To**

* Develop technical relationships with target end customer accounts
* Win new embedded opportunities at end customers by establishing technical solutions based on AMD technology
* Work with AMD internal teams across AMD Business Units to build technical presentations and documentation to be delivered in the field
* Deliver technical presentations and sales pitches to influence new AMD sales with customers and partners.

This position will require a broad technical understanding of embedded applications, especially in the communications segment. The position may require specialized knowledge of microprocessor and FPGA architectures, embedded knowledge including operating systems, BIOS & firmware is a plus.
  
  
**JOB REQUIREMENTS & Desired Skills/Exeperience**

* The preferred candidate should have a combination of relevant academic and professional experience. The minimum qualifications associated with this position are Bachelor Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering with 10+ years of experience, or advanced degree with 8+ years of experience.
* Solid hands-on experience with Vivado Design Suite and/or ISE
* Deep level knowledge of FPGA architecture
* Familiarity with various protocols and interfaces like Ethernet, PCIe, DDR etc
* Must demonstrate excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to manage complex problems involving multi-disciplined, cross-functional teams
* High energy, results driven mentality with strong people/leadership skills.
* This position requires an individual with excellent organizational and communication skills with a good balance of hardware, architecture and software expertise. Must be a team player with excellent collaborative skills and superior written and oral communication skills

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Leucine And Celestara**

**12 of the top 15 generic pharma companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.**

Leucine builds AI-powered software that helps pharmaceutical manufacturers stay compliant, audit-ready and productive, so medicines reach patients faster. Manufacturing, QA and QC teams use Leucine across thousands of regulated workflows, from material receipt to batch release, for small molecules, biologics, vaccines and more.

Celestara is our platform for building and running those solutions: data pipelines, agnotology that models the customer's operations, agentic workflows and applications on top.

**About The Role**

You will sit with our customers, understand how their work really gets done, and turn their highest-value problems into live solutions on Celestara. You own each use case end to end: from discovery and business case, through design and build, to UAT, go-live in production, and then its adoption, maintenance and ongoing iteration.

This is a hybrid role. Think product manager, solution architect and hands-on builder in one person, working inside the customer's four walls rather than from a distance. Most of our customers are in pharma, but you do not need prior pharma experience. We care far more about curiosity, empathy for users and the ability to learn a new domain fast.

**Location - India and United States, deployed on-site at customer locations**

**What You'll Do**

Understand the problem

* Embed with customer teams on the shop floor, in QA/QC labs and in offices; shadow users and learn how work actually happens
* Run discovery workshops and interviews; build empathy for users' pain points, constraints and incentives
* Produce clear as-is process maps: steps, roles, hand-offs, systems, data sources and where time, cost and errors pile up

Build the business case

* Run ROI assessments: baseline current effort, cycle time, error and rework rates, and quantify the value of the future state
* Prioritise use cases with the customer by value, feasibility and time to impact

Reimagine the solution on Celestara

* Design the to-be process and solution in the context of the platform, not as a one-off workaround
* Translate requirements into a solution design: data sources and transformation pipelines, ontology and data model, agentic workflows, application screens and user journeys, integrations and access controls
* Write crisp specs and user stories; make trade-offs and say no when scope does not serve the outcome

Deliver from UAT to production

* Configure and build on Celestara, hands-on, working with our product and engineering teams for anything new
* Plan and run UAT with customer users; triage feedback, fix issues and drive sign-off
* Lead go-live, hyper care and adoption; measure the outcomes against the ROI baseline
* Support validation and documentation needed in a regulated environment, with help from our domain experts

Own the use case after go-live

* Drive adoption: train users, track usage and close the gaps that stop people from relying on the solution
* Maintain the use case in production: monitor pipelines, workflows and agents, resolve issues and manage changes under the customer's change-control process
* Iterate continuously: gather feedback, measure impact against the ROI baseline and ship improvements release after release

Be the voice of the customer

* Feed field insights back to product: patterns across customers, gaps in the platform, ideas for reusable components and templates
* Build trusted relationships with users, process owners and senior stakeholders; identify the next use cases to expand into

**Requirements**

**What we're looking for**

**Customer and problem obsession**
. You listen first, ask sharp questions and can explain a user's problem better than they can.

**Product thinking.**
Experience as a product manager, solutions consultant, business analyst or similar; you can go from a messy problem to a prioritised, well-specified solution.

**Process and value analysis.**
You have done as-is/to-be process mapping and can build a credible ROI or business case with real numbers.

**Technical fluency.**
You already understand, or can quickly learn, how modern data and AI platforms fit together:

* data integration, transformation and pipelines (ETL/ELT)
* data modelling and ontologies (entities, relationships, semantics)
* agentic and LLM-powered workflows, automation and orchestration
* application design: user journeys, screens, roles and permissions
* APIs and enterprise system integration

**Hands-on builder.**
Comfortable configuring a platform, writing SQL, and scripting (e.g. Python) to get things working; you do not wait for someone else to build.

**Delivery ownership.**
You have taken work through UAT and into production and stayed accountable for adoption and outcomes.

**Communication.**
Clear written and verbal English; equally at ease with an operator on the floor and a VP in a steering committee.

**Ready to be on the ground.**
Willing to be deployed at customer sites in India or the US and travel as needed.

**Fast learner**
. Comfortable picking up a complex, regulated domain like pharma manufacturing and quality. No prior pharma knowledge required.

**Nice to have**

* Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or implementation lead at an enterprise SaaS, data or AI platform company
* Exposure to platforms built on ontologies or semantic layers, or to low-code/no-code application builders
* Hands-on work with LLMs, prompt design, RAG or agent frameworks
* Background in manufacturing, life sciences, quality or other regulated industries (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, CSV/CSA)
* An engineering, computer science, data or operations degree, or equivalent experience
* 3-8 years experience (indicative; strong builders with less are welcome)

**Benefits**

**What success looks like**

* By 30 days - Learned Celestara hands-on, shadowed a live deployment and grasped the basics of pharma manufacturing and quality workflows
* By 90 days - Owned discovery for a customer use case: as-is map, ROI case and a Celestara solution design the customer has signed off
* By 180 - days Taken at least one use case through UAT into production, with measurable adoption and impact, and identified the next use cases with that customer

**Why join us**

* Real impact. Your work helps medicines get made right and reach patients faster. Ownership. You own outcomes, not tickets, with direct access to customers, product and leadership
* Breadth. Product, data, AI and operations in one role; a fast track into product leadership, solution architecture or customer leadership
* Frontier tech in the real world. Put agentic AI and ontology-driven applications into production in one of the most demanding industries

**Other Benefits**

* Market leading compensation + uncapped variable
* Opportunity for fast-track growth & leadership
* Work with a purpose-driven, global team transforming an essential industry
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: Senior/Principal Application Engineer
description:
**Nexperia**
is a world-class company in semiconductor development and in-house production. A proven global player with an entrepreneurial mentality. At our core is an 13,000+ strong international network with a singular focus. Built on passion and commitment to our work, belief in our goals and a drive to succeed regardless of the challenges we face. We support, reward and challenge individuals equally, in a dynamic and energetic environment.
  
  
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**
The Senior/Principal Application Engineer will drive the development of reference designs and application boards with a strong focus on BMS, OBC, DCDC applications in light electric vehicles (LEV) that showcase Nexperia’s portfolio. The person will play a critical role in bridging product development and customer requirements by translating device capabilities into practical, production ready hardware solutions
  
  
This role is central to enabling customer adoption and accelerating time-to-market through high-quality design collaterals, hands-on validation and technical support
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design, develop, and validate reference designs and application boards using Nexperia’s discrete, analog, and power IC solutions
* Create schematics, perform component selection, and collaborate on PCB layout to optimize performance, efficiency, cost, thermal behavior, and reliability
* Perform comprehensive electrical, thermal, and system-level validation, including efficiency analysis, switching characterization, transient response testing, thermal profiling, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance evaluation and troubleshooting
* Provide application-focused technical support to customers and sales teams by troubleshooting designs, supporting design-in activities, participating in customer engagements, and representing Nexperia at workshops, conferences, and exhibitions
* Create and maintain high-quality technical collateral such as application notes, design guides, simulation models, user manuals, and web-based application content
* Build deep application expertise and translate customer insights into future product opportunities by collaborating with marketing, R&D, and system architects to define requirements, identify use cases, and contribute to product roadmap development

**Skills /Competencies**
Hard Skills:
  
  

* Technical experience in PCB design and layout – Altium, KiCad
* Familiarity with simulation tools and industry standards - Matlab/Simulink, LT Spice, Plecs, Thermal analysis, EMC compatibility
* Switching behaviour, losses and efficiency optimization

Soft Skills:
  
  

* Strong analytical and system-level thinking
* Hands-on, problem-solving mindset with attention to detail
* Ability to work in cross-functional and global teams
* Customer focused approach with strong ownership
* Excellent presentation and technical writing skills
* English business fluent verbal and written

**JOB SPECIFICATIONS:**

* Education/ studies: BSEE. MSEE preferred
* 5-8 years of experience in application engineering, hardware design or power electronics
* Proven experience developing reference designs or evaluation boards
* Strong knowledge of BMS architectures with all safety measures is advantageous
* Familiarity with industry standards such as ISO26262, UL standards, and AIS is desirable

**Talent acquisition based on Nexperia vacancies is not appreciated. Nexperia job adverts are Nexperia copyright © material and the word Nexperia® is a registered trademark.**

Our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to all, and we consider all applicants fairly, as well as providing a safe work environment and reasonable adjustments where requested.

1–4 Years

B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical or Aeronautical Engineering
  
  
**About RTX**
At RTX, approximately 185,000 talented professionals come together with a shared purpose: solving some of the world’s most complex challenges and creating technologies that connect and protect our world.
  
  
With three market-leading businesses, world-class operations, and significant investment in research and development, RTX offers an environment where engineering expertise meets innovation at scale.
  
  
**About Collins Aerospace**
Collins Aerospace is a global leader in technologically advanced and intelligent aerospace solutions. With deep engineering expertise and a comprehensive portfolio of products and services, we help customers meet the evolving demands of the global aerospace and defense industry.
  
  
**Join Collins Aerospace and turn your technical expertise into publications that help keep aircraft flying safely and efficiently.**
The Opportunity
  
  
We are looking for a
**Technical Publications Engineer**
to join our team and contribute to the creation, review, and revision of critical aerospace technical documentation.
  
  
In this role, you will work closely with engineering data, drawings, and change inputs to develop accurate, clear, and compliant
**Component Maintenance Manuals (CMMs), Service Bulletins (SBs), and Aircraft Maintenance Manuals (AMMs)**
.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who understands aerospace fundamentals, enjoys technical writing, and wants to build a career in
**aerospace technical publications and documentation engineering**
.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Create, revise, and review Component Maintenance Manuals (CMMs), Service Bulletins (SBs), and Aircraft Maintenance Manuals (AMMs).

* Interpret and effectively use engineering drawings, specifications, change notices, and other engineering inputs.
* Analyze change drivers and incorporate engineering changes accurately into technical publications.
* Ensure technical documentation complies with applicable aerospace technical publication standards and customer requirements.
* Develop and maintain Standard Work and Work Instructions for creating and revising technical publications.
* Review documentation for technical accuracy, completeness, consistency, readability, and compliance.
* Collaborate with engineering and cross-functional teams to resolve technical queries and documentation gaps.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives related to technical publication processes, quality, and productivity.
* Provide guidance and technical training to team members on CMM creation, tools, processes, and applicable standards.

What You Will Learn
  
  

* Advanced practices for developing aerospace technical publications.
* End-to-end CMM, SB, and AMM development and revision processes.
* Application of aerospace documentation standards, including ATA 100, iSpec 2200, and S1000D.
* Techniques for converting complex engineering information into clear, user-friendly maintenance procedures.
* Best practices in interpreting engineering drawings, change documentation, and technical data.
* Quality and compliance expectations within a global aerospace and defense organization.
* Opportunities to work with experienced aerospace engineers and technical publication professionals.

**Basic Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering or Aeronautical Engineering.
* 1–4 years of relevant experience in Aerospace Technical Publications.
* Hands-on experience in the creation and/or revision of CMMs, Service Bulletins, and/or AMMs.
* 1+ Years of Strong aerospace fundamentals and technical publication principles.
* 1+ Years of Working knowledge of ATA 100, iSpec 2200, and S1000D standards.
* Experience developing or revising technical procedures and maintenance documentation.
* Ability to understand and interpret engineering drawings and engineering change inputs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, engineering-driven environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ Years of Strong experience in writing Assembly, Disassembly, Inspection, and Repair procedures.
* 1+ Years of Experience working with aerospace maintenance documentation and publication tools.
* Knowledge of document configuration, revision control, and change management.
* 1+ Years of Experience developing Standard Work / Work Instructions for technical publication processes.
* Ability to train and mentor team members on CMM creation, tools, and technical publication standards.
* Strong attention to detail with a commitment to documentation accuracy and quality.
* Ability to analyze complex technical information and communicate it in a clear, structured manner.

Why Join Collins Aerospace?
  
  
At Collins Aerospace, your work contributes directly to products and technologies that support the global aerospace industry. You will have the opportunity to work on technically challenging programs, collaborate with highly skilled engineering teams, and develop expertise in one of the most critical areas of aerospace engineering—
**safe, accurate, and reliable technical documentation**
.
  
  
**If you are an engineer who enjoys transforming complex engineering data into precise, compliant, and easy-to-use technical documentation, we would love to hear from you.**
**Apply Now**
**Ready to shape the future of aerospace through engineering excellence and technical publications?**
**Join Collins Aerospace and help turn engineering knowledge into documentation that enables safe, reliable aircraft maintenance.**

All qualified applications will be given careful consideration without regard to ethnicity, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Lead Business Process Engineer (Process Automation) - Officer
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are seeking a hands-on process and knowledge engineer to join Alpha Intelligence, State Street’s AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations. You will help transform complex processes end to end — understanding how work is done today, designing simpler future-state processes, and enabling automation and AI solutions that improve speed, control and client outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate is analytical, structured and delivery-focused, comfortable working directly with subject-matter experts, and able to own a workstream of process discovery and documentation end to end with limited supervision.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
Alpha Intelligence goes beyond documenting processes — we redesign how Alpha implementations are delivered. This role connects process discovery, future-state design, automation and AI, implementation and continuous improvement.
  
  
**About The Team — Alpha Intelligence**
Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front-to-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.
  
  
We operate as one global team across the US, UK, Europe, India and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Conduct process discovery through interviews, shadowing, walkthroughs and system observation with implementation and operations subject-matter experts.
* Own end-to-end process transformation for assigned workstreams, from discovery and future-state design through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Map and assess current-state processes, including handoffs, systems, data, controls and exceptions, to identify root causes, effort, risk and friction.
* Design simpler, standardized future-state processes that improve controls and use the right mix of people, process, data, automation and AI.
* Structure and tag content for search, RAG and agent use, ensuring knowledge assets are discoverable, accurate and maintainable.
* Validate process and knowledge assets with subject-matter experts, manage signoffs and maintain version control.
* Prioritize redesign, automation and AI opportunities, and define the expected benefits and success measures.
* Turn approved future-state designs into clear requirements and implementation plans, working with automation, AI, technology, operations and change teams.
* Support rollout and adoption, track results, and use feedback to improve the process over time.
* Maintain accurate status, progress and delivery reporting for your assigned workstream, escalating risks and blockers early.
* Coordinate across regional teams and time zones to enable seamless handoffs and effective dependency management.

**What We Value**

* Strong structured thinking and attention to detail — precision matters in process and knowledge engineering.
* Curiosity and persistence in getting to the real process, not just the documented one.
* Self-driven delivery with the ability to produce quality outcomes with minimal follow-up.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, especially in documentation.
* A collaborative mindset and comfort working with senior subject-matter experts and global stakeholders.

**Experience And Capabilities That Will Help You Succeed**

* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in business process analysis, process documentation, operations, transformation or automation delivery within financial services.
* Working knowledge of investment management or capital markets operations across front, middle and back office and the trade lifecycle.
* Hands-on experience with process mapping and documentation methods and tools, exposure to BPMN, Visio, UiPath Task Capture, ARIS or comparable platforms is beneficial.
* Familiarity with automation platforms such as UiPath and an understanding of what makes a process automatable.
* Good understanding of AI and GenAI concepts, including how structured knowledge and content quality drive RAG and agent performance.
* Strong analytical and documentation skills, with proficiency in relevant collaboration, data and presentation tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Excel or PowerPoint; equivalent tools and transferable experience are welcome.
* Ability to plan, prioritize and deliver milestones in a fast-moving programme environment.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with regional teams, occasional participation outside local working hours may be required for planned handoffs or critical discussions.

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Finance, Management or Information Systems, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Process excellence or automation certifications (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, BPM, UiPath) are an advantage.

**Interested but do not meet every qualification?**
If your experience and transferable skills align with the overall role, we encourage you to apply. We value different paths to building relevant expertise and will consider the full picture of what you can bring to the team.
  
  
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: System Integration Engineer_SEM (Semiconductor)
description:
**Who We Are**
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Location:
  
  
Bangalore,IND
  
  
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
  
  
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
As a Manufacturing Engineer, you are responsible for developing and maintaining methods, operating sequences, and processes in the fabrication of parts, components, subassemblies, and final assemblies. You'll work closely with other engineering functions to coordinate the release of product improvements and new products, and you'll use engineering principles to estimate and reduce manufacturing costs, improve product quality, determine time standards, and make recommendations for tooling and process requirements. Your expertise in lean principles, automation, and continuous improvement will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and achieving higher levels of productivity and cost-effectiveness. You'll develop and use test procedures, evaluate test results, and assess work methods, procedures, and policies to identify root cause issues and solutions that ensure operational success.
  
  
We are looking for a highly talented integration engineer to join our team and integrate complex multi-disciplinary systems modules (Scanning Electron Microscopes).
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**
As part of our team, you will work together with great people, hands-on with one of the most complex multi-disciplinary systems in the market, putting into practice many of the fields from your studies.
  
  
**Our Group:**
The team is responsible for system Scanning Electron Microscopes integration for Applied Materials - Metrology and Inspection tools before shipment to the customer.
  
  
In addition, we lead R&D prototypes and new products in the organization, with large exposure to the most advanced technologies such as precise mechanics, electronics, motion and optics.
  
  
**What you'll be doing:**
The system integration engineer gets a fully assembled Scanning Electron Microscopes. His job is to calibrate and test a multi-disciplinary system, in clean room environment, from start to end until shipment to the customer includes complicated troubleshooting, investigation and engineering solutions proposal.
  
  
Since we are talking about a Scanning Electron Microscopes with Very high complexity multi-disciplinary system involving several modules and disciplines, such as E-Beam (Electron-beam Microscopy), high-end optics, lasers, precise mechanics, RF, motion and control etc., the essence of our work requires high system understanding, deep engineering knowledge and high accountability level.
