* Responsible for technical support to meet the system’s specifications & team KPIs: on time delivery, Operational aspects of the tool’s integration process, Lab Tool fleet performance

* Working 5 days/week from Bangalore Office (Saturday & Sunday a must).

**What should you have?**

* Bachelor's degree B. Tech Electrical Engineer
* 2-4 years of relevant technical experience: System integration experience or other high complex technical background - Advantage
* 10 - 30% travelling
* Team player, Highly Creative and Proactive
* High level of independent work with constant drive for improvement

This is a physically demanding position that often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.

**Job Description:**
The Manager, Operations Enablement provides non-site-based study operations support across intake and triage, study progress documentation, close-out tracking, fair market value support, cross-functional coordination, investigator-initiated and collaborative research contracting support, evidence package upload, and vendor artifact storage. The role delivers consistent, high-quality, and traceable operational execution across repeatable evidence generation workflows, enabling Global Evidence Generation teams to focus on scientific strategy, study prioritization, final decisions, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Manager, Operations Enablement coordinates study operations activities across multiple non-site-based study types. The role manages intake completeness, review logistics, study documentation, close-out packages, FMV records, contracting materials, vendor artifacts, and evidence package archival. The role works with Global Evidence Generation, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Procurement, local operating companies, vendors, and study teams, escalating strategic, scientific, budget, legal, compliance, or non-standard documentation questions to the appropriate owner.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute:**

* Receive and log evidence generation, collaborative research, study support, and contracting requests, including requester, asset, indication, region, timing, request type, and completeness status.
* Conduct first-pass completeness checks and route requests to the appropriate Global Evidence Generation, portfolio, study, or functional owner.
* Coordinate cross-functional synopsis and protocol review logistics, including reviewer lists, timelines, meeting scheduling, comment collation, version control, and action tracking.
* Escalate conflicting scientific, strategic, legal, or compliance comments to Global Evidence Generation for resolution.
* Maintain study documentation checklists, status trackers, milestone updates, open-action logs, and repository records for assigned non-site-based studies.
* Prepare study status summaries for study leads or governance review, including progress updates, risks, dependencies, and missing documentation.
* Apply standard close-out procedures, collect final study documents, track vendor, budget, and contract close-out actions, and store final close-out packages.
* Flag missing documents, unresolved payments, pending approvals, open risks, or study-specific exceptions to the appropriate owner.
* Support first-pass FMV documentation, rate-table checks, assumption capture, and archival of FMV outcomes with contract packages.

* Store vendor artifacts, statements of work, scorecards, correspondence, contract records, and performance documentation with correct metadata, access controls, retention category, and study linkage.
* Maintain traceable logs for intake, review, contracting, close-out, vendor artifacts, and evidence package archival.

* Use approved digital, automation, and AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to support intake, documentation tracking, review coordination, issue identification, and operational reporting while maintaining accuracy, traceability, privacy, and human oversight.

* A degree in a scientific, medical, life sciences, pharmacy, public health, operations, health economics, or related discipline is required.

* Working knowledge of evidence generation study operations, intake management, documentation tracking, study close-out, and cross-functional review coordination.
* Familiarity with investigator-initiated research, collaborative research, contracting workflows, FMV documentation, Legal review routing, and vendor artifact management.
* Experience maintaining audit-ready repositories, trackers, version histories, and documentation packages.
* Strong coordination skills across Global Evidence Generation, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Procurement, local operating companies, vendors, and study teams.
* Familiarity with iEnvision Research Module, Veeva Vault, document repositories, procurement systems, or equivalent tools is preferred.
* High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Comfort using approved automation and AI-enabled tools for defined operational activities, with appropriate judgment regarding accuracy, privacy, traceability, compliance, and escalation.
* Fluent English is required; additional languages are advantageous.

title: Product Support Specialist
description:
**Description**
*Position at Ziff Davis*
Product Support Specialist
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
The Opportunity:
  
  
We are seeking a Product Support Specialist to act as the bridge between Dwell subscribers and our engineering team. In this role, you will report to the director of revenue products. In this hybrid role, you will spend part of your time leading high-touch customer support and relationship management, and the other part translating those frontline insights into the product roadmap. You understand user pain points firsthand because you talk to customers every day, and you have the technical and strategic skills to build permanent solutions into our software or service offerings.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Customer Service & Advocacy
  
  

* Customer Support Response Management: Handle approximately 200 customer support tickets per week for Dwell brand subscribers, including email tickets and phone support for customer voicemails
* Payment and Account Administration: Utilize Stripe platform to resolve customer access issues, update user email addresses and payment methods, and address general customer concerns
* Issue Analysis and Reporting: Create reports documenting common customer support issues in Google Docs/Sheets format to enable product teams to prioritize system improvements and enhance customer experience
* Third-Party Coordination: Collaborate with Dwell Magazine's fulfillment partner, CDS Global, to resolve complex customer issues that cannot be addressed through Stripe's platform capabilities
* Client Enablement: Create and update customer-facing knowledge bases, release notes, training materials, and troubleshooting guides.
* Relationship Management: Build trust-based relationships with subscribers, gathering qualitative feedback on product experience.

Product Management
  
  

* Feedback Synthesis: Analyze support ticket trends, churn reasons, and customer feature requests to identify systemic product gaps.
* Roadmap Prioritization: Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing urgent customer fixes with long-term strategic product goals.
* Requirements Definition: Write Product Requirements Documents and user stories for the engineering and design teams.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate with engineering, QA, and marketing to guide features from concept through launch, ensuring the support team is fully trained before release.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) including Customer Satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS), Customer Retention/Churn, and Feature Adoption Rates.
* Report monthly insights to executive leadership regarding how product updates impact customer happiness and business revenue.

Job Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience: 3+ years of combined experience in customer service management, customer success, or technical support, alongside 2+ years in an associate product manager or product-adjacent role.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Customer Empathy: Exceptional listening, patience, and written/verbal communication skills with a proven track record of de-escalating frustrated clients.
* Product Sense: Ability to look at a repetitive customer complaint and conceptualize a scalable, software-driven solution.
* Experience using modern helpdesk software (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud) and product management tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Linear, Asana).
* Preferred: basic technical literacy (familiarity with API logs, SQL, or web technologies) to effectively communicate tradeoffs with engineering teams.

**About Dwell**
For over two decades, Dwell has been the definitive voice of modern architecture and design, exploring how smart, intentional design makes everyday life better across print, Dwell.com, and social channels.
  
  
**About Ziff Davis**
Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, connectivity, health, cybersecurity, and martech. Today, Ziff Davis is focused on seven key verticals – Technology, Connectivity, Shopping, Entertainment, Health & Wellness, Cybersecurity and Marketing Technology. Its brands include IGN, Mashable, RetailMeNot, PCMag, Humble Bundle, Spiceworks, Ookla (Speedtest), RootMetrics, Everyday Health, BabyCenter, Moz, iContact and Vipre Security.
  
  
Our Benefits
  
  
Lifestyle offers competitive salaries in addition to robust, health and wellness-focused benefits. We are committed to a work-life balance with paid time off when you need it.
  
  
At Ziff Davis, we remain dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. We offer Employee Resource Groups, company-sponsored events, and regular opportunities for professional growth through educational support, mentorship programs, and career development resources. Our employees are recognized and celebrated through employee engagement programs and recognition awards.
  
  
If you're seeking a dynamic and collaborative work environment where you can see the direct impact of your performance and thrive both personally and professionally, then Lifestyle is the place for you.
  
  
Ziff Davis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. At Ziff Davis, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) has always been about fairness, equal opportunity, and belonging. DEI enables us to attract and retain the best talent, regardless of background or circumstances, while enabling our thousands of employees worldwide to thrive. If you have a disability or learning difficulty that requires accommodation, please let us know by sending an email to [email protected].

title: Senior Technical Specialist - AI and Enterprise Applications
description:
LSEG is rapidly expanding its portfolio of AI-powered products and services, delivering innovative solutions that help customers and colleagues access insights, streamline workflows, and make informed decisions. As adoption of these technologies continues to grow, so does the need for specialized support expertise.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Specialist - AI and Enterprise Applications, you will provide expert-level support for both AI-enabled and non-AI enterprise applications, serving as a key escalation point for complex issues. You will collaborate closely with customers, colleagues, product teams, and engineers to troubleshoot problems, drive resolution, and continuously improve the support experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilitie**
s
  
  
Technical Support & Incident Management
  
  

* Act as the senior escalation point for complex application support issues that cannot be resolved through standard support channels.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents across AI-enabled and enterprise applications.
* Troubleshoot AI-specific issues, including response quality concerns, prompt execution failures, model output inconsistencies, retrieval and context-related issues, knowledge-source availability, and integration failures between AI services and connected systems.
* Ensure accurate case documentation, timely updates, and resolution within established service level agreements (SLAs).
* Perform root cause analysis and coordinate resolution efforts across multiple teams.
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across multiple layers, including:

+ Authentication and identity management (SSO, OAuth, OIDC, or similar)
+ Authorization and access permissions
+ Data connectivity and retrieval
+ Application integrations and APIs
+ User interface and user experience issues

**AI Solutions Support**

* Solid understanding of AI concepts — including how large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and tool-calling/MCP protocols function at a product level
* Understand and troubleshoot tool-calling frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations, and connected data sources.
* Support integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems, including business applications, databases, APIs, identity platforms, and knowledge repositories.
* Analyze system dependencies across cloud services, authentication services, application platforms, and enterprise workflows.
* Awareness of Responsible AI, privacy, security, and governance considerations
* Assist customers and stakeholders in understanding AI workflows, prompt engineering concepts, grounding mechanisms, and responsible AI practices.
* Support the adoption and optimization of AI technologies within enterprise environments.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and support teams to improve AI solution performance and customer experience.
* Serve as a trusted advisor for AI-powered products and enterprise solutions.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Provide professional and proactive support to external customers and internal users.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Manage customer expectations throughout the support lifecycle.
* Deliver a high-quality user experience through effective issue ownership and follow-through.
* Identify and escalate business-critical issues appropriately.

Knowledge Management & Enablement
  
  

* Develop and maintain knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and support documentation.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to permanent resolutions through collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.
* Support onboarding and user enablement activities by providing guidance and training materials.
* Stay informed of product enhancements and releases to proactively prepare support teams and users.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Serve as the voice of customers and users by providing actionable feedback to Product, Engineering, Data, and Service Management teams.
* Partner with access management, licensing, and entitlement teams to resolve user access and permission-related issues.
* Facilitate effective communication between support and development functions.
* Participate in incident, service reviews and operational improvement initiatives.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to enhance support processes, tools, and service delivery.
* Track and analyse operational metrics, including case volumes, resolution times, customer satisfaction, and recurring issue trends.
* Contribute to operational readiness for emerging technologies and AI-enabled products.
* Share best practices and mentor colleagues within the support organization.

**Skills And Experience**

* Experience in a customer-facing technical support or service management role, ideally within a SaaS, data, or financial technology environment
* Solid understanding of AI concepts — including:

+ Large Language Models (LLMs)
+ Generative AI applications
+ AI agents and orchestration
+ Prompt engineering principles
+ Tool-calling frameworks and MCP concepts
+ Retrieval and grounding approaches

* Understanding of prompt design, context management, and retrieval mechanisms
* Awareness of Responsible AI, privacy, security, and governance considerations
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills — ability to isolate root causes across authentication, data access, UI, and integration layers
* Interpretation of logs, telemetry, error codes, and system diagnostics
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to convey technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Familiarity with case management platforms (e.g., Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow)
* Experience working with authentication and entitlement systems (SSO, OAuth, OIDC, or similar)

Core Competencies
  
  

* AI Product Knowledge
* Enterprise Systems Integration
* Root Cause Analysis
* Technical Troubleshooting
* Critical Thinking
* Customer Obsession
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Problem Solving
* Communication and Stakeholder Management
* Continuous Learning and Adaptability

A successful AI and Enterprise Specialist can explain how AI solutions work at a product level, understand how they interact with enterprise systems and data sources, and quickly identify whether issues stem from authentication, permissions, integrations, configuration, data access, or AI-specific behaviors. They combine strong customer-facing communication skills with the technical expertise needed to drive issues through resolution and enable successful AI adoption across the enterprise.
  
  
**Career Stage:**
Senior Associate
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
  
  
Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.

title: RC FS-BT INS- P and C NON USA-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Business Consultant -Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Worked on multiple Business transformation, upgrade and modernization programs.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.

* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).

* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 - Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 - Personal Insurance, AINS 23 - Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 - General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.

* We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. title: Online Field Applications Engineer
description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.

Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

**Job Description**

A personalised technical support engineer for mass market customers & channel partners, providing pre & post sales technical support to a geographical region and its customers, partner FAE and Renesas Sales teams.
  
  
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Support customers on popular Catalog Embedded Products (MCU/MPU/Wireless)
* Post sales: Provide personalised technical support online (email / teams etc) to understand customers problems & solve them with smart efficient use of resources (own knowledge & product line resources)
* Pre Sales: Work with sales teams on understanding customers' requirements (product & application or use case) to position REN products and solutions in an advantageous way.
* Support Partner FAE in distribution on enabling them win with REN products & solutions.
* Solving technical issues raised by partner FAE bring to you .
* Providing them with training materials / collaterals / demos etc they need to convince customers to use REN products or solutions.
* Be their ‘go to’ advocate within REN to enable partner FAE to be successful.
* Actively Participate in local business reviews with the relevant sales teams & partners and escalate / highlight gaps and issues needed to win customer sockets.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's from Computer Science / Engineering Course or equivalent in relevant discipline
* 2 to 6 Years of experience.
* C programming know-how and experience in developing SW in embedded platforms
* Experienced with typical IDE’s & tool chains (e.g. Keil/IAR/ Eclipse based etc.) & debuggers.
* Experience in typical hardware peripherals and drivers
* Experienced with SW and/or HW debugging techniques.
* Understanding / experience of one or more Operating Systems (e.g. FreeRTOS, Azure OS, Zephyr etc.)
* Knowledgeable in high-level embedded C / device drivers / middleware / utilities.
* Knowledgeable in Communication Protocols & Interface buses like I2C, UART and SPI / Clocking & Timers / memory utilization etc.
* Any wireless experience (Bluetooth / WiFi) an advantage
* Any experience of working with customers / partners an advantage.
* Strong understanding of embedded software development & sound C skills, ideally from developing application firmware /demos etc
* Strong communication skills and be able to work / communicate in a multicultural environment.
* Good questioning techniques: ability to guide conversations via open & closed questions.
* Ability to work with multiple issues in parallel in a fast-moving environment. Will be working on many open issues in parallel.
* Confident in ability to help/communicate complex issues 1-1 (f2f online and via email etc)
* Strong collaboration skills
* Must be interested / passionate about embedded systems and MCU related matters.
* Some limited travel may be necessary (<5%).

**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘
**To Make Our Lives Easier**
.’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power.
  
  
  
  
With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘
**To Make Our Lives Easier**
.’
  
  
  
  
At Renesas, you can:

* **Launch and advance your career**
  in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things.

* **Make a real impact**
  by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people’s lives easier, safe and secure.

* **Maximize your performance and wellbeing**
  in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.

Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?

Join Renesas. Let’s
**Shape the Future**
together.

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

title: Business Execution Consultant
description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Business Execution Consultant as part of the Digital Transformation team within Operational Excellence (COO - AI COE). In this role, you will help drive business transformation through reporting, analytics, automation, and process improvement initiatives that support operational excellence and business outcomes. You will partner with stakeholders across the organization to deliver innovative solutions using Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate while supporting strategic initiatives, enhancing efficiency, and enabling data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and analytics solutions that support business decision-making and operational performance.
* Manage the maintenance, enhancement, and optimization of Power Apps and workflow automation solutions to improve efficiency and user experience.
* Partner with business leaders, stakeholders, subject matter experts, and delivery teams to support strategic initiatives and deliver business value.
* Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into reporting, automation, and process improvement solutions.
* Drive requirements by leveraging product knowledge, business needs, and industry best practices.
* Support product management activities and contribute to the strategic direction of assigned products, services, and business solutions.
* Analyze operational and performance metrics to identify trends, risks, process improvement opportunities, and automation solutions.
* Review requirements and independently develop test scenarios and test scripts to support solution validation and quality assurance activities.
* Perform testing activities in collaboration with process owners and business teams, including test coordination, defect management, issue resolution, and user acceptance testing support.
* Monitor project and pre-release activities, recommend improvements, and help ensure deliverables are completed within established timelines.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies and collaborate with stakeholders to address risks, issues, and delivery challenges.
* Monitor and enhance key performance indicators while identifying opportunities to improve operational effectiveness and business outcomes.
* Prepare and deliver reports, presentations, and recommendations to support decision-making and stakeholder communications.
* Collaborate closely with U.S. and global stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver effective solutions.
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to less experienced team members, as appropriate.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience developing and supporting Power BI dashboards, reporting solutions, and data visualization tools.
* Experience with Power Apps and Power Automate, including workflow automation and process optimization.
* Strong technology background with a solid understanding of system interactions, integrations, and application capabilities.
* Ability to effectively articulate product capabilities and technical solutions to business users and application owners.
* Experience with product management, business execution, digital transformation, or process improvement initiatives.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables.
* Experience gathering and translating business requirements into scalable business solutions.

title: Document Controller
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
  
  
**About Us:**
SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.
  
  
**Purpose**

* As a Document Controller, you manage and maintain the organization's documentation processes, ensuring that all documents are accurately recorded, securely stored, and easily retrievable. Oversee document control procedures, enforce compliance with regulatory and organizational standards, and support project teams by ensuring timely access to necessary documents.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain the organization’s document control processes, ensuring that all project documents are accurately captured, organized, and accessible.
* Implement and enforce document control procedures and standards, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and organizational policies.
* Coordinate the distribution and retrieval of documents, ensuring that the right documents are available to the right people at the right time.
* Ensure the security and confidentiality of documents, implementing access controls and monitoring systems to protect sensitive information.
* Maintain organized and efficient document archives, both digital and physical, ensuring that all documents are properly labeled, indexed, and stored for easy retrieval.
* Monitor document workflows, tracking the status of document submissions, reviews, and approvals to ensure timely completion.
* Assist in the digitization of physical documents, converting paper records into digital formats and integrating them into electronic document management systems (EDMS).
* Provide training and support to staff on document control procedures and the use of document management systems, ensuring consistent practices across the organization.
* Collaborate with project teams and external vendors to manage the flow of documentation, ensuring that all documents are accurate, up-to-date, and properly filed.
* Report on document control activities to management, providing updates on the status of document processing and any issues that may arise.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in information management, records management, library science, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Records Manager (CRM), Certified Information Professional (CIP), or Electronic Records Management (ERM) certification are recommended. Proficiency in document control processes, records management, and the use of document management systems (DMS) is essential.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in document control, records management, or a related field, with experience in managing and organizing documents within an organization.
* Proven experience in implementing and maintaining document control systems to ensure accurate and efficient management of project documents and records.
* Strong technical background with hands-on experience in following and enforcing document control policies, procedures, and best practices to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
* Experience in managing the entire document lifecycle, including document creation, review, approval, distribution, and archiving, ensuring that all documents are properly controlled and accessible.
* Proficiency in using document control tools and software, such as SharePoint, Aconex, or Documentum, to manage document workflows, version control, and access permissions.
* Knowledge of information governance, data protection regulations, and compliance standards such as ISO 9001, ensuring that document control practices align with these requirements.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain document accuracy, traceability, and compliance within the organization.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with project teams, stakeholders, and external partners to ensure that document control objectives are met.
* Relevant certifications such as Certified Records Manager (CRM), Certified Information Professional (CIP), or Electronic Records Management (ERM) certification are preferred.

Compliance
  
  
Digital savvy
  
  
Data collection and entry
  
  
Document Management Coordination
  
  
Data Management
  
  
Document Management

title: Staff, Technology Strategy
description:
Position Summary...We are seeking a Staff, Technology Strategy to join the AI Acceleration team within Walmart Global Technology India. This senior individual contributor role will help shape and execute the strategy for responsible, practical and measurable AI adoption across the technology organization. The role sits at the intersection of technology strategy, applied AI, business analysis, change management, enablement and program execution—translating emerging AI capabilities into scalable ways of working that improve associate productivity, leadership decision-making, and business outcomes.
  
  
In this role, you will work independently across multiple strategic priorities, converting ambiguous organization challenges into structured strategies, executive narratives, measurement frameworks, enablement programs, and execution plans. You will partner with product, engineering, data, communications, people, finance, legal/risk and other tech stakeholders to build alignment, drive adoption, surface insights and connect AI investments to clear usage, value, and impact metrics.
  
  
**About Team**
The AI Acceleration team is a small, high-impact team within Walmart Global Technology India focused on making AI a practical, responsible, and measurable part of how associates think, operate and deliver enterprise value. The team works at the intersection of technology strategy, applied AI, business analysis, change management and enablement—building the frameworks, programs, communities, labs, measurement systems and executive narratives that help teams adopt AI with clarity and confidence. This role sits at the strategic and analytical core of the charter, connecting emerging AI capabilities to real business workflows, adoption outcomes, leadership decision-making, and scalable ways of working across the organization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Understand Business Context

Synthesize complex unstructured asks into structured problem statements
  
  
Translate requirements into projects, activities and tasks in alignment with the overall strategy
  
  
Serve as an interpreter and conduit to connect business needs with tangible solutions and results
  
  
Recommend new processes and AI first ways of working
  
  

* Strategy Planning & Development

Conduct ongoing industry & internal research on AI, agentic tools, emerging Tech capabilities, AI skilling needs and enterprise AI adoption best practices & trends.
  
  
Create custom frameworks for evaluating different options and helping with decisions
  
  
Identify critical success factors and related key performance indicators for successful strategy planning and implementation
  
  
Synthesize insights into crisp point-of-view strategy documents and executive-level storyboards for senior stakeholder presentations.
  
  
Build a clear point of view on current AI adoption and integration into day-to-day work (what is used, by whom, for which workflows, and why).
  
  

* Influencing without authority and building stakeholder consensus

Communicate articulately and concisely in stakeholder meetings involving multiple teams
  
  
Convey complex information and address ambiguity in a simplified manner to bring everyone onto a common understanding
  
  
Build productive, collaborative relationships with stakeholders
  
  
Influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders across levels within StratOps and outside like Communications, People/HR, Finance, Legal/Risk, Product & Tech to initiate and drive change initiatives across the organization.
  
  
Independently prepare clear, concise, logically structured reusable materials (talking points, FAQs, narrative arcs, showcase content) to support leadership alignment and communications.
  
  
Seek and provide constructive feedback, anticipate stakeholder needs/questions and respond appropriately
  
  
Design and run change plans for AI initiatives: stakeholder mapping, impact assessments, change journeys, comms plans and reinforcement mechanisms
  
  
Tailor the strategy by stakeholders to garner Buy-in
  
  
Partner & influence cross-functional teams
  
  

* Measurement, analytics and leadership reporting

Define and instrument enterprise measurement framework for AI cultural change and adoption
  
  
Create leadership reporting channels and regular executive updates (dashboards, QBR content, steering committee readouts)
  
  

* Technology Acumen

Exhibit AI practitioner knowledge with hands on experience in using AI for research, strategy building, storytelling and vibe-coding custom automations/ dashboard
  
  
Understand available tech products, as well as their strengths and weaknesses, to compare choices
  
  
Assesses different programming tools, methodologies, frameworks and the overarching systems architecture
  
  
Understands AI, frameworks, and tools used across multiple products within the domain to make informed discussions with engineering teams to prioritize efforts versus features and assess the risks of certain features
  
  
Owns business and user acceptance testing of products/features
  
  

* Training, enablement and AI literacy

Support leadership training programs and role-based AI enablement curriculum curation
  
  
Translate training needs into actionable requirements and coordinate with training team to evaluate content options and deliver it.
  
  
Run high-touch enablement mechanisms (office hours, workflow labs, clinics) to accelerate adoption and confidence.
  
  
Work with Tech team to define AI Lab/ assessment requirements and get it setup for experimentation
  
  

* Program management

Own program management for the AI acceleration charter initiatives: planning, execution tracking, risk/issue management, and stakeholder coordination.
  
  
Develop, prioritize and coordinate work plans and reviews project schedules, costs, milestones, communications, and documentation
  
  
Follow project management methodologies by tracking and monitoring work, holding project teams accountable to timelines, and ensuring adherence to project milestones
  
  
Identify potential project risks and develop strategies to mitigate risks, prioritizing and ensuring the resolution of critical issues.
  
  
Create communication plans which determines communication level, frequency, detail and the distribution of status updates
  
  
Minimize the impacts of project changes
  
  
Maintain a single source of truth for artifacts (roadmaps, playbooks, comms assets, metrics, and decision logs).
  
  
**What You'll Bring**
Basic Qualifications
  
  
10+ years of experience in technology strategy, management consulting, product strategy or a related senior individual contributor role within a large technology or GCC organization.
  
  
Proven ability to translate ambiguous business needs into structured problem statements, workstreams, projects, and measurable outcomes aligned to enterprise strategy.
  
  
Experience developing strategy artefacts such as executive narratives, decision frameworks, business cases, ROI models, roadmaps, dashboards, and senior-leadership readouts.
  
  
Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex technical and business topics into crisp storyboards, written narratives and presentations for Senior and Executive leadership.
  
  
Hands-on working knowledge of generative AI and applied AI concepts, including prompt workflows, responsible-use practices, hallucination and bias risks, retrieval-augmented generation, privacy/IP considerations and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
Practical experience using AI tools to improve strategy, analysis, automation, prototyping, reporting or workflow productivity.
  
  
Experience defining adoption, usage, value and impact metrics; building measurement frameworks; and translating insights into action plans for senior stakeholders.
  
  
Hands-on change management experience, including stakeholder mapping, impact assessments, communication plans, enablement journeys, training rollouts and reinforcement mechanisms.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to influence teams & stakeholders cross-functional product, engineering, data, communications, HR, finance and Infosec stakeholders without direct authority.
  
  
Strong program management discipline across multiple concurrent workstreams, including planning, prioritization, milestone tracking, risk/issue management, decision logs and single-source-of-truth artefact management.
  
  
Experience designing or scaling internal AI communities, champion networks, role-based enablement programs, AI labs, workflow clinics or centers of excellence within a large technology organization.
  
  
Bias for action, high ownership, strong judgment, and the ability to operate both strategically and tactically in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
MBA/ PGDM
  
  
Has a good understanding of GCC operating model and ecosystem
  
  
Prior experience in big tech, top-tier consulting, a large GCC or a high-growth technology environment where AI strategy, technology transformation or enterprise adoption was a core part of the role.
  
  
Experience building, evaluating, or scaling applied AI, agentic AI, computer vision, retrieval-augmented generation or large-scale generative AI products, platforms, or internal productivity solutions.
  
  
Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, model risk, data privacy, legal/IP considerations and enterprise AI risk management.
  
  
Experience with data analysis and visualization tools to build operational dashboards and track AI adoption, usage, productivity and business value metrics.
  
  
Strong financial and analytical acumen, including experience developing cost-versus-value analyses, investment cases or ROI narratives for technology initiatives.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
**Global Outreach**
Our campuses serve as a hub to enhance collaboration, bring us together for purpose and deliver on business needs. This approach helps us make quicker decisions, remove location barriers across our global team, and be more flexible in our personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits of maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers, and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing diversity – unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

Option 1: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, business, finance, strategy, or related area and 6 years’ experience in retail, eCommerce, strategy, operations, technology, management consulting, or related area

title: Knowledge Manager - AI & Content Strategy
description:
**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
The Knowledge Manager is responsible for shaping how ECS captures, creates, organizes, validates, presents, and sustains knowledge. The role combines knowledge and content strategy, information architecture, learning enablement, SharePoint fluency, and AI knowledge readiness. The objective is not simply to administer repositories, but to make trusted knowledge easy for employees, clients, and AI solutions to understand, access, and use.
  
  
This manager-level individual contributor will establish the frameworks and operating practices needed to turn fragmented documentation and institutional expertise into current, authoritative, audience-appropriate knowledge assets. The role will support internal ECS needs and reusable approaches that may be applied to client knowledge-management engagements, support experiences, and AI knowledge assistants.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring deep knowledge-management and content-creation expertise, strong information-organization instincts, and enough hands-on SharePoint experience to contribute immediately. Experience in learning and development is important because ECS needs to effectively connect knowledge capture with training, upskilling, workshops, and knowledge transfer. The role will work with technical teams on platform decisions, while retaining accountability for the knowledge framework, content quality, governance, and user experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Knowledge Strategy, Architecture and Governance | 30%
* Design and maintain an ECS knowledge-management framework aligned to Endurance program principles, business priorities, and user needs.
* Define repository hierarchies, taxonomies, metadata, naming and smart-titling conventions, content types, source-authority rules, and audience segmentation.
* Establish governance for content creation, human validation, approval, publishing, access, periodic review, retention, archival, and disposition.
* Clarify decision rights and responsibilities for content owners, authors, reviewers, approvers, repository managers, and technical platform teams.
* Create scalable patterns that separate and appropriately connect shared Unisys knowledge, product-specific knowledge, client-owned content, and tailored client experiences.
* Serve as a hands-on SharePoint practitioner for knowledge design, while partnering with platform specialists for complex administration, engineering, integration, and security decisions.
* Content Creation, Knowledge Capture and Curation | 25%
* Develop structured templates, toolkits, and guidance that enable subject matter experts and designated contributors to conduct interviews, workshops, documentation reviews, lessons learned, and knowledge-transfer sessions.
* Create and maintain templates, editorial standards, and authoring guidance that help content owners develop consistent playbooks, guides, reference materials, standard operating procedures, training content, and other reusable knowledge artifacts.
* Organize content so employees and clients can quickly understand it, navigate it, and apply it to their work.
* Operate staged content workflows that support intake, assessment, cleanup, smart titling, tagging, categorization, validation, publishing, and maintenance.
* Identify and remediate duplicate, obsolete, redundant, conflicting, orphaned, or poorly structured content.
* Improve the quality and consistency of how ECS presents technical and business knowledge internally and to clients.
* AI Knowledge Readiness and Managed Knowledge Services | 25%
* Prepare trusted knowledge sources for Microsoft Copilot, AI knowledge assistants, RAG solutions, intelligent search, and multi-agent experiences.
* Establish AI-ready content standards covering structure, completeness, metadata, permissions, source authority, currency, validation, and intended audience.
* Partner with AI, engineering, UX, platform, security, and services teams to translate knowledge requirements into feasible solution designs without owning technical architecture decisions outside the role.
* Support knowledge assessments that determine whether source content is suitable for AI ingestion and identify cleanup or remediation required before implementation.
* Design reusable managed-knowledge practices covering content creation, validation, governance, maintenance, and service metrics.
* Create feedback loops that connect user experience and AI response quality to source-content remediation and knowledge-gap closure.
* Learning Enablement and Adoption | 15%
* Help apply learning-and-development principles to convert captured knowledge into role-based learning paths, workshops, job aids, and onboarding materials.
* Partner with Endurance program leads, practice teams, and learning resources to support concurrent training and knowledge-transfer activities.
* Build repeatable enablement patterns that can be piloted in one product or practice and adapted for subsequent areas.
* Develop guidance and communications that help contributors create better content and help users find and apply authoritative knowledge.
* Promote sustainable knowledge-sharing behaviors and support practices in taking operational ownership of their knowledge.
* Metrics, Reporting and Continuous Improvement | 5%
* Define indicators for content quality, validation status, freshness, coverage, discoverability, reuse, adoption, learning effectiveness, and AI readiness.
* Provide concise reporting on repository health, knowledge gaps, governance compliance, risks, remediation priorities, and business outcomes.
* Use analytics, search behavior, feedback, and AI-quality observations to maintain a prioritized improvement backlog.

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**
**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Knowledge Management, Library or Information Science, Instructional Design, Information Systems, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* Seven or more years of experience across knowledge management, content strategy, information architecture, content operations, organizational learning, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to design taxonomies, metadata models, repository hierarchies, content standards, and lifecycle-governance practices.
* Hands-on experience with SharePoint, including hubs, sites, libraries, content types, metadata, permissions, navigation, and search.
* Experience capturing expert knowledge and converting it into accessible, reusable content for different audiences.
* Experience leading cross-functional work with business, technical, learning, and governance stakeholders in a globally distributed environment.
* Strong writing, editing, facilitation, synthesis, and visual-communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands-on manager-level individual contributor, set frameworks, and influence without direct authority.
* Experience supporting Microsoft Copilot, AI knowledge assistants, enterprise search, agentic solutions, or RAG-based implementations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in learning and development, instructional design, curriculum development, technical training, or workforce enablement.
* Familiarity with content ingestion, semantic retrieval, vector search, knowledge graphs, web crawling, automated tagging, or content-quality automation.
* Experience assessing and organizing technical product, support, engineering, or client documentation.
* Experience shaping managed knowledge services or professional-services offerings.
* Relevant certification in knowledge management, library science, learning, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, records management, or information governance.

title: Bid and Proposal Manager
description:
**Job Title- Bid and Proposal Manager**

**Position type- Full Time**

**Work Location- Bangalore, Whitefield**

**Working style- Hybrid**

**5–12 years of experience**

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF ROLE:**

The IND Proposal Manager independently delivers moderate‑to‑high complexity proposals in line with defined SLAs, timelines, and quality standards. The role owns first‑draft development, narrative structure, and compliance execution for assigned proposal workstreams, with a strong emphasis on editorial judgment, written quality, and advanced Microsoft Word proficiency.

The role operates with minimal supervision, partners closely with onshore writers, content managers, and subject matter experts, and supports multiple concurrent bids, including fast‑turn and priority submissions.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Proposal Development & Content Management**

* Independently own first‑draft development for assigned proposal sections or modules, tailoring narrative to client context, buyer intent, and evaluation criteria.
* Interpret RFP requirements, develop and maintain compliance matrices, and identify gaps, risks, and clarification needs.
* Apply advanced editorial judgment to ensure narrative flow, logical structure, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to brand and style standards.
* Create, manage, and optimize proposal response templates and approved content within Loopio or similar proposal content platforms.
* Coordinate SME content reviews and updates to ensure accurate, compliant, submission‑ready responses.
* Demonstrate working knowledge of Aon solutions and terminology across to support accurate and relevant responses.

**Document Production & Quality Control**

* Export proposal responses to Microsoft Word and perform advanced drafting, editing, formatting, version control, and final quality reviews prior to submission.
* Enforce disciplined document management practices, including version control, naming conventions, change tracking, and structured review workflows.
* Oversee formatting of proposal documents, appendices, and forms, including population of required standard firm content (e.g., tax ID, corporate information, diversity statements).
* Provide second‑level quality review of proposal sections, templates, and formatted outputs produced by junior specialists or production resources to ensure submission readiness.

**Collaboration & Delivery**

* Partner closely with SMEs, writers, production assistants, and content managers to deliver complete, high‑quality submissions under tight and competing deadlines.
* Independently manage multiple concurrent bids, balancing quality, responsiveness, and delivery risk.
* Exercise sound judgment under pressure, proactively resolving issues and escalating risks to protect deadlines, SLAs, and submission quality.
* Provide guidance, coordination, and day‑to‑day support to Level 8 specialists and production resources as needed.
* Proactively monitor workload, complexity, and competing priorities to maintain delivery commitments and transparency with onshore partners.

**Technology & AI Enablement**

* Assertively use collaboration, content, and workflow tools (including Loopio) to optimize prioritization, transparency, and delivery efficiency.
* Leverage approved AI‑assisted drafting and review tools to accelerate first drafts, support compliance interpretation, and enhance editorial quality.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of proposal processes, tools, and technology adoption.
* Support the development and maintenance of SOPs, templates, and job aids to enable consistent execution and onboarding.

**SKILLS/COMPETENCIES REQUIRED:**

* 5–12 years of experience in proposal management, bid writing, content development, or editorial roles within consulting, insurance, professional services, or similar environments.
* Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills with demonstrated first‑draft ownership and editorial leadership.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex RFP requirements and make sound compliance judgments.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word; working knowledge of PowerPoint.
* Proven experience supporting moderate‑to‑high complexity bids in SOP‑driven quality environments.
* Strong working knowledge of Loopio or similar proposal content management tools.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines across time zones with minimal supervision.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and stakeholder partnership mindset.
* Commitment to continuous improvement through knowledge sharing, training, and coaching.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with urgency and sound judgment in deadline‑driven environments.

title: End User Training Consultant
description:
**Blue Yonder Supply Chain Solutions**
Position Overview
  
  
The
**End User Training (EUT) Consultant**
is a client-facing learning and enablement professional who supports the design, development, and delivery of learning programs for Blue Yonder supply chain transformations. Working with Senior and Principal EUT Consultants, this role helps customers build the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to successfully adopt new technologies, processes, and ways of working.
  
  
The EUT Consultant combines
**instructional design, content development, facilitation, customer enablement, and consulting skills**
to translate business processes, system functionality, roles, and organizational impacts into practical, role-based learning experiences.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Support EUT activities and deliverables across enterprise supply chain transformation programs.
* Conduct and support learning discovery, stakeholder interviews, learning needs assessments, and role-based training analysis.
* Partner with customer stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational processes, learner needs, and implementation requirements.
* Translate business processes, solution functionality, roles, and change impacts into learning objectives and role-based learning requirements.
* Support development of training plans, curricula, learning journeys, course outlines, content development plans, and training schedules.
* Design and develop instructor-led, virtual, blended, digital, and performance-support learning materials.
* Develop presentations, facilitator guides, participant materials, exercises, scenarios, job aids, videos, assessments, and other learning resources.
* Customize learning content and examples to reflect customer business processes, use cases, roles, and implementation objectives.
* Apply adult learning, instructional design, learning experience, and content development best practices.
* Apply foundational Organizational Change Management principles to understand how business and role impacts, readiness, communications, and adoption influence learning requirements.
* Deliver instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, workshops, knowledge-transfer, and customer enablement sessions.
* Facilitate interactive and hands-on learning experiences aligned with customer use cases and operational processes.
* Adapt learning and facilitation approaches for different audiences, including business users, super users, system administrators, support teams, managers, and leaders.
* Support train-the-trainer, super-user enablement, instructor readiness, and knowledge-transfer activities.
* Help customers build user proficiency, confidence, and greater self-sufficiency in using implemented solutions.
* Work with functional and solution experts to ensure learning accurately reflects configured solutions and future-state business processes.
* Participate in curriculum design, content review, validation, and training readiness sessions.
* Follow established content-development, quality, version-control, review, and approval processes.
* Work collaboratively with OCM, project management, Professional Services, solution, product, Customer Success, Education, and client teams to align learning with implementation milestones and business outcomes.
* Maintain EUT work plans, content trackers, review logs, and supporting project documentation.
* Support development of learning assessments and evaluation approaches and analyze learner feedback, training effectiveness, and adoption indicators.
* Use feedback, product enhancements, and implementation lessons learned to continuously improve learning content and delivery.
* Contribute lessons learned, templates, examples, best practices, and ideas that support continuous improvement and standardization of EUT methodologies and delivery assets.
* Develop knowledge of Blue Yonder solutions, supply chain processes, implementation methodologies, and enterprise transformation.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 3+ years of experience in end-user training, Learning & Development, instructional design, customer enablement, software implementation, professional services, or a related discipline.
* Experience designing and developing training content for enterprise software, SaaS platforms, business applications, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience delivering instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, or other facilitated learning experiences.
* Foundational knowledge of adult learning, instructional design, curriculum development, and training content development practices.
* Understanding of the relationship between Organizational Change Management, business readiness, learning, and end-user adoption.
* Ability to understand both business-process and technology concepts and translate complex information into clear, practical learning experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to establish effective working relationships with customers, subject matter experts, solution consultants, and project stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple learning deliverables, reviews, schedules, and priorities in a consulting environment.
* Professional, adaptable, self-directed, and customer-focused approach to delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with or exposure to Blue Yonder solutions or other enterprise supply chain solutions and platforms.
* Experience in supply chain, retail, manufacturing, logistics, planning, warehouse operations, transportation, or related business environments.
* Experience supporting learning and enablement for supply chain capabilities such as Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Integrated Business Planning, Allocation and Replenishment, Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, or related solutions.
* Experience supporting software implementations or broader business transformation programs.
* Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder discussions, hands-on learning, knowledge-transfer, or train-the-trainer programs.
* Familiarity with Prosci, ADKAR, SAP Activate, or other Organizational Change Management approaches.
* Experience with learning management systems, content development tools, digital learning, video, simulation, or related learning technologies.
* Professional services, enterprise software, or consulting experience.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Success means consistently delivering
**high-quality, customer-focused learning experiences**
that build learner proficiency and confidence, support successful knowledge transfer, and contribute to solution adoption and implementation success.
  
  
The EUT Consultant is expected to progressively develop from executing defined learning activities into independently conducting discovery, designing learning solutions, facilitating client sessions, advising stakeholders, and managing increasingly complex EUT deliverables.
  
  
Success is demonstrated through
**training effectiveness, learner proficiency, customer satisfaction, stakeholder relationships, solution adoption, and consistent delivery quality**
, while contributing to continuous improvement of EUT methodologies and learning assets.
  
  
**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Senior Engineer - System Solution Engineer
description:
Location: Bangalore, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Senior Engineer - System Engineering**
Thales India Engineering Competency Center (ECC) in Bangalore is seeking a Solution Engineer for MCO equipment, to be part of MCO engineering team.
  
  
In this role you will be in charge of Engineering activities to demonstrate the compliance and functionalities of equipment in front of Design Changes with same form-fit-functionalities. You establish the Change Impact Analysis, and perform the Simulation, analysis and verification activities.
  
  
Context of Design in MCO activities for FLX Cockipit and Computers,
  
  
After the first certification of our Equipments, during serial production and support phases, our equipment are regularly submitted to Design Changes. These Design Change involving partial redesign, are mainly due to obsolescence treatment, necessary correction to solve critical PR (Problem Report).; or enhancement improvement of equipment capabilities. These design changes vary from minor changes (component change with limited impact) to more significant change where all the safety, qualification, and certification information have to be re-assessed regarding airworthiness regulation, all the Design Changes must be submitted to customer approval before release.
  
  
Our Equipments are Computers (as Flight Control, Flight Management, Display, Interactivity Control Panel, Head up Display)
  
  
Our team is focused on Hardware Changes (electronics, packaging .. )
  
  
**Qualifications:**
Equipment engineering or equivalent with 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in aeronautic. Higher qualifications of Post-graduation is desirable. Domain experience in civil Avionics design is desirable.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Establish Impact Analysis of electronics Design Changes

+ Understand the applicable documentation basis (from specification to IVVQ and safety BOM data package).
+ Propose the validation plan

* Build the Simulation/analysis, and establish the entire necessary demonstration to obtain our PDA (followed by Customer) approval,
* Prepare all the customer satisfactory certification documentation (expected example) and reviews
* Perform the complementary testing and IVV at equipment level.
* Coordinate with stakeholders and specialists in a collaborative manner for
* Electronics Engineers when boards or FPGA are modified
* Packaging :Environmental testing when Qualification test are repeated
* Test Bench and Means : industrialization & Production Support , Acceptances Tests in manufacturing
* Configuration Management team
* Project Managers

**Skills & experience:**

* Must have strong knowledge in Electronics (analog and digital) design and development.

+ Should be able to analyze electronics circuits individually.
+ Should be able to select alternate electronics components (Active, Passive and Connector) individually
+ Should be able to read schematic, Bill of materials and Layout file.

* Must have high awareness of Airworthiness, Aeronautic Safety requirements and standards. ( as per ARP4761 or ARP4754 )
* Must have strong experience with aeronautic standard (DO-160 environment , DO-254, ARP4754, ARP4761; APQP)
* Must have strong experience to troubleshoot on electronics and embedded hardware systems to find the root cause and to fix with a suitable solution
* Must have experience in interfacing with external test facilities for environmental and EMI/EMC and other electrical tests as per MIL-STD and DO-160 standards
* Should be familiar in developing Qualification Test procedures (QTPs), Qualification Test Reports (QTR), Qualification by similarity reports (QBSR) and other documents required by airborne certification authorities
* Must be fluent with on Configuration Management data package (Build of Materials, Definition File, Identification, Design Change Rules)

Must be fluent with tools and data repositories: as BDDP and PLM/TOL/GED
  
  

* Experience in establishing Design Documentation (Requirement, IVVQ procedure, reports)
* Should be familiar with mechanical drawings, wiring diagram reading and understanding.
* Should be familiar in Industrialization, Production process, Testing, (Acceptance test, Screening testing ) ideally experience on APQP
