title: Technical Tendering Specialist- Optical
description:
**Job Description**
 The role is focussed on supporting product presales activities within Nokia’s Global Business Operations team. The Technical Tendering Specialist plays a critical role in translating customer requirements into clear, accurate, and compelling technical responses for Requests for Information (RFI) and Requests for Proposals (RFP). This includes analyzing customer needs, aligning proposed solutions with Nokia’s optical portfolio, and ensuring consistency with product roadmaps. The specialist works in close collaboration with sales teams to shape competitive, customer\-focused solutions and with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) teams to ensure technical accuracy, feasibility, and alignment with current and future product capabilities.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Analyze RFx/RFP/RFQ documents to identify technical requirements and develop winning response strategies.
* Collaborate with sales, product line management (PLM), and technical teams to define customer\-centric solutions.
* Prepare, review, and refine high\-quality technical proposals and tender responses aligned with customer needs.
* Support pre\-sales activities by responding to customer technical queries and conducting solution presentations.
* Develop and maintain a centralized, searchable repository of technical content for efficient proposal development.
* Provide expertise in optical and packet transport technologies, including DWDM, OTN, POTN, and Ethernet networks.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of Network Management Systems (NMS), OSS, SDN, and cloud\-native deployment architectures
* Utilize expertise in OpenConfig, YANG, NBI/SBI interfaces, and modern network management frameworks.
* Apply knowledge of optical network management standards and multi\-vendor interoperability requirements.
* Stay informed about industry trends, including advanced modulation techniques, pluggable optical transceivers, and Open MSAs


**Key Skills And Experience**
* Manage multiple concurrent projects and deliver high\-quality outputs within strict timelines.
* Leverage experience in pre\-sales engineering, bid management, tender responses, and customer engagement activities
* Demonstrate familiarity with leading optical networking vendors and solutions, particularly Nokia and Ciena.
* 8\+ years of experience in optical and packet transport networking solutions.
* Possess a bachelor’s degree in Electronics \& Communication, Telecommunications, or Computer Engineering; a Master’s degree is an advantage.
* Exhibit strong teamwork, communication, presentation, problem\-solving skills, and proficiency in MS Office and SharePoint, with the ability to work independently and proactively.
* Knowledge of Layer\-3 technologies is considered an added advantage.

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

title: Project Engineer - Fire & smoke detectors & alarms
description:
**Job Description**
* Individual in this role, will manage execution and timely completion of engineering projects by analyzing project scope and determining project specifications, establishing test programs for product investigations, and preparing reports for clients. Participates in the development of UL requirements, test methods, and test equipment.
* Independently determines project scope, develops a preliminary plan of investigation, and determines project specifications such as cost, time, and sample requirements by analyzing client input, available supplemental data, and product construction.
* Projects may include frequent travel to conduct or witness tests at client sites.
* Initiates communication with clients to promote and explain the benefits of new and existing services.
* Follows up on contacts from clients.
* Communicates with clients to discuss technical issues, explain UL procedures and requirements, convey project cost, and negotiate completion date and sample requirements.
* Acts to address client concerns and to resolve client issues.
* Provides technical assistance to clients in reference to product inspection and follow\-up services.
* Establishes appropriate test programs by reviewing files and manufacturer's information, examining samples, and applying UL requirements. Is familiar with applicable standards, company manuals and appropriate technical literature. Examines samples for compliance with UL requirements and notifies client of any areas in which the product is not in compliance or of any changes in project scope or specifications
* Notifies client of any areas in which the product is not in compliance with UL requirements or of any changes in project scope or specifications.
* Coordinates laboratory activities by preparing data sheets and instructions to technicians, scheduling and reviewing work of Laboratory Technicians and support staff and establishing completion dates.
* Coordinates administrative aspects of project management.
* Serves as Project Handler of record and may sign as Reviewer of record as assigned.
* Communicates project status and results to clients through frequent contact and by preparing reports.
* Prepares Follow\-Up Service Procedures and information pages.
* Integrates continuous improvement concepts and techniques into all aspects of the job.
* Resolves engineering issues associated with Variation Notices by analyzing and reporting on the acceptability of the variations.
* Proposes development of new and/or revised UL requirements.
* Develops special test methods and test equipment.
* May represent UL at industry related functions such as seminars and trade shows.
* May train office, field, and/or laboratory staff and entry\-level engineers.
* Provides technical assistance to laboratory and/or field staff.
* Read and follow the Underwriters Laboratories Code of Conduct and follow all physical and digital security practices.
* Performs other duties as directed.
* Integrates continuous improvement concepts and techniques into all aspects of the job.
* Shall be flexible to work in other domains like Fire Suppression etc.


**Qualifications**
* University Degree in Electrical Engineering required.
* 7 \- 10 years of engineering or industrial laboratory experience required.
* Heat and smoke detectors, strobes, and other indicating devices, as well as Fire Alarm Control Panels product working experience is required.
* Candidates from Testing, Inspection \& Certification industry are preferred.
* Detailed knowledge of the technical vocabulary common to the appropriate discipline.
* Working knowledge of conformity standards in use in area of expertise.
* Demonstrated ability to apply project\-handling concepts in use in area of expertise.
* Strong communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Compliance engineering experience preferred.


**About Us**
 A global leader in applied safety science, UL Solutions (NYSE: ULS) transforms safety, security and sustainability challenges into opportunities for customers in more than 110 countries. UL Solutions delivers testing, inspection and certification services, together with software products and advisory offerings, that support our customers’ product innovation and business growth. The UL Mark serves as a recognized symbol of trust in our customers’ products and reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing our safety mission. We help our customers innovate, launch new products and services, navigate global markets and complex supply chains, and grow sustainably and responsibly into the future. Our science is your advantage.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our buildings don’t just shape our skylines — they provide the backdrop to our lives. And knowing they’re safe matters. We’ve been helping to create safer structures since 1894, combining our expertise with innovative new technologies to help make sure both people and property are secure. As more people have to deal with extreme weather, we’re on hand to test products and building materials to increasingly rigorous standards. Whether we’re simulating tornadoes or testing smoke alarms, the work we do on our team is used in buildings around the world to — quite literally — help save lives. Join our team and build your skills, build innovative solutions and help build a safer world.

**JOB TITLE: Principal Engineer, Systems**
**JOB LOCATION: Whitefield, Bengaluru**
**Summary**
 The ideal candidate will leverage his/her exposure to embedded software and its interplay with electronics/hardware to support optimal system/product level realization for new products as well as sustenance of the existing products to deliver dialysis therapy. In this role, you will be part of the Systems Engineering function within the broader R\&D organization, collaborating closely with cross functional teams including Software, Hardware, V\&V, and Digital Engineering, as well as global stakeholders in QA, RA, Clinical, Service, and Manufacturing.
   

  

 The successful candidate will possess strong technical abilities, excitement and energy for product development, and a passion for their work and the impact it has on extending lives and expanding possibilities. Candidate is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and governing end‑to‑end requirements—from user needs through system, subsystem, and interface specifications—with rigorous traceability, risk alignment, and compliance with medical‑device standards.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Lead development, structuring, and decomposition of requirements for an electromechanical medical device development project.
* Work with clinical, marketing, and human‑factors teams to define and refine user needs, use cases, and product claims.
* Translate system\-level needs into functional, performance, interface, and safety requirements across mechanical, electrical, embedded, controls, and software domains.
* Ensure full bidirectional traceability using any requirement management tool, linking requirements to risk controls, architecture, design elements, and verification methods.
* Facilitate cross\-functional requirement reviews, ensuring clarity, feasibility, and compliance with relevant medical standards (ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601, IEC 62304\).
* Maintain configuration control, change management, and version governance of requirement artifacts.
* Support verification planning and coverage analysis ensuring every requirement is testable and aligned with risk and design outputs.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, software, controls, and quality engineering teams to ensure the architecture aligns with requirements.
* Support system\-level design documentation (architecture diagrams, interface control documents, hazard analyses, robust requirements).
* Work with risk management teams to ensure requirements address identified hazards, mitigations, and residual risk acceptance.
* Participate in FMEA/FMECA activities and ensure results flow into requirements and verification.
* Support system integration builds, resolving requirement conflicts, clarifying intent, and supporting issue triage.

title: Senior Content Associate
description:
**Why this role exists** 




  





 If you write across formats and you're the kind of person who keeps the whole pipeline on track, this role hands you both.
 



  





 You'll define the narrative \- how JustCall explains what it does and why it matters to the revenue teams who use our products, and the buyers deciding whether to. You'll set the voice and tone across web, blog, email, and social, and own the calendar that keeps all of it moving.
 



  





 You'll write the cornerstone pieces yourself \- the ones that set the standard for how we sound and hold that line across everything the wider team ships, from PMM and CRO to design and events.
 



  





**What you'll actually do** 




  





**Write across formats** 




  




* Draft and sharpen web and landing page copy \- headlines, subcopy, feature sections, and CTAs
* Write and edit blogs and long\-form content, from product announcements to thought leadership
* Own email and lifecycle copy \- onboarding sequences, campaigns and A/B variants
* Write social copy and SEO content, including meta titles and descriptions, down to sections like FAQs



  





**Own the calendar** 




  




* Plan what ships when, write the briefs, and track every piece from draft to publish
* Coordinate designers, freelancers, and other teams so work lands on time and on brief
* Keep clear visibility into what's in flight, what's done, and what's at risk, so no one has to chase



  





**Hold the quality bar** 




  




* Self\-edit hard, and hold every piece to our voice and style standards
* Review others' content for clarity, flow, and consistency
* Push every draft that's specific and reads like it was written by a human



  





**Build the systems** 




  




* Build the workflows and reusable skills the content team runs on
* Use AI tools to do more with less, and write the prompts that make the whole team faster



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* Have 3\-5 years of writing copy, ideally in B2B SaaS
* Can show a portfolio across the web, blog, email, and social
* Stay organised under a full calendar and still ship clean work
* Write plain, specific copy and make technical ideas easy to read
* Like owning a process end\-to\-end, rather than waiting to be handed briefs



  





**Edges that help** 




  




* Have written for sales and support teams
* Know SEO fundamentals and the tools we run on, like GA, HubSpot
* Have worked somewhere fast, where priorities shift week to week



  





**How we work** 




  




* Outcomes over process. We measure engineering impact by production reliability, latency benchmarks, eval coverage, and the AI experiences we ship \- not tickets closed.
* Deeply hands\-on culture \- leadership here means staying close to the hardest technical problems, not delegating your way out of them.
* Fast cycles, high ambiguity, and the expectation that you bring both architectural depth and shipping velocity to every initiative.
* Competitive pay tied to the systems you architect and the engineering culture you build.



  





**The bigger picture** 




  





 JustCall is SaaS Labs' flagship product \- used by 6,000\+ businesses across 70\+ countries to run their customer conversations. We're backed by Peak XV and Base10 Partners, have crossed $40M ARR, and are building toward $100M with the team, the product, and the infrastructure to get there.
 



  





 If this is the role you've been waiting to find \- let's talk.
 



  





 SaaS Labs takes pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products, which is why we're committed to making hiring or any employment decision regardless of race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

title: Senior Medical Writer
description:
Business Introduction
   

  

 At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R\&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting\-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
   

  

 Find out more:
   

  

 Our approach to R\&D
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Senior Medical Writer is expected to work on assignments largely independently or for complex documents, under guidance of a mentor, facilitating delivery of the written assignments through proactive coordination of stakeholders to build content. The senior medical writer understands clinical trials design and interpretation of statistically analysed clinical research data. He/she would be expected to drive and coordinate the process to draft, review and approve written assignments and should be able to meet the quality standards of the global organization. The Senior Medical Writer is responsible for the final deliverable and is expected to work in complex matrix organization
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Completes assignments independently or for more complex documents, under guidance of a mentor
   

  

 Authors a range of clinical documents, including regulatory documents following defined templates, including but not limited to
 **protocols** 
 ,
 **clinical study reports** 
 , NDA/MAA CTD submission documents,
 **investigator brochures** 
 , briefing documents, and responses to regulatory authority questions.
   

  

 Ensures high integrity of data interpretation, following negotiation with document team.
   

  

 Ensures the consistency and quality level of all documents that are issued.
   

  

 Actively participates in all planning, coordination and review meetings.
   

  

 Ability to work on 2\-3 assignments simultaneously.
   

  

 Proactively raises and discusses concerns/ issues in an open and timely manner and within the global team, thereby demonstrating the ability of promoting high medical writing standards by pointing out obvious flaws and proposing (and advocating) alternatives.
   

  

 Works directly with a diversity of roles at different levels within GSK (e.g., Clinical Leads, Asset Leads, Study Delivery Leads (SDL), Biostatisticians, other Medical Writers).
   

  

 Establishes network of communication and continuously builds collaboration to facilitate smooth partnerships and interfaces between all groups involved in delivery of writing assignments.
   

  

**Preferred Qualification**
 PhD or equivalent expertise (e.g., a master’s degree with a minimum of 2 years’ relevant experience)
   

  

**8 years** 
 clinical regulatory writing experience in the pharmaceutical industry
   

  

**Other Job\-Related Skills**
* Possesses a good understanding of basic drug development
* Demonstrates knowledge of scientific methodology and statistical principles in the design, conduct and description of clinical research.
* Demonstrates understanding of how to interpret, describe and document clinical data.
* Possesses working knowledge of International Committee for Harmonisation (ICH) / Good Clinical Practice (GCP).
* Possesses necessary computer skills and general computer literacy. Excellent English language skills (verbal and written)


 Working model
   

  

 This role is hybrid, based in India. You will spend core days in the office for collaboration and use flexible remote working for focused writing.
   

  

**Skills**
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
 GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
   

  

 People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
   

  

**Inclusion at GSK:**
 As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
   

  

 Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment\-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
   

  

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
 GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
   

  

 It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
   

  

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
 If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Assistant Engineer - Future Mobility
description:
**Responsibilities**
**WSP’S FUTURE OF MOBILITY TEAM**
 We are looking for an enthusiastic and inquisitive individual to join the WSP Future of Mobility team and support our public and private sector clients. Within Future of Mobility we work across a range of areas:
   

  

* Zero emission mobility, helping clients switch to electric and alternative fuelled vehicles, and more broadly supporting sustainability goals and the transition to a decarbonised transport system.
* New modes and services, supporting clients to harness new technologies and business models in transport – from e\-scooters and demand responsive transport, to cargo bikes and Mobility as a Service.
* Accessibility and inclusion, working to make transport more accessible for all by taking a human centred approach.
* Policy and futures, using a range of techniques to horizon scan and built future mobility into new policies and strategies.


 As a member of our team, you’ll have a chance to develop across a range of subjects and skill areas. Our projects cover problem identification, feasibility studies, policies and strategy, business case development, commercial and operating model analysis, research, and operational delivery support.
   

  

**ASSISTANT CONSULTANT ROLE**
 Due to our expanding public and private sector workload, we are looking for an enthusiastic and inquisitive Assistant Consultant to join the WSP Future of Mobility team, which is part of our Transport Planning business. You will work alongside a virtual team of individuals within India and the UK.
   

  

 As an Assistant Consultant you can expect to be active on several projects at any given time. Your work may cover a variety of areas of expertise. You will report to a senior member of our team with expected day\-to\-day tasks that include the following:
   

  

 The typical responsibilities include the following:
   

  

* Providing day\-to\-day support in the delivery of a range of projects, which may be across one, or more of the following areas:
+ Zero emission mobility, helping clients switch to electric, hydrogen and alternative fuelled vehicles.
+ New modes and services, supporting clients to harness new technologies, data and business models – from e scooters and demand responsive transport, to cargo bikes and Mobility as a Service.
+ Accessibility and inclusion, working to make services and systems more accessible for all by taking a human centred approach.
+ Policy and futures, using a range of analytical and futures techniques to horizon scan and embed future mobility into new policies and strategies.
+ Rural mobility, applying new approaches to deliver better outcomes for countryside and coastal residents and visitors

* Supporting a broad range of projects, including budgeting, programming, analysis and technical excellence.
* Supporting teams in the preparation of bids, fee proposals and project programmes.
* Taking on official Bid Manager and Deputy Project Manager roles on projects, where feasible.
* Making an active contribution to the team through sharing knowledge, taking part in discussions and contributing to team events.
* Working as part of a team, supporting the growth of the Future Mobility offer in your office and with the UK Team.


 Working closely with our Associate and Directors, and supporting the professional development of our junior staff, you will be an important member of our Future of Mobility team. The role presents an excellent opportunity to progress your career and expand your professional horizons.
   

  

**WE WOULD LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU**
 We would love to hear from you if you can demonstrate you are:
   

  

* Enthusiastic and curious about shaping better systems, services and outcomes, including (but not limited to) mobility
* Analytically minded, with experience using quantitative or structured problem solving approaches to understand complex, real world problems
* Comfortable applying critical thinking to unfamiliar subject areas and developing evidence based insights
* Interested in how technology, policy, economics, geography and human behaviour interact to shape outcomes
* Comfortable developing bespoke approaches to support individual projects or solve specific challenges
* Able to work across a range of subject areas concurrently and quickly context switch
* Strong in report writing and communication, able to translate complex analysis into clear, compelling outputs
* Responsive and agile — asking the right questions, adapting to changing priorities and raising risks early
* Depending on your experience, confident in supporting or managing projects directly, including client facing work
* Willing to work towards professional accreditation, where relevant


**Qualifications**
 BGV:

* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.


**About Us**
 WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation \& Infrastructure, Property \& Buildings, Earth \& Environment, Power \& Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
   

  

 With approximately
 **4,000 talented people** 
 across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru \& Mumbai offices) in India and more than
 **73,000 globally** 
 , in 550
 **offices across 40 countries** 
 , we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
   

  

 At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
 **Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**
* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.


***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

**Our Hybrid Working Module**
 With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
   

  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.


**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
 Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
   

  

**Inclusivity and Diversity**
 WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength \- Our People \-feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
   

  

**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
   

  

**With us, you can.
   

  

 Apply today.**

Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. title: Operational Excellence Manager
description:
**Company Description**




  





 Vialto is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to ‘Connect the world’. We are unique and the only stand\-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.
 



 Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost\-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross\-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.
 



 Working at Vialto is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.
 



 Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.
 



 To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast

 to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the
 **latest news** 
 in the industry. You can also follow us on
 **LinkedIn**

 **Instagram.** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 The Operational Excellence Manager will drive the Operational Excellence agenda across VVN global mobility operations in India. A key priority will be to identify, adapt, and scale proven improvement practices from across Vialto, ensuring successful approaches are consistently embedded within local operations. The role will build organizational capability through continuous improvement training, methodologies, and tools, while partnering with operational leaders to standardize processes, establish governance, and implement performance measurement frameworks that enable sustainable improvements and measurable business outcomes.
 



 The role will support broader process improvement and automation initiatives by identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, improve efficiency, and enhance service delivery. Working closely with operational and functional stakeholders, the successful candidate will assess opportunities, develop business cases, define requirements, and coordinate the delivery of improvement initiatives. While experience with automation is advantageous, this is primarily a business\-facing role focused on opportunity assessment, solution design, stakeholder engagement, and benefits realization rather than hands\-on automation development.
 



 Reporting to the Operational Excellence Lead, this role is part of a broader enabling functions team that combines expertise in process improvement, automation, analytics, and other support capabilities.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead process improvement initiatives using structured Operational Excellence methodologies and project management disciplines.
* Design and deliver training on Operational Excellence methodologies, tools, and best practices, and coach teams in their practical application.
* Map end\-to\-end processes, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies, and drive process simplification and standardization.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Identify and assess improvement and automation opportunities, develop business cases, define business requirements, and support benefit tracking and realization.
* Identify, adapt, and promote proven improvement practices from across Vialto to drive consistency and accelerate outcomes.
* Oversee governance of the improvement portfolio, including initiative prioritization, benefit validation, progress tracking, risk management, and stakeholder reporting.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders to support consistent service delivery and continuous improvement across regions.



**Required Qualifications** 



* At least five years of experience in Operational Excellence, process improvement, continuous improvement, or a related field.
* Practical experience in process mapping, performance measurement, and operational standards development.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead multiple improvement initiatives simultaneously, including programs delivered through cross\-functional teams and subject matter experts.
* Experience designing and delivering training, workshops, or capability\-building programs for diverse audiences.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, business analysis, and data interpretation skills.
* Experience driving change adoption and influencing stakeholders across multiple levels of an organization.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience supporting clients or stakeholders across EMEA and/or the Americas.
* Experience in global mobility, professional services, or other knowledge\-based operational environments.
* Experience identifying and implementing automation opportunities in partnership with technical teams.
* Experience using Power BI or similar tools for operational performance reporting and productivity analysis.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification.



**Location and Working Arrangement** 




 This is a hybrid role based in
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka** 
 . The successful candidate is expected to work from the Bengaluru office at least two days per week.

title: Content Writer — Finance and SEO
description:
**About Stockify** 




 Stockify is one of India's fastest\-growing marketplaces for pre\-IPO and unlisted shares, helping retail and HNI investors discover and invest in high\-potential companies before they list on public exchanges. Our platform covers a wide universe of unlisted stocks across sectors, and we publish research, market updates and investor education content that helps people make better investment decisions. Content is central to how we build trust, drive organic traffic and grow our investor community. We are now looking for a skilled Content Writer who can produce finance content that is both deeply informative and built to rank.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This is a writing\-first role. You will be responsible for producing high\-quality, SEO\-optimised blog articles, landing page copy, company profiles and investor education content for stockify.net.in. The content you write will serve two audiences simultaneously: search engines that need clear signals of relevance and authority, and investors who need accurate, readable and genuinely useful information about unlisted shares, pre\-IPO investing and the companies available on the Stockify platform.
 



 We are not looking for someone who can produce high volumes of generic finance articles. We are looking for a writer who researches before writing, understands how search intent works, can explain complex financial concepts in plain language without dumbing them down, and takes pride in producing content that is both credible and engaging.
 



 If you have a finance background or have spent meaningful time writing about capital markets, investments or fintech, and you understand what it takes to make a piece of content rank on Google, this role is for you.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




**Blog and Long\-Form Content** 



* Research, plan and write SEO\-optimised blog articles on topics including unlisted share investing, pre\-IPO opportunities, company analysis, market trends, ESOP liquidation, SME IPOs and investor education
* Produce well\-structured long\-form content in the range of 1,000 to 2,500 words per article, with clear headings, logical flow, strong internal linking and accurate financial information throughout
* Work from SEO briefs provided by the SEO Manager, including target keywords, intent mapping, suggested structure and competitor benchmarks, and consistently deliver content that meets or exceeds those briefs
* Conduct independent research using company filings, DRHP documents, market data, SEBI announcements and credible financial news sources to ensure every article is factually accurate and up to date
* Optimise every article for on\-page SEO including keyword placement, meta title and description writing, heading hierarchy, image alt text and internal link suggestions



  





**Company and Product Pages** 



* Write and update company profile pages for unlisted stocks listed on the Stockify platform, covering business overview, financials, recent developments, shareholding structure and investment considerations
* Draft and refresh landing page copy for key product and category pages including unlisted share price lists, sector\-specific pages and investor resources
* Ensure all product and company page content is accurate, current and written in a way that serves both search discoverability and investor decision\-making



  





**Social and Supporting Content** 



* Repurpose long\-form blog content into LinkedIn posts, WhatsApp updates and short\-form summaries for use across Stockify's distribution channels
* Support the marketing team with content for email newsletters, investor communication and campaign\-specific copy as required
* Contribute to the monthly content calendar planning by suggesting relevant topics based on market events, search trends and investor questions



  





**Quality and Compliance** 



* Ensure all published content adheres to SEBI guidelines on investment communication, includes appropriate disclaimers and avoids making unsubstantiated return claims or investment recommendations
* Maintain a consistent brand voice across all content, writing like a knowledgeable and trustworthy source rather than a promotional one
* Self\-edit rigorously before submission, checking for factual accuracy, grammatical correctness, SEO compliance and brand tone in every draft



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Two to four years of content writing experience with a demonstrable focus on finance, investment, fintech, capital markets or a related domain
* A strong portfolio of published SEO\-optimised articles in the finance or investment space that you can share as part of your application
* Working knowledge of SEO content principles including keyword research, search intent, on\-page optimisation, internal linking and meta writing
* The ability to read and interpret financial documents such as DRHPs, annual reports, balance sheets and press releases, and translate them into clear and readable content for a general investor audience
* Familiarity with tools such as Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs or Ubersuggest for keyword research and content gap analysis
* A high standard of written English with strong self\-editing skills and zero tolerance for factual errors in published content
* Awareness of SEBI content guidelines and the regulatory sensitivities of writing about investment products in India
* Bonus: Prior experience writing specifically about unlisted shares, pre\-IPO investments, PMS, AIF or alternative investment products



  





**What We Are Not Looking For** 



* Writers who produce high volumes of generic, templated content without original research or genuine financial understanding
* Candidates who rely on AI\-generated drafts without substantial human editing, fact\-checking and rewriting
* Anyone who has not written specifically about finance, investment or fintech at a professional level



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 



* Fixed: Rs. 30,000 per month
* Performance Incentives: Upto 3 months Bonus based on individual and company performance
* Review Cycle: Performance review at 6 months with potential for salary revision

title: Medical Data Governance & Knowledge Management Lead
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Posting Description
   

  

**The Future Begins Here**
 At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future\-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
   

  

 Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.
   

  

**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity**
 Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
   

  

**OBJECTIVES/PURPOSE**
* Support the realization of Medical Governance Office (MGO) strategy by ensuring that the data, records, decisions, and governance knowledge used by MGO are complete, current, easy to find, traceable, and managed consistently.
* Establish and lead the Medical Data Governance \& Knowledge Management capability within the Bengaluru Global Capability Center, developing the Medical ontology and knowledge management framework and supporting the realization of MGO and broader Global Medical priorities.
* Translate approved MGO and Global Medical priorities into clear business definitions, data standards, relationships, and knowledge structures that connect Medical information and support trusted search, retrieval, reuse, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Work directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office and relevant MGO capability leads to deliver agreed priorities and expected outcomes, and stay closely connected to Medical teams so the capability reflects daily operations and business needs. MGO and relevant Medical domain owners retain responsibility for strategy, scientific and business meaning, and final decisions.


**Accountabilities**
**Medical Data Stewardship and Business Glossary**
* Act as the operational steward for assigned Medical data domains. Work with MGO and relevant Medical domain owners to document and maintain approved business definitions, critical data elements, data lineage, ownership, metadata, and data\-quality expectations.
* Own and maintain the Medical business glossary and domain\-level metadata standards for the assigned scope, coordinating proposed changes with MGO and the relevant Medical domain owners.
* Maintain an inventory of the data, reports, repositories, systems, owners, and key definitions within the assigned scope. Run regular checks to identify missing, incomplete, inconsistent, duplicate, outdated, or incorrectly classified information and coordinate correction with the responsible owners.
* Ensure that data used for MGO oversight, dashboards, reporting, and decision support is consistently defined, linked to the agreed official source, and supported by clear data\-quality checks, lineage, and traceable records.


**Medical Ontology, Knowledge Management and Repository Governance**
* Develop the Medical ontology (the agreed structure of terms, definitions, classifications, and relationships used to connect Medical information consistently) and knowledge management framework.
* Own and maintain the Medical ontology, taxonomies, metadata standards, and controlled vocabularies for the assigned scope, coordinating significant changes with MGO and relevant Medical domain owners.
* Work with MGO and relevant Medical domain owners to define and maintain the relationships across Medical data, content, evidence, insights, processes, decisions, and knowledge assets so information can be connected, found, and reused.
* Work with MGO to define practical ways of recording and maintaining governance decisions, approvals, exceptions, standards, frameworks, guidance, templates, and supporting rationale, based on approved MGO and Takeda requirements.
* Ensure that governance records and knowledge are correctly captured, named, classified, linked to related records, version\-controlled, accessible to the right users, periodically reviewed, retained, archived, and retired.
* Oversee regular repository checks to make sure that information is complete, current, correctly linked, and easy to retrieve. Maintain the evidence needed for audit and inspection readiness and work to address identified gaps.
* Help MGO and assigned Medical teams capture, maintain, find, share, and reuse current governance knowledge, reducing duplication and the use of outdated or conflicting materials.


**MGO Functional Partnership and Enablement**
* Receive functional direction from the Head, Medical Governance Office and relevant MGO capability leads on priorities, approved requirements, and expected outcomes. Translate these into clear workplans, deliverables, and timelines.
* Provide regular updates to MGO on progress, data quality, repository status, missing information, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities. Escalate significant gaps, risks, or unresolved ownership questions.
* Maintain regular engagement with MGO leads and Medical teams to understand daily operations, terminology, decisions, user needs, and emerging priorities, ensuring that the Medical ontology and knowledge management framework remain relevant and practical.
* Lead the operational transition of agreed data\-governance, governance\-record, repository, and knowledge\-management activities into Bengaluru. Ensure that scope, responsibilities, handoffs, standards, controls, training needs, and escalation routes are clearly documented before transition.
* Turn agreed business needs into clear requirements for repositories, workflows, access, search, integration, and reporting. Partner closely with Medical DD\&T and the Enterprise AI team to define the business requirements for the Medical knowledge architecture, semantic layer, Medical knowledge graph, AI\-supported search and retrieval, and future approved AI\-enabled workflows. Medical DD\&T and Enterprise AI remain responsible for technical architecture and implementation.


**DIMENSIONS AND ASPECTS**
**Technical/Functional Expertise**
* Strong knowledge of data governance and knowledge management in a regulated environment, including data stewardship, business glossaries, critical data elements, data lineage, ontology, taxonomy, metadata, data quality, records management, and knowledge reuse.
* Good understanding of Medical Affairs governance and operations, with the ability to turn approved governance requirements into clear and practical data and knowledge\-management practices.
* Understands the difference between managing data, records, and repositories and owning the underlying content or decision. Scientific, policy, compliance, legal, privacy, information\-security, technology, clinical\-data, and business decisions remain with the relevant accountable owners unless formally delegated.


**Leadership**
* Provides functional leadership to data owners, data stewards, repository owners, knowledge contributors, system owners, and project teams involved in the assigned scope.
* Translates agreed priorities into clear responsibilities, workplans, and delivery expectations and helps teams apply approved standards consistently.
* Influences stakeholders without relying only on formal authority and brings together the appropriate owners to resolve data, repository, and knowledge\-management issues.


**Decision\-Making and Autonomy**
* Acts as the business owner for the Medical ontology and knowledge management framework and is accountable for its business requirements, operating model, roadmap, adoption, and ongoing evolution within approved MGO and Global Medical direction.
* Within approved requirements, makes operational decisions about the business glossary, ontology, taxonomy, metadata, controlled vocabularies, data\-quality controls, knowledge relationships, repository practices, and issue remediation.
* Escalates questions that involve governance strategy, substantive content, scientific interpretation, policy, compliance, Legal, Privacy, Information Security, enterprise architecture, clinical or RWE data governance, or business ownership.
* MGO and relevant Medical domain owners retain accountability for governance strategy, scientific and business meaning, and approval of significant domain\-specific definitions and relationships. Medical DD\&T and Enterprise AI retain accountability for technical architecture and implementation.


**Interaction**
* Works directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office and relevant MGO leads on priorities, expected outcomes, workplans, progress, and escalation, and maintains regular contact with Medical teams to ensure the capability reflects day\-to\-day business context.
* Maintains close alignment with the GCM Medical Operations \& Governance Lead as the formal line manager and with Medical Excellence \& Operations on the broader Bengaluru operating model and cross\-capability dependencies.
* Collaborates closely with Medical DD\&T and Enterprise AI, as well as Records Information Management, Quality, Privacy, Ethics \& Compliance, Legal, Information Security, system owners, and global, regional, and local Medical stakeholders.


**Innovation**
* Identifies practical opportunities to use ontology, semantic search, knowledge graphs, automation, analytics, and AI\-enabled tools to improve how Medical information is connected, found, understood, and reused.
* Ensures that digital and AI\-enabled solutions are introduced with appropriate validation, access controls, human oversight, traceability, and alignment with applicable Takeda requirements.


**Complexity**
* Works across different Medical governance areas, data sources, repositories, systems, functions, and geographies.
* Balances the need for common global ways of working with valid legal, regulatory, privacy, records\-management, and local requirements.
* Helps move fragmented or locally maintained data and knowledge practices toward more consistent, traceable, and reusable approaches without taking ownership of the underlying scientific, policy, or business decisions.


**Education, Behavioural Competencies And Skills**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, data or information management, library and information science, information systems, quality, business, or a related discipline is required.
* An advanced degree or relevant professional certification in data governance, knowledge management, records and information management, or a related field is preferred.


**Experience**
* Eight or more years of relevant professional experience, including at least four years in the biopharmaceutical, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated experience in data governance, knowledge management, records and information management, repository management, data quality, or Medical operations.
* Experience establishing or improving data\-ownership practices, common definitions, data\-quality checks, repository structures, document\-lifecycle practices, or knowledge\-management processes.
* Experience with business glossaries, ontologies, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, semantic relationships, knowledge graphs, semantic search, or similar knowledge\-management capabilities.
* Experience working with Medical Affairs, quality, governance, compliance, or another regulated business area in a global or matrixed organization.
* Experience providing project, team, or matrix leadership and influencing stakeholders across functions and geographies.
* Experience supporting the transition or centralization of activities into a global capability center or shared\-services organization is preferred.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong knowledge of data stewardship, business glossaries, critical data elements, data lineage, ontology, taxonomy, metadata standards, controlled vocabularies, data quality, traceability, access, retention, and issue\-management processes.
* Experience managing document, record, or knowledge repositories, including naming conventions, classification, access controls, versioning, links between records, review cycles, retention, archiving, and retrieval.
* Experience with platforms such as Veeva Vault, SharePoint, enterprise data catalogues, document\-management systems, records\-management systems, or similar tools.
* Understanding of Records Information Management, controlled documentation, privacy, information security, and audit and inspection\-readiness requirements in a regulated environment.
* Experience with dashboards, workflow tools, data\-quality monitoring, search technologies, automation, or AI\-enabled tools applied to data or knowledge\-management activities.
* Ability to translate Medical business needs into clear requirements for data, knowledge, search, and AI solutions.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Structured and practical thinker with strong attention to detail and the ability to translate complex governance requirements into clear operational standards and ways of working.
* Demonstrates sound judgment and can distinguish issues that can be resolved operationally from those that require escalation to MGO or another accountable function.
* Strong stakeholder\-management, facilitation, and communication skills, including the ability to influence without formal authority and explain data\-governance and knowledge\-management topics clearly.
* Collaborative and pragmatic working style, with strong ownership, follow\-through, and commitment to quality, transparency, inclusion, and continuous improvement.


**Languages**
 Fluent English required; additional languages advantageous.
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Formal line reporting is to the GCM Medical Operations \& Governance Lead.
* For MGO\-assigned scope, the role works directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office, who provides functional direction on priorities, approved requirements, expected outcomes, workplans, and escalation of significant issues.
* The role supports the realization of MGO and Global Medical priorities by serving as the business owner for the Medical ontology and knowledge management framework and the operational steward for assigned Medical data and knowledge domains.


**Benefits**
 It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are:
   

  

* Competitive Salary \+ Performance Annual Bonus
* Flexible work environment, including hybrid working
* Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance Plans for self, spouse, and children
* Group Term Life Insurance and Group Accident Insurance programs
* Employee Assistance Program
* Broad Variety of learning platforms
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Programs
* Reimbursements – Home Internet \& Mobile Phone
* Employee Referral Program
* Leaves – Paternity Leave (4 Weeks) , Maternity Leave (up to 26 weeks), Bereavement Leave (5 calendar days)


**About Icc In Takeda**
* Takeda is leading a digital revolution. We’re not just transforming our company; we’re improving the lives of millions of patients who rely on our medicines every day.
* As an organization, we are committed to our cloud\-driven business transformation and believe the ICCs are the catalysts of change for our global organization.

 IND \- Bengaluru

 Employee

 Regular

* Strong experience in developing partnerships, negotiating project agreements, managing stakeholders, and driving cross\-functional collaboration. Exposure to ESG and sustainability initiatives, including integration of social impact programs with broader sustainability objectives, would be an advantage.

Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple projects, budgets, timelines, risks, and stakeholder expectations in a complex corporate environment.

title: Tech Lead — Corporate (CSR) Business Unit
description:
Position: Tech Lead — Corporate (CSR) Business Unit
   

  

 Location: Bangalore (Preferred)/Mumbai/Gurgaon/Delhi
   

  

 Job Type: 1 year contract
   

  

**About Sattva**
 We Partner to deliver social impact at scale
   

  

 Sattva Consulting is an Indian\-origin, Global impact consulting firm and since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, businesses and government to deliver societal impact at scale.
   

  

 We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our research \& advisory services, knowledge platforms and collaborative initiatives.
   

  

 Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Corporate Advisory Business Unit works as a strategic advisor to companies solving social problems at scale. The work spans CSR strategy and flagship programme design; impact portfolio advisory, covering compliance, portfolio governance, social audit, programme monitoring and impact measurement; and end\-to\-end programme management through implementation support, advisory and in\-house tools.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 We are hiring a Tech Lead to anchor technology across our Corporate (CSR) Business Unit: the platform our CSR programmes run on, the partner who builds it, and the AI and data work that is changing how the unit delivers. You will report to the Corporate BU Head and have a dotted line to the Chief Technology Officer.
   

  

 We are looking for 5–8 years in product management or technology services/consulting.
   

  

 The Corporate BU is growing in both the volume and the complexity of its engagements, and technology has moved from supporting that work to shaping what the work can be. We manage our CSR programmes on a purpose\-built platform, mGrant, from Dhwani RIS.
   

  

 AI presents a fast\-emerging opportunity in this space. Inside the unit, consultants are already piloting with it in processes like NGO due diligence and impact assessment. Outside, there are services we can build and sell — like putting Voice AI into our Impact Portfolio Advisory. What the unit needs now is someone to hold all of this together: to set the standard for the platform and the partnership, and to turn promising pilots into offerings we can take to market.
   

  

 The Ideal Candidate
   

  

* 5–8 years of experience in product management or technology services/consulting.
* A solid working understanding of the software development lifecycle in an Agile setting.
* Expertise in using AI to solve real problems — analysing data, building prototypes, knowing where it does and does not help.
* Proven experience getting B2B technology adopted inside teams, using change management and supporting behavioural change.
* Fluency in managing stakeholder relationships, internally and externally.
* Comfort with ambiguity and several parallel priorities, and the judgement to call what to focus on, what to defer, and which risks need active management.
* Clear communication in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment, and openness to occasional travel for project and client work.


 What would give you an edge:
   

  

* Experience in the social sector.
* Past work on CSR projects, particularly an understanding of how a CSR monitoring and evaluation project runs end to end.
* Experience with CSR technology tools and platforms.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 What you will own
   

  

* Drive and Manage tech platform adoption within the CSR Business Unit, playing a central role across all CSR projects in the unit
* Interface with the project leads and consultants in the unit and enable successful delivery of CSR projects using the tech platform
* Drive end\-to\-end governance of our engagement with Dhwani RIS, our technology partner behind mGrant and other potential partners
* Interface with NGO users of the tech platform, and support them on tech platform related requirements.


 What you will support:
   

  

* Client\-facing: integrating Voice AI into our Impact Portfolio Advisory (IPA) and assessment offerings, and prototyping new services we can take to IPA clients.
* Internal: optimising the workflow for processes like due diligence, impact assessment and other processes in the CSR lifecyle.
* Knowledge management: building the unit’s discipline and driving the adoption of our AI\-based knowledge management solution.
* Data: enabling longitudinal CSR insight drawn from integrating mGrant with our internal data warehouse.
* Working with the unit's AI Champions — the consultants already experimenting on their own projects — to turn what works into something productised.


 Why Sattva?
   

  

 It's not about us really\- Because IMPACT is everybody’s business.
   

  

* Create Impact: Make an impact with the work you do and the solutions you design
* Work Environment: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment
* Learn \& Grow: Challenge yourself to learn, grow, and deliver the best you can
* Future Ready: Work on critical issues of today that will affect our collective tomorrow


 How to Prepare?
   

  

 This is your opportunity to showcase not only your qualifications but also your unique personality
   

  

 and passion for making a meaningful impact. Approach your application with intentionality, ensuring that each word reflects your commitment to excellence and aligns seamlessly with the values of Sattva.
   

  

 FAQs on the Hiring Process
   

  

 Next Steps
   

  

 Together towards a sustainable world with opportunity for all!
   

  

 Sattva is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, caste, creed, gender, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected and/or marginalized characteristics. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are essential to our business and we foster an environment of respect and a culture that celebrates diversity and promotes equity and inclusion.  Let’s build what’s next, together.

 You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements, define the scope of work, conduct solution reviews, and deliver customized solutions using APIs, conversational AI, automation platforms, and emerging AI development tools.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions, implementation plans, and scopes of work.
* Use AI development tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar AI platforms to accelerate solution design, implementation, coding, prototyping, and documentation.
* Create and maintain AI\-generated or AI\-assisted technical artifacts, including prototypes, workflows, reusable skills, integrations, code components, documentation, and solution accelerators.

* Support solution implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation troubleshooting.

* Stay up to date with SaaS, conversational AI, generative AI, automation, and CPaaS trends, and apply relevant best practices.

* Minimum 3 years of experience in solution engineering, technical consulting, systems development, enterprise software implementation, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience in a customer\-facing role, including the ability to communicate confidently, present solutions, influence stakeholders, and handle client discussions independently.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, workflows, or other technical artifacts.
* Practical experience with chatbot technologies, conversational AI, generative AI, or conversational agent solutions.
* Proficiency in one or more of JavaScript, C\+\+, and .NET, along with the ability to understand and work across multiple technologies.
* Strong knowledge of API integrations, particularly REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and third\-party service integrations.
* Experience with SaaS products and enterprise\-level implementations.

* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with Agile methodologies is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Why you'll love it here**
