title: Founder's Office - Generalist
description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.
 



 Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
 



 Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top\-tier global investors, 60\+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Tackle founder\-level problems. Dive into ambiguous questions (e.g., "How do we cut customer onboarding time by 40%?") and deliver a data\-backed solution—process, product spec, or growth playbook
* Shadow → Own. Start by shadowing founders and executives across GTM, Product, and Operations, and quickly take ownership of initiatives with significant revenue, customer, or cost impact
* Be the connective tissue. Translate hard manufacturing realities from shop\-floor SMEs into crisp product requirements; then turn those into value propositions sales can run with
* Scale what works. Systematize every win—dashboards, SOPs, automations—so the next team member can sprint from day 1
* Rinse, learn, repeat. Each quarter you'll rotate (sales → CS → product → biz ops), compounding domain depth while keeping a 10,000\-foot strategic view



  





**You Might Thrive Here If You** 



* Love messy problems. You run towards the smoke, disassemble chaos into first\-principles, then rebuild in clean layers of logic \& data
* Play in spreadsheets \& slides with equal joy. Google Sheets in the morning; crisp narrative memo by lunch; client demo at 4 PM
* Have a bias for action. You'd rather ship v0\.1 today and iterate than debate v2\.0 for weeks
* Communicate like an engineer and a poet. Precision when the stakes are technical; story when hearts \& budgets are on the line
* Are hungry—really hungry. Titles don't impress you; impact does. You measure weeks in learnings shipped
* Bring 1\-5 years of high\-intensity experience. Early\-stage start\-up, tier\-one consulting, I\-banking, ops in manufacturing—anything that shows you can out\-execute peers



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Must\-Haves** 



* 1\-4 years of experience in start\-up, consulting, business operations, product, or manufacturing.
* Engineering background from tier 1 / tier 2 colleges
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets and presentation skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership, bias for action, and comfort with ambiguity.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally across GTM, Product, Operations, and CS.



  





**Nice\-to\-Haves** 



* Experience working with founders/CXOs or on strategic projects.
* Background in B2B SaaS, manufacturing, pharma/lifesciences, or enterprise tech.
* Experience with SQL, dashboards, automation, or process building.



  





**Benefits** 



* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting\-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high\-performing team building innovative AI\-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry\-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals \& Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family\-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: Cardiovascular Program Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
 At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life\-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.
   

  

 As a pioneer and market leader in robotic\-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible.
   

  

 Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
   

  

 Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture. Our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long\-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.
   

  

 Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Primary Function of Position**
 The Cardiovascular Program Specialist (CVPS) will provide expert clinical support, education, and training to physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on the use of DaVinci cardiac surgery, devices and therapies. This role partners closely with the sales team, specifically the Cardiovascular Sales Manager (CVSM) to ensure safe and effective product adoption while driving positive patient outcomes. This role will be a part of a future small team of strategic sales professionals across the country who are focused on developing cardiac surgeons, and all those associated with cardiac programs.
   

  

**Clinical Support \& Case Coverage**
* Provide on\-site case support in the operating room or hybrid OR for procedures involving robotic cardiac procedures and surgery technologies.
* Serve as a clinical expert for product setup, troubleshooting, and optimal use during live cases.
* Ensure compliance with clinical and safety protocols.
* Expand the user base collaborating with CVSM to cultivate a training pipeline of new surgeons.
* Exhibit proficiency in multiple technology platforms to effectively support DaVinci adoption of Multiport Single Port, digital solutions, and customer needs.
* Promote advanced instruments and accessories to enhance surgical performance and promote surgeon autonomy.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional internal teams to identify and capitalize on opportunities for expanding the use of the da Vinci® Surgical Systems and strengthening Intuitive’s partnership with healthcare facilities.


**Training \& Education**
* Conduct training for physicians and care team members on indications and proper use of robotic platforms.
* Administer individualized surgeon and care team training sessions onsite and assist with organizing appropriate mentoring programs.
* Support new site start\-ups by delivering onboarding programs and in\-services.
* Act as a resource for ongoing education and product updates.
* Design and implement tailored da Vinci® pathways for surgeons and surgical teams to ensure proficient and autonomous system use, by providing recurring care team training as needed.
* Maintain flexibility to support after\-hours cases and provide weekend support as needed, dictated by the territory's adoption of robotic surgery.


**Collaboration \& Sales Partnership**
* Partner with local ISI sales team, leadership, customer training, and business partners to execute the appropriate clinical plan for surgeons and surgical teams to ensure system autonomy within a reasonable time frame
* Provide clinical insights to the commercial team to shape strategy and drive business growth.
* Participate in physician education programs, workshops, and regional/national conferences.
* Facilitate the adoption of our digital solutions through enhancing our customer infrastructure and capabilities.
* Communicate and collaborate with ancillary equipment manufacturers to develop strategies to ensure overall programmatic success


**Market \& Clinical Insights**
* Collect and communicate customer feedback to internal teams (sales, marketing, R\&D).
* Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines.
* Assist in clinical trial support when required.


**Preferred Skills and Experience** 
 (As applicable \- Specific skills, knowledge, and experience that are not required to perform the job, but are desirable to have)
   

  

* Deep understanding of cardiac anatomy, physiology, and interventional procedures.
* Exhibit a working knowledge of typical hospital policies.
* Excellent communication, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work in high\-pressure environments (OR/Cath lab)
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and complex procedures.
* Team oriented with a commercial mindset.
* Willingness to travel up to 75% domestically.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in nursing, Life Sciences, or related field required
* Advanced degrees (RN, PA, NP, RT, or other clinical credentials) preferred.
* Minimum 5\+ years of sales or related experience in the medical devices industry
* At least 2\+ years of managing government customers
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Marketing \& Hospital analysis experience is essential
* Sales management experience
* Ability to travel up to 50%, dependent upon account distribution

title: Project Associate - Gender and Digital Empowerment
description:
IT for Change (ITfC) is a not\-for\-profit organization whose mission is to end digital inequality and advance just, equitable, and people\-led digital futures. ITfC works through three strategic program areas: Gender and Digital Empowerment, Public EdTech, and Just Digital Governance. The Gender and Digital Empowerment program works with adolescent girls across rural, semi\-urban, and urban Karnataka, inside schools and within communities. We are currently expanding our program and are looking for a Project Associate to support program delivery, documentation, and impact reporting for our in\-school interventions.
 



  





**Position Title** 




 Project Associate
 



  





**Location** 




 Bengaluru, Karnataka with in\-office presence
 



  





**Reporting To** 




 Head \- Gender and Digital Empowerment
 



  





**Role** 




 This is a field\-facing, ownership\-driven role at the heart of the adolescent empowerment program. The Project Associate will facilitate curriculum delivery in schools, help build and apply the program's MEL (Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning) systems, support funder reporting, and create digital content that documents and communicates program impact. The role bridges direct program delivery with the data, documentation, and relationship\-building that sustain and grow the initiative. 
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**01: Program Delivery \& Facilitation** 



* Facilitate the adolescent empowerment curriculum and digital skilling for adolescent girls and boys across Bengaluru schools.
* Manage field implementation across schools, colleges, and community settings, including day\-to\-day coordination.



  





**02: Impact Documentation** 



* Document project work and contribute to program strategy and ideation.



  





**03: Digital content creation \& Dissemination** 



* Develop digital resources including audio/video for program curriculum, toolkits and social media.
* Support program outreach with funders and peer organizations.



  





**04: Donor \& Funder Reporting** 



* Own donor and funder reporting for one or more institutional partners, including narrative and data inputs.
* Track reporting timelines and compliance requirements in coordination with the program lead.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* **Gender and adolescent empowerment expertise:** 
 Solid grasp of gender dynamics and adolescence, with a strong commitment to feminist values and an inclusive workplace.
* **Program implementation and field facilitation:** 
 Hands\-on experience delivering curriculum and running activities directly with adolescents in school and/or community settings.
* **Communication and content creation:** 
 Comfort with creating digital content, including audio and video, for social media and outreach, and translating program work into donor\-facing narratives.
* **Language proficiency:** 
 Solid hold on Kannada language (spoken, written and typing) along with English.
* **Ownership and self\-direction:** 
 Proven ability to independently plan, execute, and own program components end\-to\-end, delivering reliably.



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 



* Postgraduate degree in Social Work, Gender Studies, Development Studies, Sociology, or a related field.
* 3–4 years' experience working with adolescent girls and young women.
* Proficient in Kannada and English, spoken and written; Kannada typing is mandatory.
* Fluent with applications and tech tools, and open to picking up new tech skills.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to contribute meaningfully to social change
* Collaborative and mission\-driven work environment
* Scope for professional growth and leadership
* A flexible and hybrid work environment, with three in\-person office days a week
* A competitive compensation package including health benefits, with salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.



  





**Application Process** 




 For more details about the job and to apply, fill this form: https://bit.ly/gdeassociate
 



  





 Last date to apply: 25th September 2026
 



  





 Know more about the Gender and Digital Empowerment Program here: https://bit.ly/gdeprogram

 Dyson IT are mid\-transformation. Our aim, to create robust IT architecture, to manage data effectively and efficiently and continue to grow our world\-class team. A team who is strategic, enabling business acceleration, growth and success.
   

  

 Workplace Platform team
   

  

 The Workplace Platform Team Act As a Key Technology Partner For Microsoft 365 Collaboration Capabilities, Productivity Platforms, Governance, Adoption And Secure Digital Solutions Across The Organisation

title: Associate Quality Engineer
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
   

  

 As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
   

  

 What You Can Expect
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Associate Quality Engineer supports software quality assurance, software testing, verification and validation (V\&V), and compliance activities in a regulated environment. This entry\-level role assists with reviewing software requirements and deliverables, developing and executing test documentation, supporting defect management, maintaining traceability, and participating in software lifecycle quality activities.
   

  

 The position works under the guidance of senior Software Quality and Quality Assurance team members and collaborates with cross\-functional teams including Software/R\&D, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs. The ideal candidate has a foundation in software testing, application and API testing, defect tracking, and software development lifecycle processes, with an interest in developing expertise in regulated software and medical device quality systems.
   

  

**Work mode:** 
 2 WFH, 3 WHO
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
   

  

 How You'll Create Impact
   

  

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
* Support software quality assurance activities throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Assist with software verification and validation (V\&V) activities, including development, review, execution, and documentation of test plans, test cases, test protocols, and test reports.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing for software applications, including embedded, desktop, web\-based, and cloud\-based systems, as applicable.
* Support application testing to identify functional defects, UI issues, usability concerns, performance issues, and inconsistencies.
* Execute and document testing of software features and verify defect corrections and implemented fixes.
* Support the review of software requirements, design documentation, test documentation, and other software deliverables for completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability.
* Participate in requirements activities and assist with ensuring requirements are clear, complete, traceable, and verifiable.
* Assist with maintaining traceability between software requirements, risk controls, test cases, and verification evidence using Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) or similar tools.
* Support defect tracking, investigation, documentation, retesting, and closure activities.
* Assist with testing REST APIs and software interfaces, including validation of requests, responses, error handling, and status codes using tools such as Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI.
* Support software integration testing between frontend, backend, databases, and external interfaces.
* Assist with software change management activities, including impact assessments, regression testing, and updates to applicable documentation.
* Assist with maintaining configuration and release traceability and supporting software version and change documentation.
* Prepare and maintain validation and quality documentation, including test plans, protocols, test cases, execution records, RTMs, validation reports, and other objective evidence.
* Support compliance with applicable quality system procedures and regulatory requirements, including FDA regulations, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, GAMP 5, and 21 CFR Part 11, as applicable.
* Assist with audit readiness activities and provide documentation or support during internal audits, external audits, and regulatory inspections as needed.
* Collaborate effectively with R\&D, Software Engineering, QA, and Regulatory teams to support software quality objectives.


 This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.
   

  

 What Makes You Stand Out
   

  

**Expected Areas Of Competence (i.e., Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**
* Familiarity with web and application testing, including identification of UI defects, functional errors, formatting inconsistencies, responsiveness, and overall software quality issues.
* Exposure to REST API development and testing, including API requests and responses, HTTP methods and status codes, CRUD operations, and tools such as Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI.
* Exposure to Python and backend frameworks such as Flask and/or Django, with basic understanding of frontend\-to\-backend integration, software debugging, and relational databases such as MySQL and/or MariaDB.
* Basic understanding of software quality processes, the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), software verification and validation (V\&V), configuration management, version control, and software release traceability.
* Familiarity with regulatory and quality concepts and standards applicable to software, including FDA regulations, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, GAMP 5, and 21 CFR Part 11, as well as risk management, change management, and documentation control processes.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organization, communication, and attention\-to\-detail skills, with the ability to document issues, test results, and findings clearly, work independently under guidance, and collaborate effectively in a cross\-functional team environment.


 Your Background
   

  

**Education/Experience Requirements**

Role: Lead\- Technical Trainer
   

  

 Department: Operations Location: Bengaluru, India Experience: 10\+Years
   

  

**Your Team:**

Our Flexible Energy Stack consists of the e^pack (battery pack) and e^pump (charging station), which unlock 15\-minute rapid charging.
   

  

**Our philosophy:**
 Break. Believe. Build.
   

  

 Break stuff, break assumptions, break the thumb rule.
   

  

 Believe in the team, the process, and through failures.
   

  

 Build fast, build passionately, build to simplify.
   

  

 Own it like you mean it.
   

  

**What you'll own:**
 The Technical \& Product Trainer will design, develop, and deliver comprehensive technical and product training programs for our dealership network and internal teams. This role focuses heavily on the Electric Vehicle (EV) segment for 3 Wheelers and Heavy commercial vehicles. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between advanced EV engineering and practical dealership applications, ensuring dealer technicians, service advisors, and sales teams are fully equipped to support our EV commercial product lineup.
   

  

**What you'll do:**
**Technical Training Delivery**
* Conduct hands\-on technical training for dealer technicians on EV architecture, high\-voltage systems, powertrain, battery and chargers
* Train dealership staff on advanced diagnostics, troubleshooting, and the use of specialized OEM diagnostic tools
* Educate teams on rigorous high\-voltage safety protocols, safety gear (PPE) utilization, and emergency response procedures


**Product \& Sales Training**
* Deliver product performance, capability, and feature training to dealer sales teams and product specialists
* Translate complex EV commercial vehicle technical specifications into clear, value\-based sales arguments (e.g., Total Cost of Ownership, charging infrastructure, payload efficiency)
* Conduct competitive analysis training to help dealerships differentiate our EV products in the commercial market


**Content Development \& Strategy**
* Create, update, and localize training modules, manuals, e\-learning content, and practical assessment tools
* Collaborate with R\&D, product planning, and engineering teams to stay ahead of upcoming vehicle launches and software updates
* Design simulation\-based learning and hands\-on trouble\-shooting exercises for the training lab


**Dealer Performance \& Assessment**
* Evaluate and certify dealer technicians and sales staff based on OEM global standards
* Monitor dealer training KPIs and conduct skill\-gap analyses to recommend targeted training interventions
* Provide on\-site or remote technical support to dealerships handling complex, first\-time EV issues


**What you'll bring:**
* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Automobile, Mechanical, or Electrical/Electronics Engineering
* 3 to 6 years of experience as a Technical Trainer within an Automobile OEM or Tier\-1 supplier
* Minimum 2 years of dedicated experience in Electric Vehicle (EV) systems, preferably within the commercial vehicle segment (buses, trucks, or LCVs)


**What matters to us:**
* Quality of work
* Structured problem\-solving
* Dissatisfaction with mediocre work
* Ability to multi\-task and handle a dynamic working environment
* Resilient attitude to bounce back after failing


**About Us:**
 Exponent is building the energy stack powering commercial EVs in India. Our proprietary battery and charging technology enables safe, reliable 15\-minute rapid charging while delivering a 3,000\-cycle battery life warranty using standard lithium\-ion cells. Today, our platform powers high\-utilisation commercial vehicles \- from three\-wheelers to intercity buses, making electric mobility rapid, more reliable and more affordable than petroleum.
   

  

 Founded by Arun Vinayak (Founding Partner \& Former Chief Product Officer, Ather Energy), Exponent is a 250\+ member team of passionate builders solving some of the toughest engineering challenges in energy.
   

  

 If solving hard engineering problems across mechanics, thermal systems, power electronics, manufacturing, and the charging network, while staying obsessed with customer experience excites you, we'd love to build with you.

**Position Overview**
 The Consultant, Regulatory Operations will support the preparation, formatting, compilation, publishing, validation and dispatch of regulatory submissions in accordance with applicable regional requirements, internal procedures and project timelines. This role is responsible for assisting with submission\-ready document preparation, eCTD publishing activities, technical validation checks and lifecycle submission support for dossiers such as IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, amendments and responses, as applicable.
   

  

 The position requires hands\-on support in regulatory document conversion, hyperlinking, bookmarking, PDF quality checks, eCTD sequence preparation, validation using approved tools, and submission dispatch through relevant health authority gateways under the guidance of senior team members. The role also involves coordination with CMC Regulatory Affairs, Labelling, Clinical, Quality and other cross\-functional teams to ensure timely collection, organization and processing of documents while maintaining accuracy, compliance and audit\-ready documentation standards.
   

  

**WORK LOCATION:**
 Bangalore
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 (This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented or changed as necessary.)
   

  

* Prepare, convert, format and quality check regulatory documents, including clinical, nonclinical, CMC, labelling and administrative documents, to ensure they are submission\-ready and compliant with applicable formatting standards.
* Perform document\-level activities such as PDF conversion, hyperlinking, bookmarking, pagination checks, document property verification, file naming checks and technical readiness review as per internal procedures and submission requirements.
* Support compilation and publishing of assigned regulatory submissions in eCTD format using approved publishing tools under the guidance of senior team members.
* Assist in preparation of regulatory submissions including IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, amendments, supplements and responses to health authority queries, as applicable.
* Perform eCTD sequence preparation, document placement, leaf title checks, metadata review and lifecycle operator checks in accordance with regional regulatory requirements and internal checklists.
* Conduct technical validation of assigned submissions using approved validation tools and support resolution of validation errors or warnings in coordination with senior team members.
* Support dispatch of submissions through applicable health authority gateways or portals such as FDA ESG, EMA Gateway/Web Client, MHRA Submissions Portal and other regional systems, as required.
* Maintain accurate publishing records, validation reports, submission acknowledgements, dispatch confirmations and related documentation to ensure audit\-ready traceability.
* Coordinate with CMC Regulatory Affairs, Labelling, Clinical, Quality and other cross\-functional teams for timely receipt, review, organization and processing of documents required for regulatory submissions.
* Track assigned publishing activities, timelines, pending documents, validation status and submission milestones, and provide timely updates to senior team members and stakeholders.
* Follow applicable ICH guidelines, regional eCTD specifications, internal SOPs, work instructions, naming conventions, quality checklists and document management requirements while performing assigned activities.

title: Data Governance Associate
description:
**Job Description**
 Are you ready to make data your playground? Join a team where your technical skills, creativity, and curiosity will help shape how HR data is classified, secured, and delivered across the enterprise. If you thrive on variety, love solving complex problems, and want to make a real impact, this is the role for you!
   

  

 As a Data Management Associate in HR, you'll be the driving force behind how our organization classifies, secures, and unlocks the power of data. You'll architect robust access control models, organize and elevate HR data assets, and champion data as a product—making information discoverable, trusted, and ready for action. Collaborating with Data Owners, Product Owners, Engineering and business leaders, you'll deliver high\-impact presentations, streamline governance, and continuously improve our data processes. If you're ready to innovate, influence, and transform how data empowers our people, this is the opportunity for you.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Support roadmap execution by gathering inputs, documenting decisions, tracking milestones, and maintaining risk and dependency logs and release checklists.
* Assist with role and access design for HR and employee data — documenting policy patterns clearly enough that engineering teams can implement them without follow\-up.
* Maintain the entitlement taxonomy (data products, assets, attributes, concepts, sensitivity tags), flagging inconsistencies and keeping documentation current across teams.
* Develop working knowledge of the firm's enterprise data platform entitlement model — how access is structured at the object, row, and column level — sufficient to document requirements and validate implementations.
* Support data classification maintenance by keeping sensitivity tier definitions accurate and linking business glossary terms to physical data assets. Document how enterprise identity groups map to data platform access roles, flagging mismatches or accounts that fall outside governed structures.
* Develop familiarity with entitlement and governance tooling in use (e.g., Immuta, Collibra) — enough to document configurations, support testing, and produce end\-user guidance.
* Write clear, build\-ready requirements — user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data definitions — that engineering teams can act on directly.
* Coordinate and facilitate stakeholder working sessions, demos, and training, making entitlement concepts accessible to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Track and report entitlement metrics (time\-to\-entitle, recertification rates, SQL performances) and surface trends or anomalies to the product lead.
* Ensure audit logging and compliance requirements are reflected in requirements and release artifacts; understand what evidence a controls review needs.
* Maintain SOPs for entitlement operations — access requests, approvals, recertifications, exceptions — in line with firmwide standards.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* 2\+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, data governance, access controls, or risk and controls — ideally in a data\-heavy environment.
* Working understanding of Role\-Based (RBAC) and Attribute\-Based (ABAC) access control — what they are, when each applies, and how policies translate into platform configurations.
* Familiarity with enterprise data platforms and fair understanding of SQL.
* Basic understanding of data classification — sensitivity tiers, tagging, and how classification drives access policy. Comfortable working with data dictionaries and business glossaries.
* Able to read data queries and table definitions well enough to review access configurations and identify obvious entitlement gaps — deep technical expertise is not required.
* Proven ability to produce precise, actionable requirements — user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria — that engineering teams can build from without back\-and\-forth.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Experience in financial services, healthcare, or another highly regulated environment.

title: Technical Support Engineer – EHR / EMR Application Support
description:
📍
 **India \| Remote** 




 🕒
 **Full time \| UK business hours** 




  





**Technical Support Engineer \| Technical Support Analyst \| Technical Solution Analyst \| Application Support Engineer \| Technical Support Consultant \| EHR / EMR \| SQL \| Production Support** 




  





 About the role
 



 Script Assist is hiring junior
 **Technical Support Engineers** 
 to investigate and resolve technical and functional problems within our healthcare software platform.
 



 We are particularly interested in candidates currently or recently working as:
 


* **Technical Support Engineer**
* **Technical Support Analyst**
* **Technical Solution Analyst**
* Associate Technical Support Consultant
* Technical Support Consultant
* Application Support Engineer
* Application Support Analyst
* Software Support Engineer
* Software Specialist
* Software Specialist – Support
* Product Support Engineer
* Production Support Engineer
* EHR / EMR Technical Support Analyst



 This job is deliberately designed to reach junior technical\-support populations from companies such as:
 


* **eClinicalWorks**
* **Altera Digital Health / Allscripts**
* **Oracle Health / Cerner**
* athenahealth
* NextGen Healthcare
* PracticeSuite
* MEDITECH
* InterSystems / TrakCare
* other EHR / EMR / HIS and enterprise SaaS vendors



  





 eClinicalWorks uses the
 **Technical Support Engineer** 
 and
 **Software Specialist** 
 career family; Altera currently recruits
 **Associate Technical Support Consultants** 
 for entry\-level enterprise healthcare software support; Cerner has used
 **Technical Support Engineer** 
 and
 **Technical Solution Analyst** 
 roles.
 



 This is
 **software/application support** 
 .
 



 It is not desktop, hardware, network or generic IT support.
 



  





**About Script Assist** 




 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company.
 



 Our platform supports complex private clinical services and connects clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams.
 



 The software contains interconnected:
 


* clinical workflows
* application logic
* permissions
* configuration
* customer data
* statuses
* integrations
* operational workflows
* users and roles



 When something goes wrong, the customer's description of the problem may only be the starting point.
 



 Our Technical Support Engineers need to enjoy asking:
 


* Can I reproduce it?
* What happened immediately before the issue?
* What does the data show?
* Is the configuration correct?
* Is this expected application behaviour?
* Is the user's workflow correct?
* Is another system involved?
* Does the problem affect everyone or one customer?
* Is this a genuine software defect?
* What evidence does Engineering need?
* How can I verify the fix?



  





**What you will do** 




 You will:
 


* Triage
 **technical support and application\-support tickets**
* Investigate customer\-reported software issues
* Gather evidence required for diagnosis
* Reproduce application problems
* Analyse application behaviour
* Inspect error messages and available logs
* Perform basic data investigation
* Use SQL where appropriate
* Investigate application configuration
* Identify likely root causes
* Distinguish software defects from data, configuration and workflow problems
* Investigate production\-support incidents
* Write clear reproduction steps
* Document findings accurately
* Escalate complex defects to Product and Engineering
* Work with developers and QA engineers
* Validate software fixes
* Retest issues before closure
* Maintain accurate incident and ticket histories
* Communicate technical information clearly to customers
* Build troubleshooting documentation and knowledge articles
* Identify recurring issues and opportunities for automation or process improvement



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 We are primarily targeting candidates with
 **0–2 years of experience** 
 .
 



 An ideal candidate may have approximately
 **6–24 months** 
 as a:
 


* Technical Support Engineer
* Application Support Engineer
* Technical Support Analyst
* Technical Solution Analyst
* Technical Support Consultant
* Associate Technical Support Consultant
* Software Support Engineer
* Software Specialist
* Product Support Engineer
* Production Support Analyst



 We will also consider an exceptional fresher or graduate with strong technical aptitude.
 



  





**Preferred education** 




 We strongly prefer:
 


* B.Tech / BE Computer Science
* B.Tech / BE Information Technology
* Computer Engineering
* BCA
* MCA
* BSc Computer Science
* BSc IT
* Electronics
* another relevant technical degree



 This mirrors the kind of entry\-level technical profile being recruited into healthcare application support today. For example, Altera's current 0–1 year Associate Technical Support Consultant role explicitly targets technical graduates and develops them across enterprise applications, databases, interfaces, incident management and application troubleshooting.
 



  





**Technical skills** 




 You do not need everything below.
 



 Experience with some of these is particularly valuable:
 


* **SQL**
* relational databases
* database queries
* APIs
* JSON
* REST APIs
* application logs
* error logs
* browser developer tools
* software testing
* defect reproduction
* root\-cause analysis
* incident management
* problem management
* Jira
* ServiceNow
* Zendesk
* Freshdesk
* application configuration
* production support
* SaaS support
* enterprise software support
* EHR support
* EMR support
* HIS support



 Basic knowledge of operating systems and networking can be useful when troubleshooting an application.
 



 But infrastructure is
 **not the job** 
 .
 



  





**Healthcare / EHR experience** 




 Particularly relevant experience includes:
 



  





 eClinicalWorks
 



 Candidates who have worked as:
 


* Technical Support Engineer
* Software Specialist
* Software Specialist – Support
* Application Support Engineer



 eClinicalWorks Technical Support Engineer compensation data also sits almost exactly around this hiring range, with Indeed currently estimating an average of approximately ₹4\.83 LPA in India.
 



  





 Altera Digital Health / Allscripts
 



 Candidates who have worked as:
 


* Associate Technical Support Consultant
* Technical Support Consultant
* Application Support Analyst
* Application Support Engineer



 Altera's current junior support role involves ServiceNow tickets, application troubleshooting, logs, configuration, databases, interfaces, escalation and customer communication.
 



  





 Oracle Health / Cerner
 



 Candidates who have worked as:
 


* Technical Support Engineer
* Technical Support Analyst
* Technical Solution Analyst
* Technical Solution Analyst I
* Application Support Analyst



 There are public Cerner career paths moving from
 **Technical Support Engineer → Senior Technical Support Engineer → Technical Solution Analyst** 
 , which is exactly the occupational family we want this advert to match.
 



 We are also interested in equivalent junior technical\-support experience from:
 


* athenahealth
* NextGen Healthcare
* PracticeSuite
* MEDITECH
* InterSystems / TrakCare
* other EHR / EMR / HIS companies
* complex SaaS, ERP, fintech and enterprise software businesses



 What this role is NOT
 



 This is not primarily:
 


* desktop support
* laptop repair
* hardware maintenance
* printer support
* Windows installation
* Active Directory administration
* router or switch configuration
* network operations
* infrastructure support
* NOC monitoring
* generic IT service desk



 If your career is mainly about supporting
 **devices or infrastructure** 
 , this probably isn't the right role.
 



 If it is about investigating
 **software applications** 
 , we want to hear from you.
 



  





**Why join Script Assist?** 




 This is designed as a strong early\-career route into sophisticated software and healthcare technology.
 



 You will work directly alongside:
 


* Product
* Engineering
* QA
* Support
* Operations



 Rather than simply forwarding technical tickets, you will learn how to investigate them properly.
 



 Strong performers can progress towards:
 


* Senior Technical Support
* Application Support
* Product Support
* Technical Operations
* QA
* Implementation
* Integrations
* Business Analysis
* Product
* Customer Technology
* If you like working out
 **why software behaves the way it does** 
 , this role should suit you.

title: Demand Generation Intern
description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.
   

  

 Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
   

  

 Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top\-tier global investors, 60\+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.
   

  

**About The Demand Generation Team**
 Demand Generation owns how these buyers find Leucine before sales ever talks to them. We run it like an engineering programme, not a content mill: every channel has a locked methodology, a baseline, a numeric goal, a task list and a weekly measurement loop. Our work lives in an internal command\-center dashboard with dedicated centers for SEO, Social Media and Events, plus goal tracking across all three.
   

  

 One principle you must be comfortable with from day one:
 **Demand Gen suggests keywords, pages, changes and ideas. The website and content team writes the copy and builds the pages.** 
 You will not be ghost\-writing blog posts. You will be doing the research, analysis and specification work that tells the content team exactly what to write and why.
   

  

**The role**
 You will spend of your time on SEO, Social Media, Events and early outbound work. You will work alongside the Demand Gen lead using our internal tooling (Google Search Console, GA4, DataForSEO, PageSpeed Insights, Webflow, Supabase\-backed dashboards and Claude Code automation) to move real numbers on real product pages.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* SEO (primary focus)


 Our SEO programme runs product by product through an eight\-phase pipeline: Kickoff → Seeding → Discovery → Filtering → Conversion Audit → Baseline \& Goal → Planning → Tasks → Execution. You will work inside every phase.
   

  

* Keyword research and shortlisting
* Build seed keyword lists for a product across our five seed types: core topic, customer pain, competitor brand, regulatory anchor and persona job\-to\-be\-done. Every seed must trace to real evidence (sales calls, FDA data, competitor pages, customer language), not guesses
* Expand seeds into a candidate pool using DataForSEO (multi\-mode, dual\-region India \+ US sweep), then run the junk filter and manually review every remaining row. Expect pools of several hundred keywords where 60 to 80% is noise
* Reduce the reviewed pool to 3 to 5 primary pillar keywords plus 15 to 30 supporting cluster keywords using our five\-stage funnel and weighted scoring rubric. Document the rationale for every keep and every cut
* Baseline, goal and weekly measurement
* Freeze a 28\-day baseline of impressions and clicks per product page from Google Search Console. Our success bar is 3× clicks against baseline
* Own the Monday numbers: pull GSC impressions and clicks, DataForSEO rank positions and task closure counts, compute week\-over\-week deltas against the locked baseline, and flag pages that are gaining impressions but not clicks (a title/meta problem, not a win)
* Maintain the Rank Tracker and product funnel views in the dashboard so the team sees one source of truth
* Page planning and task creation
* Map every filtered keyword to a target page and a role (pillar page vs supporting page). Build the full page list for the product and identify which of our four SEO pillars is the bottleneck on each page:
* Technical Foundation (indexability, speed, mobile, canonicals)
* Search Intent \& Content Quality (right query, depth, unique evidence)
* On\-Page Optimization (H1, title, meta, schema, internal links)
* Off\-Page Authority (backlinks, mentions)
* Audit each planned page against all four pillars and turn every gap into a task with Action, Pillar, Priority, Effort and a measurable win condition
* Change specs and handoff to the website team
* Write structured change specifications for the website team: exact current and target strings for meta titles, meta descriptions, canonicals, schema markup, keyword insertions and internal links, each with a priority and a constraint on what must be preserved. No vague "improve the page" notes
* Suggest new pages where keyword gaps exist: target keyword, suggested title tag and meta description, page structure and internal\-link targets. You specify; the content team writes
* Re\-scan the live site after the website team ships and verify each change was applied as specified. Mark resolved changes and chase the ones that are not
* Site migration (leucine.io → leucine.ai)
* We are mid\-way through migrating our old domain to the new one. You will help work the URL\-mapping table: match old URLs to new destinations, decide redirect vs keep\-live vs retire based on 16 months of GSC query data, and flag pages that need to be built new before a redirect can go live
* Set up and verify 301 redirects in Webflow, confirm the destination page is indexed, and check that rankings on the old URL transfer rather than drop
* Write migration briefs for the website team: per page, the action (build new vs update existing), the suggested keywords and where each goes, the suggested title and meta, and the page structure
* Conversion and technical health
* Read GA4 to find where product\-page traffic leaks (high exits, no CTA clicks, form abandonment) and record per\-page findings with where, why, evidence and recommended action
* Run PageSpeed Insights and Core Web Vitals checks on priority pages and log technical fixes as Pillar 1 tasks
* Help with our early Generative Engine Optimization work: llms.txt compliance, passage citability, and tracking which keywords trigger AI Overviews
* Social Media (LinkedIn) — secondary
* Help assemble LinkedIn post kits for campaigns and events: one company caption plus tailored reshare takes for each of our leadership voices, packaged with the creative
* Produce post graphics (announcement cards, countdown cards, recap carousels) using our locked brand design system and templates
* Run the weekly Monday ingest of LinkedIn analytics CSV exports into the Social dashboard and confirm every CTA link carries the correct UTM tags
* Mine our internal knowledge base and FDA Tracker data for content ideas and log them in the content\-ideas backlog
* Events — secondary
* Research and qualify pharma industry events against our ICP: who attends, which companies, sponsorship tiers and cost, and whether the expected qualified meetings justify the spend
* Build attendee dossiers for qualified events: company ICP tier, recent FDA inspection history from FDA Tracker, prior CRM contact, and public profile notes for introductions
* Support the before/during/after event campaign plan, the execution task list and the activity log as organiser emails and replies come in
* Our event success metric is sales\-qualified leads booked. You will help track meetings completed and cost per meeting after each event
* Outbound — early stage
* Our outbound channel (cold email via Instantly / Heyreach, TAM building via Clay) is scaffolded but not yet live. You will help stand it up: build target account and contact lists from FDA Tracker's inspection database filtered against our ICP, and help set up the first campaign\-tracking views (reply rate, meetings booked per sequence)


**What You Will Learn**
* How a B2B SEO programme is actually run against numbers: seeding, discovery, filtering, baselining, planning, tasking, shipping and measuring, on live product pages with real traffic
* Hands\-on fluency with Google Search Console, GA4, DataForSEO, PageSpeed Insights and Webflow
* How to run a domain migration without losing rankings
* How AI tooling (Claude Code, structured skills and automated gate reviews) is used to run marketing operations as repeatable pipelines
* How pharma quality and manufacturing buyers search, think and buy, and how FDA inspection data drives go\-to\-market


**Requirements**
**Must have**
* Final\-year student or recent graduate in marketing, business, engineering, life sciences or a related field, or equivalent self\-taught experience
* Working understanding of how search engines rank pages: intent, on\-page factors, technical basics, backlinks
* Comfortable in spreadsheets and with reading hundreds of rows of data carefully. Much of this role is disciplined review, not creative flair
* Clear written English. You will write specifications and briefs that another team executes without asking follow\-up questions
* Curiosity about a technical B2B domain. You do not need pharma knowledge on day one, but you need to want to learn what a Form 483, a deviation or a cleaning validation is


**Nice to have**
* Hands\-on time in Google Search Console or GA4, even on a personal or college project
* Exposure to any keyword tool (DataForSEO, Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Keyword Planner)
* Familiarity with Webflow or any CMS
* Basic markdown and comfort working in a terminal or with AI coding assistants
* LinkedIn content or design experience (Canva, Figma)


**Benefits**
* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting\-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high\-performing team building innovative AI\-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
* Complimentary Meals \& Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office

title: Study Start-up Associate (Site Activation Specialist)
description:
**Job Overview**
 Primary contact with investigative site(s) during site start\-up activities and maintenance with responsibility for collection of the required investigator and essential documents for a study, to ensure EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authority and any other local applications are made within the timelines agreed with project management and Site Readiness team and that documentation meets the specifications required by applicable regulations and sponsor. Proactively interacts with EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authorities to provide guidance regarding requirements. Maintain awareness of current regulatory standards related to submissions. Serve as local expert in project start\-up activities for a particular country or region. Act as a ‘knowledge resource’ to mentor and train new hires and less\-experienced department colleagues if suitable.
   

  

**Summary Of Responsibilities**
* Maintain awareness of regulatory legislation, guidance, and practice in the assigned countries.
* Coordinate, collect and organize data and information required by EC/IRB/Third body/Regulatory Authority including but not limited to the preparation of study documentation such as the country application form and cover letter for sponsor review as applicable.
* Compile and prepare routine submission filed to IRB/IEC/Third body/Regulatory Authorities (e.g., INDs/CTAs) and liaise with them as applicable regarding submission/approval.
* Liaise with internal and external vendors in the generation of Regulatory Authority submissions (as applicable).
* Perform a review of final submission documents as applicable.
* Ensure that all assigned start\-up and maintenance activities are on track, in accordance with client expectations and budget and in compliance with applicable laws and guidelines, regulatory requirements, ICH/GCP, SOPs and quality standards
* Prevent and escalate study issues appropriately and in a timely fashion.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management depending upon country and situational requirements with proper supervision \[if applicable].
* In Country specific tasks (Global):
* Serve as primary contact for investigative sites and ensure documents required are collected in a timely manner.
* Collect and track all the necessary documents required and perform a quality review, formatting, and compilation of the final documents for effective and compliant site activation and maintenance without supervision.
* Ensure high quality documents are filed and systems are updated on an ongoing and timely basis, making Fortrea ready for an audit at any time.
* Participate in team and project meetings as applicable.
* When needed, assist in the strategy definition for Site Activation and provide accurate projections and timelines to study teams.
* Review and customize country and site\-specific patient informed consent forms for compliance with local requirements and protocol. Proactively resolve informed consent issues and other potential difficulties with study sites.
* May support the negotiation of site contracts and budgets with sites, if applicable and track progress of contract and budget milestones/developments, intervening and escalating as appropriate.
* Proactively identifying and escalating to Submission Leads any risk to meeting deliverables.
* Notify the Submissions Lead of hours identified as Out\-of\-Scope or overburn.
* Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) tasks (specific centralized role for EU):
* Assist in the upload of submission documentation to, interacting with and monitoring of all notifications and alerts in CTIS to ensure all milestones and events for the trial are met within the timelines mandated.
* Performs all other duties as needed or assigned.


**Qualifications (Minimum Required)**
* University/College degree (life science preferred), or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriate accredited institution (e.g., nursing certification, medical or laboratory technology) AND 2 years' work experience in clinical research, including a strong working knowledge of the ICH guidelines and RA, IRB/IEC regulations.
* Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.
* In lieu of the above requirement, candidates with a High School Diploma or equivalent AND a minimum of 2 years' work experience in clinical research, including a strong working knowledge of the ICH guidelines and RA, IRB/IEC regulations will be considered.


**Experience (Minimum Required)**
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in clinical development or start\-up/ regulatory process.
* Working knowledge of ICH, RA, IRB/IEC, and other applicable regulations/guidelines; familiarity with investigator start\-up documents and contract/budgets negotiation process; previous interaction with operational project teams and investigative sites.
* Demonstrated understanding of research protocol requirements and proven ability to communicate them/educate others about them.


**Physical Demands/Work Environment**
* General Office Environment.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid\-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.
 



 As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting\-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.
 



 This role will act as the pivotal, hands\-on technical authority driving the performance and standardization of Armstrong Fluid Technology's control solutions. Operating at the intersection of continuous innovation and regional execution, this role requires practical expertise in industrial automation—specifically PLCs, HMIs, and robust network protocols. You will be instrumental in executing technical responsibilities within the core product development team, while simultaneously serving as the primary engineering backbone for our regional sales, service, and production operations. As key member of the product development team, you will be supporting the sales inquiries, supporting service team to reduce onsite resolution times for field issues, and ensure our optimization deployments are highly standardized, scalable, and built on reliable technical foundations.
 



 This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to strategic technology initiatives that directly impact product performance, customer satisfaction, and long\-term business growth.
 



**Key Accountabilities** 




**Job Accountability** 



* Standardization \& Product Development: Drive the continuous standardization of optimization products across the India and APAC regions, actively collaborating with global product development to ensure field\-tested, repeatable configurations are integrated into the core R\&D roadmap.
* Pre\-Sales Engineering Support: Act as the dedicated regional technical authority for the sales team, accelerating sales cycles by unblocking complex technical inquiries, advising on customer system requirements, and verifying robust automation architectures.
* Advanced Field Troubleshooting: Provide rapid, hands\-on diagnostic support for the regional service team, taking direct technical ownership of complex onsite escalations to significantly reduce Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) and minimize customer downtime.



**Job Accountability** 



* Industrial Automation Execution: Develop, program, and troubleshoot comprehensive automation architectures, utilizing deep expertise in PLCs, HMIs, and diverse industrial network protocols to ensure optimal performance of field installations.
* Coordinate changes to control logic, configuration, and system documentation to ensure smooth integration.
* Participate in testing, validation, and deployment activities to ensure performance and reliability.



**Job Accountability** 



* Support the implementation of advanced control features and system enhancements.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to create and monitor development and rollout plans for new platform capabilities.
* Coordinate changes to control architecture, firmware, and network configurations.
* Participate in design reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.



**What We’re Looking For** 




 To thrive in this role, you should bring:
 



**Education and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Control Systems, Automation Engineering, or a related field
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in control systems engineering, industrial automation, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience with Carel and JACE PLC platforms, control logic programming, and system integration.
* Deep experience in HVAC application systems and implementation of control features is an asset.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, Ethernet/IP, Bacnet) and system testing methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to work in cross\-functional teams and contribute to large\-scale engineering initiatives.



**Technical Skills** 



* Industrial Automation \& Control Systems
* PLC Programming background utilizing Ladder logic, Functional Block, Structured Texts.
* HMI Design \& Development
* Control Logic Design \& Troubleshooting
* Network and Communication protocols
* Industrial Networking: Modbus, Ethernet/IP, BACnet
* Network Troubleshooting \& Configuration
* HVAC industry experience is an asset
* Knowledge of different control algorithms and models is an asset (PID control)



**Soft Skills** 



* The capability to simplify complex problems, conduct root cause analysis, and provide clear, well\-thought\-out recommendations.
* Team\-oriented leadership skills with a proactive approach.
* An ability to communicate openly and authentically in all situations.



**Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?** 




 By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid\-flow technology while upholding Armstrong's commitment to sustainability. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

**Here’s a summary of the role:**

As a Technical Support Specialist, you’ll support customers using a large SaaS platform, troubleshoot web\-based application issues, communicate clearly over phone and email, identify and reproduce bugs, and work with escalation teams when deeper investigation is needed.
   

  

**Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do:**

* Investigate application errors and determine when an issue should be treated as a product bug and escalated to the appropriate Tier 2 or product team.
* Build strong customer relationships by explaining technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users and keeping customers informed throughout the resolution process.

* Flexibility to work an EMEA\-aligned shift, currently expected to start around 1:30 PM IST, and to support occasional crossover coverage for America shifts when required.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**About Neo** 




 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of
 **Zeta**
 ,
 **Radix**
 , and
 **Titan**
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* Tasket — A radically reimagined, AI\-native work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* Friday — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* Studio — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* Drive — AI\-native repository, where humans and agents can co\-work on files.
* Scribe — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the Role** 




 We want someone whose job is turning PRDs and product context into documentation — and building the automation that makes that scale.
 



 You are someone who reads a spec closely, understands what a user or engineer actually needs to know, and writes it clearly. But you don't stop at writing docs one at a time: you build repeatable workflows — skill files, prompt templates, structured inputs — that let AI tools generate consistent first drafts from PRDs, tickets, and changelogs, which you then refine and own.
 



 This is a hands\-on, build\-the\-system role. It's not a pure writing job where you manually draft every page, and it's not a pure engineering job either — it's the combination: strong writing judgment paired with an automation mindset.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 • Read PRDs and engineering specs, and translate them into clear technical documentation — user guides, release notes, API docs, internal runbooks
 



 • Design and build documentation automations: skill files, prompt templates, and scripts that let AI tools generate consistent first\-draft docs from structured inputs
 



 • Maintain and improve those automations over time as our product and doc formats evolve
 



 • Edit and fact\-check AI\-generated drafts against source material — you're accountable for accuracy, not just fluency
 



 • Organize documentation in our workspace tools and keep information architecture clean and findable
 



 • Partner closely with PMs and engineers to fill documentation gaps and flag when a PRD lacks the detail needed to write accurate docs
 



 • Continuously push on documentation methodology and tooling as our products evolve
 



  





**Skills** 




 • Strong written communication — this is a writing\-first role; verbal fluency alone won't cut it
 



 • Technical fluency: able to read a PRD or API spec and understand it well enough to explain it accurately
 



 • Hands\-on use of AI: real experience using AI assistants for actual work, with a clear sense of what "skills"/prompts/context files are and how to build with them
 



 • Working understanding of project management and workspace tools (Confluence, Jira, Notion, or similar)
 



 • Genuine curiosity about systems and process — an instinct to automate the repeatable parts of a workflow
 



 • Comfortable with ambiguity and moving quickly
 



  





**Experience and Qualifications** 




 • Around 1–2 years of experience in technical writing, content engineering, developer relations, QA, or a similar technical\-adjacent role. Strong internship experience counts.
 



 • Exposure to product development or working alongside a product/engineering team
 



 • A background in computer science/engineering, or another field (journalism, English, technical support) paired with demonstrated technical comprehension — no specific degree required
 



  





**Equal Opportunity** 




 Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

title: Content Lead- Discovery
description:
You will be the editor of a machine that writes for local businesses. You will not write the content. You will decide what good means, prove whether the machine is meeting it, and find the reasons when it is not.
   

  

**About Zoca**
 Zoca builds AI agents that local service businesses hire to run the parts of the business the owner cannot get to. More than 1,000 businesses use Zoca today. We started in beauty and wellness and are backed by Accel, Elevation Capital, Better Capital and GTM Fund.
   

  

 Discovery is the agent that runs a business’s online presence: its Google Business Profile, website, service pages, blogs, Google posts and reviews. It publishes on behalf of thousands of businesses every week, many of them in the same cities.
   

  

**The terrain**
 How does content written by a machine, for a business the machine only knows through data, become genuinely useful to a person searching nearby? How does it rank, and keep ranking, when the same machine is writing for the business down the street? Nobody at Zoca owns that question today. Engineers own the pipeline. Nobody owns what comes out of it.
   

  

 You would inherit a working pipeline from keywords to topics to published pages and posts, a per\-business context layer we call Brain that holds services, staff, tone and house rules, a live connection to every business’s Google Business Profile and Search Console, every review those businesses have received, and engineers who want someone to argue with about what the pipeline should produce. Over a thousand live businesses across many cities means a natural experiment running every day, if someone reads it.
   

  

**What We Know So Far**
 Google treats content produced at volume to manipulate ranking as spam, whoever wrote it. Fluent, generic content has become free, and specific, local, useful content has not. Many businesses in the same city want the same topics. And from the outside, a page that never got indexed, a page on the wrong topic, and a badly written page all look the same.
   

  

 What we do not know, and have opinions on that we will share after we hear yours: what separates two businesses’ content in the same zip code beyond the facts about each. How much business\-specific data moves ranking compared to the prose. Which content types are worth producing at all. Where a human belongs in the loop and where a human is a bottleneck dressed up as quality. And how you know a page is good before Google tells you two months later.
   

  

**What You Would Own**
* The definition of good. A rubric a person and a model can both apply, with pages that pass, pages that fail, and why.
* The weekly read. A sample of what shipped, across cities and business types, scored against the rubric, with every failure turned into a named class rather than a one\-off fix.
* The eval set. The pages the pipeline is measured against before anything goes live, and the automated judge engineering builds from it.
* Local intent, per business type. What someone searching for a lash studio wants to read is not what someone searching for a med spa wants. You decide what we produce for each, and what we stop producing.
* The outcome numbers. Pages indexed, pages earning impressions, keywords ranked, clicks, and calls and bookings we can trace back to a page. Not output volume. Where those numbers should be is yours to argue.


 If you find yourself writing blogs, something upstream is broken, and that is the thing to fix.
   

  

**Who You Probably Are**
* You have personally made local pages rank for hundreds of small businesses, at an agency or on a marketplace, and can explain exactly what did it.
* You write well and can say precisely why a paragraph is bad, in one sentence.
* You read Search Console before you form an opinion.
* You have worked with model\-generated content and hold a view of it that is neither hype nor contempt.
* You can write a rubric, argue with an engineer about an eval, and lose the argument gracefully when the data says so.
* You have real experience with US local search, wherever you sit.


 This is not a content calendar role, a people\-management role, a brand copy role or a social media role. It reports into product, works daily with the pipeline engineers, and starts with no team.
   

  

 Skills: local seo,google business profile,editorial judgment paired with seo

**Senior Content Specialist \- DBOR Transformation**
**Role Overview**
 As a Senior Content Specialist, you will play a key role in the DBOR Transformation programme, shaping the future operating model, data workflows, and tooling capabilities used across Content Operations.
   

  

 You will work closely with Content Infrastructure Owners, Engineering, Product and Operations teams to refine business requirements, support solution design, drive adoption, and ensure successful delivery of transformational change.
   

  

 This role offers a unique opportunity to influence how data is managed at scale across a global organisation while working at the forefront of AI, automation and product\-led transformation. You will work on complex business challenges, collaborate with experts across Product and Engineering, and help deliver capabilities that will shape the next generation of Content Operations
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Partner with Content Infrastructure Owners to translate strategic requirements into executable operational solutions.
* Identify and implement opportunities to leverage AI, automation and agent\-based solutions to improve operational efficiency, quality and scalability
* Define, document and maintain operating models, process documentation and operational standards
* Support data modelling activities by documenting business rules, workflows, dependencies and operational requirements.
* Develop a thorough understanding of the data sources, business rules and processing logic that support the assigned data domain
* Assess impacts of proposed changes on users, processes and downstream operations.
* Lead business testing and validation activities to ensure solutions meet operational and business requirements.
* Facilitate knowledge transfer across operational teams on new tools and functions
* Gather user feedback and identify enhancement opportunities to improve adoption and effectiveness.
* Analyse data sources, lineage, business rules and processing logic to support the design, implementation and optimisation of DBOR capabilities.
* Develop and maintain deep expertise in DBOR processes and data workflows, acting as a trusted advisor during solution deployment and adoption.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, data quality, operational controls and user experience through technology and workflow enhancements
* Build effective relationships across Content Operations, Product and Engineering teams aligned with a product‑led operating model.


**Required Skills**
* Experience delivering business, operational, data or technology transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical, business analysis and process improvement skills.
* Experience documenting business processes, requirements and operating models.
* Experience supporting technology implementations, platform migrations or operational change programmes.
* Ability to analyse complex problems and develop practical, scalable solutions.
* Ability to understand data models, technology architectures and system workflows sufficiently to collaborate effectively with engineering and product teams
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and communication skills.
* Ability to manage change and challenge existing processes.
* Experience working across both business and technical teams.
* Experience with AI agents, workflow automation tools, Python, SQL or low\-code development platforms.


**Desirable Skills**
* Experience within financial services, market data, data management, content operations or related industries.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality and operational controls.
* Experience working in Agile or product\-led delivery environment


**Career Stage:**
 Manager
   

  

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
 Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
   

  

 Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
 **Integrity, Partnership** 
 ,

 and
 **Change** 
 underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
   

  

 Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
   

  

 We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
