title: Technical Document Writer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 You will develop accurate, user\-centric, and technically sound documentation for SCADA systems in wind turbine operations, supporting engineering, commissioning, operations, and maintenance teams.
   

  

 The role requires close collaboration with SCADA engineers, network architects, software developers, and field technicians to document highly technical content related to wind farm control systems, networking architecture, data acquisition, and remote monitoring. You will translate complex engineering concepts into clear and usable documentation, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with industry standards.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for SCADA software and network infrastructure
* Develop system architecture and topology diagrams
* Prepare network configuration guides (switches, routers, firewalls)
* Document communication protocols (e.g., IEC 60870\-5\-104, Modbus, OPC)
* Develop installation and commissioning manuals
* Define cybersecurity and access control procedures
* Document alarm handling and data logging processes
* Create end\-user and admin operation guides
* Develop assembly work instructions
* Prepare electrical work instructions and wiring routing for SCADA panels
* Work on product specifications and engineering circuit drawings
* Manage BoM and components documentation
* Translate complex engineering concepts into clear documentation for technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (SCADA engineers, software developers, OT/IT teams, vendors) to gather source content
* Use documentation tools such as MS Office, Excel, Visio, Markdown, LaTeX, XML/DITA, and version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Ensure consistency in format, terminology, and compliance with industry standards and company style guidelines
* Regularly update documentation based on system upgrades, regulatory changes, and new deployments


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 3 to 6 years of experience
* Experience as a technical writer in the energy, automation, or SCADA domain
* Solid understanding of SCADA systems, industrial networking, and data acquisition principles
* Familiarity with wind turbine operations, control systems, and remote monitoring tools
* Strong grasp of networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, IP routing)
* Proficiency in creating structured technical documents using tools like MS Office, Excel, Visio, Xmetal, LaTeX, Markdown, or Sphinx
* Experience working in Agile engineering environments and interpreting technical drawings and network schematics using NX software / SEE Electrical software


**About The Team**
 You will be part of a collaborative and cross\-functional team supporting SCADA systems and wind energy solutions. The team works closely across engineering, software, and operations functions to ensure accurate documentation and smooth system deployment.
   

  

 The environment encourages knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and high\-quality documentation practices, enabling teams to effectively operate and maintain wind turbine systems while contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Gamesa?**
 Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are always looking for dedicated individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation.

 How do you imagine the future? https://youtu.be/12Sm678tjuY
   

  

 Our global team is on the front line of tackling the climate crisis, reducing carbon emissions \- the greatest challenge we face.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

title: Runbook Specialist- Technical documentation/ Technical writing
description:
**Documentation / Runbook Specialist** 




**Location: India \- Remote** 




**Job Profile Summary** 




 The Documentation / Runbook Specialist creates, governs, and maintains operational documentation for migrated services. The role owns runbooks, the documentation home, and the wiki model, ensuring content is current, searchable, version\-controlled, and support\-ready. The specialist produces service transition artefacts and coordinates structured knowledge transfer for effective post\-migration supportability.
 



**Career Level Summary** 



* Requires working knowledge of technical writing, IT operations, service transition, and knowledge management practices.



**Critical Competencies** 



* Excellence: Produces accurate, complete, consistent, and usable documentation with strong attention to detail.
* Expertise: Applies technical writing, information architecture, and service transition practices to complex environments.
* Agility: Adapts documentation priorities and content to changing migration scope, dependencies, and technical inputs.
* Ownership: Drives documentation through creation, review, approval, publication, handover, and ongoing maintenance.



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Create and maintain operational runbooks for routine operations, monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, escalation, recovery, backup, rollback, and service restoration.
* Maintain the documentation home as the authoritative location for approved operational and service transition content.
* Define and maintain the wiki model, including taxonomy, page hierarchy, naming conventions, metadata, navigation, ownership, review cycles, and archival rules.
* Convert engineering knowledge, migration procedures, design inputs, and support requirements into clear, actionable documentation.
* Produce service transition artefacts including operational readiness checklists, support models, escalation paths, contact matrices, known\-error records, handover packs, and acceptance evidence.
* Plan and coordinate knowledge\-transfer sessions, including agendas, content readiness, attendance, actions, recordings or reference material, and completion sign\-off.
* Ensure runbooks and handover artefacts are reviewed, approved, version\-controlled, and available before migration closure or service acceptance.
* Confirm each runbook includes purpose, scope, prerequisites, dependencies, steps, expected results, exception handling, escalation, owner, and review date.
* Monitor content quality, ageing, gaps, duplication, broken links, and overdue reviews, and coordinate corrective actions with accountable owners.



**Knowledge** 



* Knowledge of IT service management and service transition, including operational readiness, support handover, incident, problem, change, configuration, and knowledge management.
* Knowledge of document lifecycle management, information architecture, content governance, version control, approvals, and records retention.



**Skills** 



* Runbook authoring using consistent templates, procedural language, decision points, prerequisites, validation steps, and exception paths.
* Documentation and collaboration platforms such as SharePoint, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft 365\.



**Education** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, English, Communications, or a related field required, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.



**Certifications** 



* Any technical writing, knowledge management, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Confluence certification is an advantage.



**Experience** 



* Minimum 3\-6 years of experience in technical documentation, runbook development, knowledge management, service transition, operations enablement, or a related role.
* Experience producing operational documentation for infrastructure, cloud, application, data\-centre, or migration programs.

title: Associate Consultant-SDS Author/ Regulatory Documentation Specialist (10-15 Years)
description:

CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
   

  

 Position: Associate Consultant\-SDS Author/ Regulatory Documentation Specialist
   

  

 Experience: 10\-15 years
   

  

 Category: Software Development/ Engineering
   

  

 Shift Timing: US based hours (8:00 AM \-5:00 PM EST)
   

  

 Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai Pune/Mumbai
   

  

 Position ID: J0926\-0495
   

  

 Employment Type: Full Time
   

  

 Education Qualification: Bachelor’s or master’s in chemistry, Toxicology, Environmental Science, or a related field.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly detail\-oriented SDS Author with expertise in global chemical regulatory standards. You will be responsible for authoring, reviewing, and maintaining Safety Data Sheets (SDS), labels, and related hazard communication documents using various authoring platforms.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

* Work with US client on a daily basis to create and update SDSs, labels, and hazard communication documents using SDS authoring platforms such as ProSteward360, SAP EHS, and Sphera.
* Ensure compliance with GHS, REACH, CLP, OSHA HCS, WHMIS, and other global chemical regulations.
* Interpret chemical and toxicological data to ensure accurate classifications and hazard statements.
* Collaborate with regulatory, toxicology, and product teams for data validation and approval.
* Maintain version control and support multi\-language document generation and localization.
* Monitor regulatory changes and update documentation accordingly.
* Deliver timely SDS updates and improve safety outcomes.
* Perform peer quality reviews to report errors and improve overall performance.
* Ability to train other SDS Authors on platform and business processes.


**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 Must to have skills\-
   

  

 7\+ years of experience in SDS authoring or chemical regulatory compliance.
   

  

* Knowledge of global SDS formats and regional classification systems.
* Experience with PS360 or similar SDS authoring platforms (The WERCS, Intelligent Authoring, MSDGen, SAP EHS)
* Familiarity with chemical databases (e.g., IUCLID, ChemIDplus).
* Ability to work US based hours (8am \-5pm EST)
* Communicate directly with the customer on a daily basis on specific authoring tasks
* Certified SDS Author (AIHA, SDSRP, or equivalent)
* Dangerous good transport certification (DG)
* Exposure to SAP EHS, REACH registration systems, or Poison Centre Notification tools.
* Using task management software (JIRA, etc.) to track and prioritize tasks to timely complete


 Good to have Skills\-
   

  

* Experience with Sphera \- SAP EHS solutions is a strong advantage.
* Experience in the Oil \& Gas industry would be an added advantage.

title: Journalist
description:

* Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The CoE Post\-Market Surveillance (PMS) Specialist supports global Business Unit (BU) PMS teams by maintaining and updating approved PMS documentation as part of ongoing lifecycle surveillance activities. This role operates within a centralized Center of Excellence model, leveraging standardized processes, templates, and best practices to ensure efficiency, consistency, and compliance.
   

  

 The Specialist updates previously approved PMS reports (e.g., PMSR, PSUR, PMPF, Literature Reviews) using analyzed data provided by BU PMS teams. The CoE does not perform final approval; BU PMS teams retain full legal responsibility for product oversight and report approval.
   

  

 This role ensures PMS reports are reviewed and updated at least annually and remain inspection\-ready and compliant with applicable regulations (e.g., IVDR EU 2017/746\).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Update approved PMS reports (PMSR, PSUR, PMPF, Literature Reviews) using BU\-provided data
* Ensure timely annual or periodic updates of PMS documentation
* Maintain version control and document traceability
* Compile and integrate BU data into standardized templates
* Ensure clarity, accuracy, and audit readiness of documentation
* Identify inconsistencies or potential safety signals and escalate to BU teams
* Collaborate with BU PMS teams to gather inputs and incorporate feedback
* Deliver draft reports to BU teams for review and approval
* Apply standardized templates and support process improvements


**Scope of Role**
**In Scope:**
* Updating and maintaining PMS reports
* PMS document lifecycle management
* Supporting centralized PMS processes


**Out of Scope:**
* Approval of PMS reports (BU responsibility)
* Quality event tracking/investigation
* Regulatory submissions (e.g., EUDAMED)


**Qualifications**
**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, or related field


**Experience:**
* 1–3 years in medical devices, IVD, or regulatory/quality environment


**Skills:**
* Strong technical writing skills
* Data interpretation and analytical ability
* High attention to detail
* Familiarity with IVDR/MDR preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office


**Key Success Factors**
* Timely delivery of compliant PMS reports
* Strong collaboration with BU teams
* Consistent use of templates and processes
* Maintenance of audit\-ready documentation


**Operating Model Context**
 This role is part of a centralized PMS Center of Excellence designed to improve efficiency, standardization, and scalability while maintaining compliance and supporting Business Unit ownership of product responsibility.

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
Senior Copywriter — CRM, Product \& App (AI\-first)
 



 Team: Brand
 



 Works with: CRM \& Retention, Product UX, App Merchandise, CX
 



 Experience: 3\+ years
 



 Location: Indiranagar, Bangalore (In\-office)
 



  





**WHY DOES THIS ROLE EXIST?** 




 More of what we say to an existing pet parent goes out through CRM than through any campaign we’ll ever run. Push, email, in\-app, WhatsApp—it is our highest\-volume writing by a distance, and it’s the easiest place in the business for a voice to quietly go flat.
 



 It’s also where the money is. A pet parent who stays is worth more than one we win twice. Retention is a writing problem more often than anyone admits—the right words to the right cohort at the right moment, over and over.
 



 And the words don’t stop when the notification is tapped. The push lands, the app opens, and the same person now reads a home screen, a banner, an empty cart, an error, or a checkout button. If the message sounded like a friend and the app sounds like a form, we’ve lost the thread.
 



 Whoever writes the first line should have a hand in the next one.
 



 So, this role is CRM at its core, with two deliberate extensions: the product surfaces the message opens into and the app storefront it lands on.
 



  





**YOUR MISSION, SHOULD YOU CHOOSE TO ACCEPT** 




 • Think deeply about what pet parents would like, especially those who already trust us
 



 • Own every word we send an existing pet parent across push, email, in\-app and WhatsApp
 



 • Write to the cohort: new user, first order, repeat and lapsed
 



 • Map and write complete journeys across onboarding, retention, re\-engagement and win\-back
 



 • Carry the voice past the tap into onboarding screens, empty states, errors, confirmations and CTAs
 



 • Make the app storefront read like a shop someone wants to walk through, not a grid of SKUs
 



 • Test constantly, read the numbers and kill what loses—including the one you were proud of
 



 • Use AI to draft at volume, set up processes and ensure brand adherence at scale
 



 • Maintain a consistent brand personality across every channel and screen
 



 • Spot and avoid thnigs lyk thise
 



 • Collaborate with multiple internal teams to expedite the marketing team’s creative output
 



 • Create a tangible impact on the lives of pets and pet parents
 



 • Be around pets—a lot
 



  





**WHAT YOU’LL OWN** 



1. CRM \& lifecycle copy



 Every lifecycle surface—push, email, in\-app, WhatsApp and SMS. Each message should be written for the cohort and have a clear objective. A first\-time parent three days in and a subscription lapse at ninety days are not the same person and should not receive the same sentence.
 



 2\.Journeys, not sends
 



 Onboarding, retention, re\-engagement and win\-back. Map the whole arc, then write it. A brilliant one\-off inside a broken flow is still a broken flow.
 



 3\.Optimisation \& testing
 



 Own an always\-on testing calendar across subject lines, hooks, CTAs, framing and length. Read the results and act on them. Retire what underperforms instead of letting it run simply because it exists.
 



 4\.AI\-first production
 



 Generate cohort variants at volume, then edit hard. Build prompt and template systems so quality is repeatable and doesn’t live only in your head.
 



 5\.Product UX writing
 



 Own the screens our messages open into: onboarding and account setup, empty states, error and edge\-case copy, confirmations, permissions, subscription and vet\-consult flows, and button labels.
 



 The writing should be short, clear, kind and unmistakably us. You’ll work with Product UX designers inside their files and flows—not on a document thrown over the wall. When a pattern repeats, you’ll write it once and add it to the UX copy library so it stays written.
 



 6\.App merchandising \& category copy
 



 Own the storefront: home screen and banner copy, collection and category names, shelf and carousel titles, in\-app sale and campaign framing, and PDP support copy where it moves the needle.
 



 Merchandising is a weekly rhythm, not a weekly rewrite. Template recurring asks so this remains a corner of the week—not the entire week.
 



  





 Support \& service content
 



 Work with the CX team on macros, canned replies, help\-centre copy and FAQs.
 



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




 • At least 3 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, retention or UX copywriting
 



 • Real exposure to product or in\-app writing, even if it wasn’t part of your job title
 



 • Comfort working in Figma, inside a flow and alongside a designer
 



 • Proficiency in spoken and written English
 



 • Strong attention to punctuation, grammar and spelling
 



 • Creativity with both words and ideas
 



 • Awareness of current trends and news
 



 • An understanding of the tone required for different audiences
 



 • Experience writing for different mediums and channels, especially short\-form and character\-limited formats
 



 • Real AI fluency
 



 • An understanding of how marketing campaigns are developed, with the ability to contribute insights and words that create coherent, impactful brand campaigns
 



 • Comfort being the only writer in a room of designers, PMs and merchandisers—and holding the line on voice
 



  





 Location: Indiranagar, Bangalore
 



 Work mode: In\-office

title: Solutions Engineer - Sr Staff, DFT/ Design for Test
description:
Alternate Job Titles
   

  

* Applications Engineer, DFT
* Product Specialist, Design for Test
* Customer Solutions Engineer, Semiconductor DFT
* Technical Solutions Engineer, TestMAX
* DFT Tools Engineer


 We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years deep in semiconductor design, and you know that getting a chip to tape\-out is only half the story. The other half is making sure it can actually be tested at scale, in volume, without blowing up the schedule or the yield. You understand DFT not as a checkbox but as a discipline that makes or breaks manufacturability, and you have the hands\-on experience with scan insertion, ATPG, and tool flows to prove it.
   

  

 You are comfortable sitting across from a customer's design team, listening to their constraints, their timeline pressures, their tool frustrations, and walking out with a plan that turns those constraints into a working solution. You do not just demo tools, you configure them, script around their edges, and make them fit the problem. TCL, Python, Perl are not languages you look up, they are tools you reach for without thinking.
   

  

 You translate well. Between customer requirements and R\&D roadmaps. Between technical depth and executive summaries. Between what the tool can do today and what the customer needs by next quarter. At Synopsys, you will work on DFT solutions that shape how the industry builds and tests silicon, and the customers you support will remember the difference you made.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Work directly with semiconductor customers to understand their DFT challenges, design constraints, and tool flow requirements, then translate those into technical solutions using Synopsys DFT tools including TestMAX Manager
* Configure, customize, and deploy DFT tool flows tailored to customer designs, including scan insertion, ATPG, and verification using TestMAX ATPG, Formality, and VCS
* Deliver hands\-on technical demos and proof\-of\-concept implementations that show customers exactly how the toolset solves their specific design and test problems
* Script automation solutions in TCL, Python, or Perl to streamline customer workflows, improve tool adoption, and address gaps in existing flows
* Collaborate with Account teams to gather requirements, align on customer priorities, and provide regular technical updates throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Partner with R\&D to surface customer feedback, reproduce tool issues, and influence product roadmap decisions based on real\-world design challenges
* Stay current on DFT methodologies, semiconductor design trends, and emerging test strategies to ensure the solutions you deliver remain relevant and scalable


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Enable customers to achieve faster time\-to\-market by delivering DFT solutions that reduce design iterations and improve test coverage
* Increase adoption and satisfaction with Synopsys DFT tools by making them work seamlessly within customer design environments
* Strengthen customer relationships and retention by becoming the trusted technical advisor who understands their design challenges and delivers results
* Influence the direction of Synopsys DFT product development by bringing real customer requirements and pain points directly to R\&D
* Improve silicon yield and manufacturability across the industry by helping customers implement robust, scalable DFT methodologies
* Reduce customer support escalations by proactively solving tool flow issues and building automation that prevents common failure modes
* Protect and grow Synopsys' leadership position in semiconductor design by ensuring customers see measurable value from the toolset


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Master's degree (M.Tech or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
* 8 to 12 years of hands\-on experience in semiconductor design, DFT engineering, or related domains with direct exposure to VLSI design principles and design flows
* Deep working knowledge of Design for Testability methodologies, including scan insertion, ATPG, and DFT verification techniques
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as TCL, Python, or Perl for automation, tool customization, and workflow optimization
* Direct experience with semiconductor design tools and flows, exposure to TestMAX Manager, Formality, VCS, or TestMAX ATPG is a strong plus
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with customers, gather technical requirements, and deliver solutions that meet both technical and business objectives
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a track record of diagnosing complex tool or design issues and finding practical paths forward


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a messy design problem, and sketch out a tool flow solution on a whiteboard that makes sense to both the engineer and their manager
* You do not wait for perfect documentation or complete specs, you ask the right questions, fill in the gaps, and move forward with what you have
* You are comfortable being the bridge between customer frustration and R\&D priorities, translating "this does not work" into reproducible cases and actionable feedback
* You stay curious about what is changing in DFT, test strategies, and semiconductor design, and you bring that knowledge into the solutions you build
* You follow through, when you commit to a customer deliverable or a timeline, you make it happen or communicate early when something shifts
* You are technical enough to debug a tool flow issue yourself and collaborative enough to know when to pull in the right expert from another team


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join a team of Product Engineers and Product Specialists focused on advancing semiconductor design methodologies and delivering measurable value to customers. This team works closely with Application Engineers and R\&D to ensure customer needs are met with solutions that are reliable, scalable, and grounded in real\-world design challenges. The work you do here protects Synopsys' reputation for excellence in the semiconductor industry and directly influences how customers experience and adopt our DFT toolset.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
   

  

 \#TPG

 and competitive intelligence, including gathering, organizing, and summarizing insights
 



 from public sources, reports, and industry databases.
 



 ● Understanding of oncology, medical, and pathology terminologies.
 



 ● Conduct clinical pipeline analysis, clinical trial analysis, medical conference tracking, and
 



 draw appropriate insights.

 Pharmaceutical Sciences
 



 ● Prior knowledge of clinical trials and clinical research is preferred

 ● Fast learner with strong problem\-solving skills
 



 ● Excellent written and verbal communication in English
